info.description: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the provision of designed DNA medicines to treat and protect people from infectious diseases, cancer, and diseases associated with human papillomavirus. Its product pipeline includes VGX-3100, INO-3107, INO-5410, INO-4800, and PENNVAX-GP. The company was founded by David B. Weiner on June 29, 1983 and is headquartered in Plymouth Meeting, PA.
info.description_zh: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 致力于提供设计的 DNA 药物，用于治疗和保护人们免受传染病、癌症以及与人乳头瘤病毒相关的疾病。其產品線包括VGX-3100、INO-3107、INO-5410、INO-4800和PENNVAX-GP。該公司由 David B. Weiner 於 1983 年 6 月 29 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州普利茅斯米廷。

info.description: Lexaria Bioscience Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the provision of active pharmaceutical ingredients through its DehydraTECH drug delivery technology. It operates through the IP licensing segment which generates revenue from customers by licensing its proprietary DehydraTECH technology. The company was founded on December 9, 2004 and is headquartered in Kelowna, Canada.
info.description_zh: Lexaria Bioscience Corp. 是一家生技公司，透過其 DeHydraTECH 藥物傳輸技術提供活性藥物成分。該公司透過 IP 授權部門運營，透過授權其專有的 DeHydraTECH 技術向客戶產生收入。該公司成立於2004年12月9日，總部位於加拿大基洛納。

info.description: Cypherpunk Technologies, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing targeted and immuno-oncology therapeutics. Its novel therapies are designed to treat patients with cancer. The company was founded on January 3, 2011 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Cypherpunk Technologies, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發標靶和免疫腫瘤療法。其新穎療法旨在治療癌症患者。該公司成立於2011年1月3日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Comstock Holding Cos., Inc. engages in the development of real estate properties and provision of asset management services. It operates through the following segments: Asset Management and Real Estate Services. The Asset Management segment provides management services to real estate assets and businesses that include commercial real estate uses, including apartments, hotels, office buildings, commercial garages, leased lands, retail stores, mixed-use developments and urban transit-oriented development. The Real Estate Services segment provides real estate services in the areas of strategic corporate planning, capital markets, brokerage services, environmental and design-based services. Its environmental services group provides consulting and engineering services, environmental studies, remediation services and provides site specific solutions for any project that may have an environmental impact, from environmental due diligence to site-specific assessments and remediation. The company was founded by Christopher Clemente in 1985 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: Comstock Holding Cos., Inc.從事房地產開發和提供資產管理服務。它透過以下部門運作：資產管理和房地產服務。資產管理部門為房地產資產和業務提供管理服務，其中包括商業房地產用途，包括公寓、飯店、辦公大樓、商業車庫、租賃土地、零售店、混合用途開發和城市交通導向開發。房地產服務部門提供企業策略規劃、資本市場、經紀服務、環境和設計服務等領域的房地產服務。其環境服務團隊提供諮詢和工程服務、環境研究、修復服務，並為任何可能對環境產生影響的項目提供特定地點的解決方案，從環境盡職調查到特定地點的評估和修復。該公司由 Christopher Clemente 於 1985 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. is a blockchain-native capital marketplace, which engages in connecting origination, funding, and secondary market activity. It operates through the following segments: FTI, Markets, and Other. The FTI segment offers Figure Connect which generates ecosystem and technology fees, and originates, sells, and securitizes home equity line of credit (HELOC) loans that it services. The Markets segment utilizes blockchain technology to develop an exchange for digital assets and credit, with new product offerings including providing interest-bearing stable coin deposits. The company was founded by Michael Scott Cagney and June Ou in 2018 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. 是一個區塊鏈原生資本市場，致力於連結發起、融資和二級市場活動。它透過以下部門運作：FTI、市場和其他部門。 FTI 部門提供Figure Connect，該產品產生生態系統和技術費用，並發起、銷售和證券化其服務的房屋淨值信貸額度 (HELOC) 貸款。市場部門利用區塊鏈技術開發數位資產和信用交易，提供新產品，包括提供計息穩定幣存款。該公司由 Michael Scott Cagney 和 June Ou 於 2018 年創立，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Kura Oncology, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research and development of medicines for the treatment of cancer. Its pipeline includes Tipifarnib, which is a Farnesyl transferase inhibitor for HRAS Mutant Solid Tumors, Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia, KO-947, which is an ERK inhibitor for MAPK Pathway Tumors, and KO-539, which is a Menin MLL inhibitor for acute leukemias. The company was founded by Troy E. Wilson, Yi Liu, Pingda Ren and Antonio Gualberto on August 22, 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Kura Oncology, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事癌症治療藥物的研究和開發。其管道包括Tipifarnib（一種針對HRAS突變實體瘤、慢性粒單核細胞白血病的法尼基轉移酶抑制劑）、KO-947（針對MAPK通路腫瘤的ERK抑制劑）和KO-539（針對急性白血病的Menin MLL抑制劑）。該公司由 Troy E. Wilson、Yi Liu、Pingda Ren 和 Antonio Gualberto 於 2014 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. develops drugs for clinical treatment. Its unique precision medicine platform is Acrivon Predictive Precision Proteomics (AP3). AP3 is used to generate proprietary OncoSignature companion diagnostics to identify patients who will benefit from the medicine. The company was founded by Peter Blume-Jensen and Kristina Masson in 2018 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. 開發用於臨床治療的藥物。其獨特的精準醫學平台為 Acrivon Predictive Precision Proteomics (AP3)。 AP3 用於產生專有的 OncoSignature 伴隨診斷，以識別將從該藥物中受益的患者。該公司由 Peter Blume-Jensen 和 Kristina Masson 於 2018 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Caesarstone Ltd. operates as a multi material designer, producer and reseller of countertops used in residential and commercial buildings globally. It designs, develops, produces and source engineered quartz, natural stone and porcelain products that offer aesthetic appeal and functionality through a distinct variety of colors, styles, textures, and finishes used primarily as countertops, vanities, and other interior and exterior spaces. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Haifa, Israel.
info.description_zh: Caesarstone Ltd. 是一家多材料設計商、生產商和經銷商，產品用於全球住宅和商業建築的檯面。它設計、開發、生產和採購工程石英、天然石材和瓷器產品，這些產品透過獨特的各種顏色、款式、紋理和飾面提供美學吸引力和功能性，主要用作檯面、梳妝台和其他內部和外部空間。該公司成立於1987年，總部位於以色列海法。

info.description: Immix Biopharma, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company that engages in the development of therapies for cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Ilya Rachman, Sean Senn, and Vladimir Torchilin in 2012 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Immix Biopharma, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症和發炎性疾病療法的開發。該公司由 Ilya Rachman、Sean Senn 和 Vladimir Torchilin 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Zymeworks, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of novel, multifunctional biotherapeutics. Its product includes Zanidatamab, which is a novel bispecific antibody that targets two distinct domains of the human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2). Zanidatamab's unique binding properties result in multiple mechanisms of action that may enable it to address unmet need in patient populations with HER2-expressing cancers. The company was founded on September 8, 2003 and is headquartered in Middletown, DE.
info.description_zh: Zymeworks, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於新型多功能生物治療藥物的發現、開發和商業化。其產品包括 Zanidatamab，這是一種新型雙特異性抗體，針對人類表皮生長因子受體 2 (HER2) 的兩個不同結構域。 Zanidatamab 獨特的結合特性產生多種作用機制，可能使其能夠解決表達 HER2 的癌症患者群體中未滿足的需求。該公司成立於2003年9月8日，總部位於德拉瓦州米德爾敦。

info.description: Calumet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, formulation, and sale of specialty branded products and renewable fuel. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Products and Solutions, Montana/Renewables, Performance Brands, and Corporate. The Specialty Products & Solutions segment consists of customer-focused solutions and formulation businesses. The Montana/Renewables segment is composed of a Great Falls specialty asphalt facility and Montana Renewables facility. The Performance Brands segment includes Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel. The Corporate segment focuses on the general and administrative expenses not allocated to other segments. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: Calumet, Inc. 從事專業品牌產品和再生燃料的製造、配​​製和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：特種產品和解決方案部門、蒙大拿州/再生能源部門、績效品牌部門和企業部門。特種產品和解決方案部門包括以客戶為中心的解決方案和配方業務。蒙大拿州/再生能源部門由大瀑布特種瀝青設施和蒙大拿州再生能源設施組成。性能品牌部門包括 Royal Purple、Bel-Ray 和 TruFuel。公司部門專注於未分配給其他部門的一般和管理費用。該公司成立於 1919 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: Assembly Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company that focuses on developing small molecule antiviral therapeutics for serious viral diseases. Its lead programs, ABI-5366 and ABI-1179, long-acting helicase-primase inhibitors, are in clinical development for recurrent genital herpes. The company is partnered with Gilead Sciences to advance current and future antiviral programs across herpesviruses, HBV, and HDV. Assembly Biosciences was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Assembly Biosciences, Inc. 是一家生物技術公司，專注於開發針對嚴重病毒性疾病的小分子抗病毒療法。其主導計畫 ABI-5366 和 ABI-1179 是長效解旋酶引子酶抑制劑，目前正處於治療復發性生殖器皰疹的臨床開發階段。該公司與吉利德科學公司合作，推動目前和未來的皰疹病毒、乙型肝炎病毒和丁型肝炎病毒的抗病毒計畫。 Assembly Biosciences 成立於 2005 年，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BULL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BULL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BULL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BULL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 BULL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BULL 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kolibri Global Energy, Inc. is an international energy company, which focuses on finding and exploiting energy projects in oil, gas, and clean energy. It operates through the United States, and Canada and Other geographical segments. The company was founded on May 26, 2008 and is headquartered in Newbury Park, CA.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Kolibri Global Energy, Inc.是一家國際能源公司，專注於尋找和開發石油、天然氣和清潔能源領域的能源專案。它透過美國、加拿大和其他地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於2008年5月26日，總部位於加州紐伯里公園。

info.description: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of global maritime shipping services through its subsidiaries. Its services include time chartering and vessel management. The company was founded on July 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司提供全球海運服務。其服务包括期租和船舶管理。該公司成立於2023年7月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Roadzen, Inc. operates as an insurance technology company. It offers auto insurance services through artificial intelligence technology. The company was founded by Rohan Malhotra on May 7, 2015 and is headquartered in Burlingame, CA.
info.description_zh: Roadzen, Inc. 是一家保險科技公司。它透過人工智慧技術提供汽車保險服務。該公司由 Rohan Malhotra 於 2015 年 5 月 7 日創立，總部位於加州伯林格姆。

info.description: Atlas Critical Minerals Corp. is a mineral exploration company, which focuses on minerals projects and properties in Brazil. The firm also operates an iron ore mine Its portfolio includes mineral properties for rare earths, graphite, uranium, titanium, copper, nickel, iron ore, gold, and quartzite. The company was founded by Marc Fogassa on July 27, 2016 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
info.description_zh: Atlas Critical Minerals Corp. 是一家礦產勘探公司，專注於巴西的礦產項目和房地產。該公司還經營一座鐵礦，其投資組合包括稀土、石墨、鈾、鈦、銅、鎳、鐵礦石、金和石英岩的礦產。該公司由Marc Fogassa於2016年7月27日創立，總部位於巴西貝洛奧裡藏特。

info.description: SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc. engages in management services and products to cosmetic treatment centers. The company was founded on January 20, 2023 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: SBC Medical Group Holdings, Inc. 從事美容治療中心的管理服務和產品。該公司成立於2023年1月20日，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Mesa Laboratories, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and market of instruments and disposable products utilized in healthcare, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, medical device, and petrochemical industries. It operates through the following segments: Sterilization and Disinfection Control, Clinical Genomics, Biopharmaceutical Development, and Calibration Solutions. The Sterilization and Disinfection Control segment manufactures and sells biological, cleaning, and chemical indicators. The Clinical Genomics segment division develops, manufactures and sells highly sensitive, low-cost, high-throughput genetic analysis tools and related consumables and services that enable clinical research labs and contract research organizations. The Biopharmaceutical Development segment caters and sells automated systems for protein analysis and peptide synthesis solutions. The Calibration Solutions segment focuses on the quality control products using principles of advanced metrology to enable customers to measure and calibrate critical parameters in applications such as renal care, environmental and process monitoring, gas flow, air quality and torque testing, primarily in medical device manufacturing, pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory and hospital environments. The company was founded by Luke R. Schmieder on March 26, 1982 and is headquartered in Lakewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Mesa Laboratories, Inc. 從事醫療保健、製藥、食品和飲料、醫療器材和石化行業所用儀器和一次性產品的設計、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：滅菌和消毒控制、臨床基因組學、生物製藥開發和校準解決方案。滅菌和消毒控制部門生產和銷售生物、清潔和化學指示器。臨床基因組學部門開發、製造和銷售高靈敏度、低成本、高通量的基因分析工具以及相關耗材和服務，為臨床研究實驗室和合約研究組織提供支援。生物製藥開發部門提供和銷售用於蛋白質分析和勝肽合成解決方案的自動化系統。校準解決方案部門專注於使用先進計量原理的品質控制產品，使客戶能夠測量和校準腎臟護理、環境和過程監測、氣流、空氣品質和扭矩測試等應用中的關鍵參數，主要在醫療器械製造、藥品製造、實驗室和醫院環境中。該公司由 Luke R. Schmieder 於 1982 年 3 月 26 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州萊克伍德。

info.description: BitVentures Ltd. is a technology company that develops early-stage technology businesses. The company is actively developing technology ventures across verticals including e-commerce, digital assets, and other areas of consumer and enterprise technology. It also provides client referral services to external financial product partners and offers a range of insurance products, including life insurance products such as individual whole life, term life, health insurance, and universal life insurance; annuity insurance products; and critical illness insurance products, including personal accident insurance products. The company was founded by Hongwei Han in July 19, 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: BitVentures Ltd. 是一家開發早期技術業務的技術公司。該公司正在積極開發跨垂直行業的技術企業，包括電子商務、數位資產以及消費者和企業技術的其他領域。它還為外部金融產品合作夥伴提供客戶推薦服務，並提供一系列保險產品，包括個人終身壽險、定期壽險、健康險、萬能壽險等壽險產品；年金保險產品；重大疾病保險產品，包括人身意外傷害保險產品。該公司由韓宏偉於2019年7月19日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Direxion Daily NFLX Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of NFLX. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of NFLX and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to NFLX, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily NFLX Bull 2X Shares 寻求 NFLX 每日业绩的 200% 的每日投资结果（扣除费用和开支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NFLX 的證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 NFLX 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. engages in the research and development of engineered cells as medicine. It focuses on identifying and developing potential product candidates, executing preclinical studies, and acquiring technology. The company was founded by Steven D. Harr, Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert Taylor Nelsen, and Hans Edgar Bishop on July 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 從事工程細胞藥物的研究和開發。它專注於識別和開發潛在的候選產品、執行臨床前研究以及獲取技術。該公司由 Steven D. Harr、Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert Taylor Nelsen 和 Hans Edgar Bishop 於 2018 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing and commercializing products across a range of therapies. Its products include Gvoke, Keveyis, and Recorlev. Gvoke is a ready-to-use liquid glucagon for the treatment of severe hypoglycemia. Keveyis is the therapy approved in the United States to treat hyperkalemic, hypokalemic, and related variants of primary periodic paralysis (PPP). Recorlev is a cortisol synthesis inhibitor approved for the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolemia in adult patients with Cushing's syndrome. The company was founded by Steven Prestrelski in 2005 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化一系列療法的產品。其產品包括 Gvoke、Keveyis 和 Recorlev。 Gvoke 是一種即用型液體胰高血糖素，用於治療嚴重低血糖。 Keveyis 是美國核准用於治療高血鉀、低血鉀和原發性週期性麻痺 (PPP) 相關變異的療法。 Recorlev 是一種皮質醇合成抑制劑，被批准用於治療患有庫欣氏症候群的成人患者的內源性高皮質醇血症。該公司由 Steven Prestrelski 於 2005 年創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: H World Group Ltd. engages in the operation of hotels. It operates through the Legacy Huazhu and Legacy DH segments. The company was founded by Qi Ji, Jiong Wu, and Tong Tong Zhao on January 4, 2007, and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: H World Group Ltd.從事旅館經營業務。它透過Legacy Huazhu 和Legacy DH 部門運作。該公司由季奇、吳炯和趙童童於2007年1月4日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Ovid Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to pioneering better, gentler medicines for the brain. It discovers and develops differentiated, small molecule medicines for neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders with significant unmet need. The company was founded by Matthew During and Jeremy M. Levin on April 1, 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Ovid Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發更好、更溫和的大腦藥物。它發現和開發差異化的小分子藥物，用於治療尚未滿足重大需求的神經系統和神經精神疾病。該公司由 Matthew Dur 和 Jeremy M. Levin 於 2014 年 4 月 1 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Immuneering Corp. operates as a clinical-stage oncology company, which engages in developing medicines for cancer patients. Its pipeline of drug candidates focuses on treating aspects of disease that have eluded conventional approaches, including cancer cachexia and metastasis. The company was founded by Robert J. Carpenter and Benjamin J. Zeskind in 2008 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Immuneering Corp. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於為癌症患者開發藥物。其候選藥物的研發重點是治療傳統方法無法解決的疾病，包括癌症惡病質和轉移。該公司由 Robert J. Carpenter 和 Benjamin J. Zeskind 於 2008 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Atrium Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company that provides RNA therapeutics services to the heart to transform the standard of care for people living with cardiomyopathies. Its products pipeline includes two lead development candidates: ATR 1072 for PRKAG2 syndrome and ATR 1086 for PLN cardiomyopathy, both conditions are severe, life-threatening, rare autosomal dominant progressive cardiomyopathies with no approved treatment options and high unmet need. The company was founded on September 30, 2025 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Atrium Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，為心臟提供 RNA 治療服務，以改變心肌病變患者的護理標準。其產品線包括兩種主要開發候選藥物：用於 PRKAG2 綜合徵的 ATR 1072 和用於 PLN 心肌病變的 ATR 1086，這兩種情況都是嚴重的、危及生命的、罕見的常染色體顯性進行性心肌病，沒有批准的治療方案，且需求未得到滿足。該公司成立於2025年9月30日，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Immunic, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which develops a pipeline of selective oral immunology therapies aimed at treating chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, and psoriasis. The firm's products include IMU-838, IMU-935, and IMU-856. The company was founded in May 2003 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Immunic, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，開發一系列旨在治療慢性發炎和自體免疫疾病的選擇性口服免疫療法。它的重點是潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症、復發緩解型多發性硬化症和牛皮癬。該公司的產品包括 IMU-838、IMU-935 和 IMU-856。該公司成立於2003年5月，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Dorchester Minerals LP engages in the acquisition, ownership, and administration of royalty properties and net profits interests (NPI). The NPI represents a net profits overriding royalty interest burdening various properties owned by its operating partnership. Royalty properties consist of producing and nonproducing mineral, royalty, overriding royalty, net profits, and leasehold interests. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Dorchester Minerals LP 從事特許權使用費和淨利潤權益 (NPI) 的收購、所有權和管理業務。 NPI 代表淨利潤高於其營運合夥企業擁有的各種財產的特許權使用費利息。特許權使用費財產包括生產性和非生產性礦物、特許權使用費、首要特許權使用費、淨利潤和租賃權益。該公司成立於 1982 年，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Eton Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development, acquisition, and commercialization of prescription drug products. Its products include Biorphen, Alaway Preservative Free, zonisamide oral suspension, topiramate oral suspension, lamotrigine for oral suspension, cysteine injection, and ephedrine ready-to-use injection. The company was founded in April 2017 and is headquartered in Deer Park, IL.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Eton Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development, acquisition, and commercialization of prescription drug products.其产品包括Biorphen、Alaway Free Preservative Free、唑尼沙胺口服混悬液、托吡酯口服混悬液、拉莫三嗪口服混悬液、半胱氨酸注射液、麻黄碱即用注射液。 The company was founded in April 2017 and is headquartered in Deer Park, IL.

info.description: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. engages in the operation of retail stores in the United States. It offers name-brand consumables and fresh products through a network of independently operated stores. The company was founded by Jim Read in 1946 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. 在美國從事零售店經營。它透過獨立經營的商店網路提供名牌消費品和新鮮產品。該公司由 Jim Read 於 1946 年創立，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: ProQR Therapeutics NV is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of RNA therapies for the treatment of severe genetic rare diseases with a focus on inherited retinal diseases. The company was founded by Daniel Anton de Boer, Gerard J. Platenburg, Henri A. Termeer, and Domenico Valerio on February 21, 2012, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ProQR Therapeutics NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開髮用於治療嚴重遺傳性罕見疾病（尤其是遺傳性視網膜疾病）的 RNA 療法。該公司由 Daniel Anton de Boer、Gerard J. Platenburg、Henri A. Termeer 和 Domenico Valerio 於 2012 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於荷蘭萊頓。

info.description: Invesco Optimum Yield Diversified Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the world's most heavily traded commodities. Commodities are assets that have tangible properties, such as oil, agricultural produce or raw metals.
info.description_zh: 景順最佳收益多元化商品策略No K-1 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資與全球交易最頻繁的商品經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。商品是具有有形財產的資產，例如石油、農產品或原料金屬。

info.description: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves. It operates through the Upstream and Midstream Services segments. The Upstream segment focuses on the Permian Basin operations in West Texas. The Midstream Services segment is involved in the Midland and Delaware Basins. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves.它透過上游和中游服務部門運作。上游部門專注於德克薩斯州西部的二疊紀盆地業務。中游服務部門涉及米德蘭和特拉華盆地。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company developing MasterKey therapies that target families of oncogenic mutations in patients with cancer. The company's MasterKey therapies are designed to address a broad spectrum of genetically defined tumors, overcome resistance, minimize wild-type-mediated toxicities, and be brain-penetrant to treat central nervous system diseases. It is currently focused on advancing a Phase 2 NSCLC trial of BDTX-1535, a brain-penetrant, fourth-generation epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) MasterKey inhibitor targeting EGFR-mutant NSCLC and glioblastoma. The company was founded by David M. Epstein and Elizabeth Buck in 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤學公司，開發針對癌症患者致癌突變家族的 MasterKey 療法。該公司的 MasterKey 療法旨在解決廣泛的基因定義的腫瘤，克服抗藥性，最大限度地減少野生型介導的毒性，並具有腦滲透性以治療中樞神經系統疾病。該公司目前專注於推進 BDTX-1535 的 2 期 NSCLC 試驗，BDTX-1535 是一種針對 EGFR 突變 NSCLC 和膠質母細胞瘤的腦滲透性第四代表皮生長因子受體 (EGFR) MasterKey 抑制劑。該公司由 David M. Epstein 和 Elizabeth Buck 於 2014 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Compass Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of proprietary antibody therapeutics. Its platform includes common light chain-focused antibody discovery, human display for antibody tuning, stitchmabs, and highly modular and manufacturable bispecific candidates. The company was founded by Thomas J. Schuetz in 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Compass Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事專有抗體療法的開發。其平台包括常見的以輕鏈為中心的抗體發現、用於抗體調整的人體展示、縫合抗體以及高度模組化和可製造的雙特異性候選物。該公司由 Thomas J. Schuetz 於 2014 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: AT&T, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of telecommunications and technology services. It operates through the Communications and Latin America segments. The Communications segment offers wireless, wireline telecom, and broadband services to businesses and consumers located in the US and businesses globally. The Latin America segment provides wireless services and equipment in Mexico. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: AT&T, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供電信和技術服務。它透過通訊和拉丁美洲部門運作。通訊部門為美國和全球的企業和消費者提供無線、有線電信和寬頻服務。拉丁美洲部門在墨西哥提供無線服務和設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Scholar Rock Holding Corp. is a biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the business of discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines for the treatment of serious diseases in which signaling by protein growth factors plays a fundamental role. The company was founded by Timothy A. Springer and Leonard I. Zon in October 2012 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: 學者石控股公司是一家生物製藥公司。該公司從事發現、開發和提供用於治療嚴重疾病的創新藥物的業務，其中蛋白質生長因子的信號傳導發揮基礎作用。該公司由 Timothy A. Springer 和 Leonard I. Zon 於 2012 年 10 月創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Oramed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the provision of oral delivery solutions for drugs delivered via injection. It concentrates on the research and development of pharmaceutical solutions, including an oral insulin capsule to be used for the treatment of individuals with diabetes, and the use of orally ingestible capsules or pills for delivery of other polypeptides. The company was founded by Nadav Kidron and Miriam Kidron on April 12, 2002 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Oramed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 致力於為注射藥物提供口服給藥解決方案。它專注於藥物解決方案的研究和開發，包括用於治療糖尿病患者的口服胰島素膠囊，以及使用口服膠囊或藥丸來輸送其他多肽。該公司由 Nadav Kidron 和 Miriam Kidron 於 2002 年 4 月 12 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Castor Maritime, Inc. engages in the provision of shipping transportation services. It operates through the following segments: Dry Bulk, Containership, and Asset Management. The Dry Bulk segment provides dry bulk commodities transportation services. The Containership segment provides cargo transportation services. The Asset Management segment focuses on the activities of the subsidiary MPC Capital, an internationally active manager and provider of services for investment projects in maritime and energy infrastructure. The company was founded by Petros Panagiotidis on September 12, 2017 and is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.
info.description_zh: Castor Maritime, Inc. 從事提供船舶運輸服務。它透過以下部門運作：幹散貨部門、貨櫃船部門和資產管理部門。乾散貨部門提供乾散貨商品運輸服務。貨櫃船部門提供貨物運輸服務。資產管理部門專注於子公司 MPC Capital 的活動，該公司是一家國際活躍的海事和能源基礎設施投資專案管理人和服務提供者。該公司由Petros Panagiotidis於2017年9月12日創立，總部位於塞浦路斯利馬索爾。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Texas ETF is an actively managed equity fund focused on long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in stocks of companies operating in the oil, gas & consumable fuels industry and the energy equipment & services sectors, across a diversified range of market capitalizations. The investment strategy combines fundamental, value-oriented research with selective growth opportunities to identify companies expected to benefit directly or indirectly from expanding economic opportunities within the State of Texas. The fund targets businesses positioned to capitalize on Texas-specific advantages, including energy sector strength, favorable regulatory conditions, and sustained demographic and economic growth.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Texas ETF 是一檔專注於長期資本增值的主動管理股票基金。該基金主要投資於石油、天然氣和消耗性燃料產業以及能源設備和服務業的公司股票，其市值範圍多元化。該投資策略將基礎性的、以價值為導向的研究與選擇性成長機會相結合，以確定預計將直接或間接受益於德州不斷擴大的經濟機會的公司。該基金的目標是那些能夠利用德州特有優勢的企業，包括能源產業的實力、有利的監管條件以及持續的人口和經濟成長。

info.description: The Hershey Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of chocolate, sweets, mints and confectionery products. The firm operates through the following segments: North America Confectionery, North America Salty Snacks and International. The North America Confectionery segment is responsible for the traditional chocolate and non-chocolate confectionery market position of the company, as well as its grocery and snacks market positions, in the United States and Canada. The North America Salty Snacks segment is responsible for the salty snack products in the United States. The International segment includes the combination of all other operating segments, including those geographic regions where the company operates outside of North America. Its brands include Hershey's, Reese's, and Kisses. The company was founded by Milton S. Hershey in 1894 and is headquartered in Hershey, PA.
info.description_zh: 好時公司從事巧克力、糖果、薄荷糖和糖果產品的製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門營運：北美糖果部門、北美鹹味零食部門和國際部門。北美糖果部門負責公司在美國和加拿大的傳統巧克力和非巧克力糖果市場地位，以及雜貨和零食市場地位。北美鹹味零食部門負責美國的鹹味零食產品。國際部門包括所有其他營運部門的組合，包括公司在北美以外營運的地理區域。其品牌包括 Hershey's、Reese's 和 Kisses。該公司由 Milton S. Hershey 於 1894 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州好時市。

info.description: CoStar Group, Inc. engages in the provision of online real estate marketplaces, information, and analytics in the commercial and residential property markets. It operates through the following segments: CoStar Portfolio, Information Services Portfolio, Multifamily Portfolio, LoopNet Portfolio, and Other Marketplaces Portfolio. The CoStar Portfolio segment consists of two classes of trade receivables based on geographical location: North America and International. The Information Services Portfolio segment includes four classes of trade receivables: CoStar Real Estate Manager, Hospitality, North America, Hospitality, International, and other Information Services. The Multifamily Portfolio, LoopNet Portfolio, and Other Marketplaces Portfolio segments focus on one class of trade receivables. The company was founded by Andrew C. Florance and Michael R. Klein in 1987 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: CoStar Group, Inc. 致力於在商業和住宅房地產市場提供線上房地產市場、資訊和分析。該公司透過以下部門營運：CoStar Portfolio、Information Services Portfolio、Multifamily Portfolio、LoopNet Portfolio 和 Other Marketplaces Portfolio。 CoStar Portfolio 部門根據地理位置由兩類貿易應收帳款組成：北美和國際。資訊服務組合部門包括四類貿易應收帳款：CoStar 房地產經理、飯店、北美、飯店、國際和其他資訊服務。多戶型投資組合、LoopNet 投資組合和其他市場投資組合細分市場則專注於一類貿易應收款。該公司由 Andrew C. Florance 和 Michael R. Klein 於 1987 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond to the price and yield of an index called the Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its net assets in the ETFs that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs that the index determines offer the greatest potential to outperform the other First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF 尋求與名為 Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM 指數的指數的價格和收益率相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的 ETF。該指數旨在提供對 5 個 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的有針對性的投資，該指數認為這些 ETF 具有超越其他 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a Major League Baseball (MLB) club. It operates through the Baseball and Mixed-Use Development segments. The Baseball segment includes its operations relating to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park and includes revenue generated from ticket sales, concessions, local broadcasting rights, advertising sponsorships, suites, and premium seat fees, retail and licensing revenue, shared MLB revenue streams, including national broadcasting rights and licensing, and other sources. Ticket sales, concessions, broadcasting rights and advertising sponsorship sales are the baseball segment's primary revenue drivers. The Mixed-Use Development segment includes retail, office, hotel and entertainment operations within The Battery Atlanta. The Battery Atlanta derives revenue primarily from office and retail rental income including overage rent and tenant reimbursements and, to a lesser extent, parking and advertising sponsorships. The company was founded on December 7, 2022 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 亞特蘭大勇士控股公司 (Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.) 擁有並經營美國職棒大聯盟 (MLB) 俱樂部。它透過棒球和混合用途開發部門運作。棒球部门包括与勇敢者棒球特许经营权和Truist Park相关的业务，包括门票销售、特许权、当地广播权、广告赞助、套房和高级座位费、零售和许可收入、共享MLB收入流（包括国家广播权和许可）以及其他来源产生的收入。門票銷售、優惠、轉播權和廣告贊助銷售是棒球業務的主要收入來源。混合用途開發部門包括亞特蘭大砲台內的零售、辦公室、飯店和娛樂業務。亚特兰大炮台的收入主要来自办公室和零售租金收入，包括超额租金和租户报销，以及较小程度的停车和广告赞助。該公司成立於2022年12月7日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Freenome, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company. It engages in the development of an early cancer detection platform. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Freenome, Inc. 是一家生技公司。它從事早期癌症檢測平台的開發。該公司成立於2014年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: CorMedix, Inc. is a pharmaceutical and medical device company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutic products for the prevention and treatment of diseases and conditions. The company was founded by Antony E. Pfaffle on July 28, 2006 and is headquartered in Berkeley Heights, NJ.
info.description_zh: CorMedix, Inc.是一家製藥和醫療器材公司，致力於預防和治療疾病和病症的治療產品的開發和商業化。該公司由 Antony E. Pfaffle 於 2006 年 7 月 28 日創立，總部位於新澤西州 Berkeley Heights。

info.description: Bionano Genomics, Inc. is a life sciences instrumentation company, which focuses on the genome analysis space. The firm engages in the development and marketing of the Saphyr system, a platform for ultra-sensitive and ultra-specific structural variation detection that enables researchers and clinicians to accelerate the search for new diagnostics and therapeutic targets and to streamline cytogenetics. Its products include Saphyr, Bionano Chips, Bionano Prep Kits, and Bionano Data Solutions. The company was founded by Han Cao in January 2003 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Bionano Genomics, Inc. 是一家生命科學儀器公司，專注於基因組分析領域。該公司從事 Saphyr 系統的開發和行銷，該系統是一個超靈敏和超特異性結構變異檢測平台，使研究人員和臨床醫生能夠加速尋找新的診斷和治療標靶並簡化細胞遺傳學。其產品包括 Saphyr、Bionano 晶片、Bionano 製備套件和 Bionano 數據解決方案。該公司由曹韓於2003年1月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM"), the investment adviser to the fund, seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing the fund's assets based on a model portfolio provided by Bridgewater Associates, LP (the "Sub-Adviser" or "Bridgewater"), the investment sub-adviser to the fund.
info.description_zh: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。 SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（下稱「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）是該基金的投資顧問，旨在透過根據該基金的投資副顧問 Bridgewater Associates, LP（下稱「副顧問」或「Bridgewater」）提供的模型投資組合來投資基金資產，從而實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: Swarmer, Inc. is an AI-driven software company, which develops software platforms and AI systems for autonomous swarm control of drones and unmanned vehicles. The firm offers STYX AI Command and Control System, MINAS Autonomy and Collaboration AI, and TRIDENT Embedded Drone Operating System. The company was founded by Alex Fink and Serhii Kuprienko in May 2023 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Swarmer, Inc. 是一家由人工智慧驅動的軟體公司，開發用於無人機和無人駕駛車輛自主群體控制的軟體平台和人工智慧系統。該公司提供 STYX 人工智慧命令和控制系統、MINAS 自主和協作人工智慧以及 TRIDENT 嵌入式無人機作業系統。該公司由 Alex Fink 和 Serhii Kuprienko 於 2023 年 5 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Absci Corp. is the drug and target discovery company harnessing deep learning AI and synthetic biology to expand the therapeutic potential of proteins. It partners with pharma and biotech innovators to create the next generation of protein-based drugs. The company was founded by Sean McClain in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Absci Corp. 是一家藥物和標靶發現公司，利用深度學習人工智慧和合成生物學來擴大蛋白質的治療潛力。它與製藥和生物技術創新者合作，創造下一代基於蛋白質的藥物。該公司由 Sean McClain 於 2011 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: ONEOK, Inc. engages in gathering, processing, fractionating, transporting, storing and marketing of natural gas. It operates through the following segments: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing, Natural Gas Liquids, Natural Gas Pipelines, and Refined Products and Crude. The Natural Gas Gathering and Processing segment offers midstream services to producers in North Dakota, Montana, Wyoming, Kansas and Oklahoma. The Natural Gas Liquids segment owns and operates facilities that gather, fractionate, treat and distribute NGLs and store NGL products in Oklahoma, Kansas, Texas, New Mexico, and the Rocky Mountain region, which includes the Williston, Powder River and DJ Basins, where it provides midstream services to producers of NGLs and delivers those products to the two market centers, one in the Mid-Continent in Conway, Kansas and the other in the Gulf Coast in Mont Belvieu, Texas. The Natural Gas Pipelines segment provides transportation and storage services to end users. The Refined Products and Crude segment engages in the transportation, storage and distribution of Refined Products and crude oil. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.
info.description_zh: ONEOK, Inc. 從事天然氣的收集、加工、分餾、運輸、儲存和行銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：天然氣收集和加工部門、液化天然氣部門、天然氣管道部門以及成品油和原油部門。天然氣收集和加工部門為北達科他州、蒙大拿州、懷俄明州、堪薩斯州和俄克拉荷馬州的生產商提供中游服務。液化天然氣部門在俄克拉荷馬州、堪薩斯州、德克薩斯州、新墨西哥州和落基山地區（包括威利斯頓盆地、粉河盆地和DJ盆地）擁有並經營收集、分餾、處理和分銷液化天然氣以及儲存液化天然氣產品的設施，在這些地區為液化天然氣生產商提供中游服務，並將這些產品運送到兩個市場中心，一個位於堪薩斯州康威的中大陸，另一個位於堪薩斯州康威的天然氣管道部門為最終用戶提供運輸和儲存服務。成品油和原油部門從事成品油和原油的運輸、儲存和分銷。該公司成立於 1906 年，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州塔爾薩。

info.description: Versamet Royalties Corp. engages in the business of acquiring and managing royalties, streams, and other similar interests on metals and mining operations and projects globally. It focuses on precious metals, copper, and other diversified metals. Its portfolio includes the Kolpa, Kiaka, and Greenstone projects. The company was founded on January 31, 2022 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Versamet Royalties Corp. 從事收購和管理全球金屬和採礦業務及專案的特許權使用費、資源和其他類似權益的業務。它專注於貴金屬、銅和其他多元化金屬。其投資組合包括 Kolpa、Kiaka 和 Greenstone 項目。該公司成立於2022年1月31日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Nuveen US Infrastructure ETF is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth and income by investing in equity securities issued by U.S.-focused infrastructure-related companies that own or operate vital structures, facilities, and services. The strategy utilizes a fundamental selection process focusing on long-term service contracts, identifiable near-term catalysts, and stable cash flows while maintaining the flexibility to incorporate common stock, preferred securities, master limited partnerships (MLPs), real estate investment trusts (REITs), and risk-management derivatives.
info.description_zh: Nuveen US 基礎設施 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過投資於擁有或經營重要結構、設施和服務的美國基礎設施相關公司發行的股本證券，實現長期資本成長和收入。該策略採用基本選擇流程，重點關注長期服務合約、可識別的近期催化劑和穩定的現金流，同時保持納入普通股、優先證券、主有限合夥企業（MLP）、房地產投資信託（REIT）和風險管理衍生品的靈活性。

info.description: Alpha Architect High Inflation And Deflation ETF seeks long-term total return. The fund primarily invests its assets in the shares of registered investment companies, including affiliated and non-affiliated ETFs, that emphasize investments in (i) intermediate-term U.S. Treasury bonds; (ii) real estate; and (iii) commodities. The Advisor expects to obtain its exposure to the Target Asset Classes primarily through its investments in underlying funds, but the fund also may invest directly in equity interests in real estate investment trusts (REITs) and in intermediate-term U.S. Treasury bonds. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 高通膨和通貨緊縮 ETF 尋求長期總回報。該基金主要將其資產投資於註冊投資公司的股票，包括附屬和非附屬ETF，重點投資於(i) 中期美國國債； (ii) 房地產； (iii) 商品。顧問預計主要透過對基礎基金的投資來獲得對目標資產類別的投資，但該基金也可能直接投資於房地產投資信託基金 (REIT) 和中期美國國債的股權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: NovaBridge Biosciences operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of novel or differentiated biologics to treat diseases with unmet medical needs, particularly cancers and autoimmune disorders. The company was founded by Jingwu Zang on June 30, 2016 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: NovaBridge Biosciences 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於新型或差異化生物製劑的開發和商業化，以治療醫療需求未被滿足的疾病，特別是癌症和自體免疫疾病。該公司由臧經武於2016年6月30日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Golar LNG Ltd. engages in owning and operating liquefied natural gas carriers, floating storage, and regasification units. It operates through the Floating Liquefaction Natural Gas (FLNG), and Corporate and Other segments. The FLNG segment includes the operations of FLNG vessels and projects. The Corporate and Other segment focuses on shipping segment activities, vessel management, floating storage, and regasification unit services for third parties. The company was founded on May 10, 2001 and is headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda.
info.description_zh: Golar LNG Ltd. 從事擁有和經營液化天然氣運輸船、浮動儲存和再氣化裝置。它透過浮動液化天然氣（FLNG）以及企業和其他部門運作。 FLNG部門包括FLNG船舶和項目的運作。本公司及其他部門專注於航運部門活動、船舶管理、浮式儲存以及為第三方提供的再氣化裝置服務。該公司成立於2001年5月10日，總部位於百慕達漢密爾頓。

info.description: Walmart, Inc. engages in the retail and wholesale business. The company offers an assortment of merchandise and services at everyday low prices. It operates through the following segments: Walmart U.S., Walmart International, and Sam's Club U.S. The Walmart U.S. segment operates as a mass merchandiser of consumer products, operating under the Walmart and Walmart Neighborhood Market brands, including walmart.com. The Walmart International segment includes operations of wholly-owned subsidiaries in Canada, Chile, China, and Africa, and majority-owned subsidiaries in India, as well as Mexico and Central America. The Sam's Club U.S. segment manages membership-only warehouse clubs and operates samsclub.com. The company was founded by Samuel Moore Walton and James Lawrence Walton on July 2, 1962 and is headquartered in Bentonville, AR.
info.description_zh: 沃爾瑪公司從事零售和批發業務。該公司以每日低價提供各種商品和服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：沃爾瑪美國部門、沃爾瑪國際部門和山姆會員店美國部門。沃爾瑪美國部門作為消費品的大型銷售商運營，以沃爾瑪和沃爾瑪鄰里市場品牌運營，包括walmart.com。沃爾瑪國際部門包括在加拿大、智利、中國和非洲的全資子公司以及在印度、墨西哥和中美洲的控股子公司。山姆會員店美國分會管理會員制倉儲俱樂部並經營 samsclub.com。該公司由塞繆爾·摩爾·沃爾頓 (Samuel Moore Walton) 和詹姆斯·勞倫斯·沃爾頓 (James Lawrence Walton) 於 1962 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於阿肯色州本頓維爾。

info.description: Abony Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Abony Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月13日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Churchill Downs, Inc. is a provider of pari-mutuel horse racing, online account wagering on horse racing and casino gaming. It operates through the following segments: Live and Historical Racing, Wagering Services and Solutions, and Gaming. The Live and Historical Racing segment includes live and historical pari-mutuel racing related revenue and expenses at Churchill Downs Racetrack and historical racing properties in Kentucky, Virginia, and New Hampshire. The Wagering Services and Solutions focuses on the revenue and expenses from pari-mutuel wagers through TwinSpires, retail and online sports betting business, United Tote Company, and Exacta Systems, LLC. The Gaming segment is involved in the casino properties and associated racetracks which support the casino license. The company was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: Churchill Downs, Inc. 是一家彩池賽馬、賽馬線上帳戶投注和賭場遊戲提供商。它透過以下部門運作：現場和歷史賽馬、投注服務和解決方案以及遊戲。現場和歷史賽馬部門包括丘吉爾唐斯賽馬場的現場和歷史彩池賽馬相關收入和支出，以及肯塔基州、維吉尼亞州和新罕布夏州的歷史賽馬場館。投注服務和解決方案專注於透過 TwinSpires、零售和線上體育博彩業務、United Tote Company 和 Exacta Systems, LLC 進行派利分成投注的收入和支出。遊戲部門涉及賭場資產和支援賭場許可證的相關賽馬場。該公司成立於 1875 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the price and yield performance of the CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite Index is a benchmark index that measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ-100 Index, and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money NASDAQ-100 Index covered call options. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 備兌買權 ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和支出之前，通常與 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現密切對應的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於相關指數的證券。 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite 指數是衡量理論投資組合表現的基準指數，該理論投資組合持有 NASDAQ-100 指數中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或賣出）一系列 1 個月平價 NASDAQ-100 指數擔保看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on May 27, 2025, and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年5月27日，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Marvell Technology, Inc. engages in the design, development, and sale of integrated circuits. Its products include data processing units, security solutions, automotive, coherent DSP, DCI optical modules, ethernet controllers, ethernet PHYs, ethernet switches, linear driver, PAM DSP, transimpedance amplifiers, fibre channel, HDD, SSD controller, storage accelerators, ASIC, and Marvell government solutions. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Singapore, Israel, India, China, and Others. The company was founded by Wei Li Dai and Pantas Sutardja in 1995 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Marvell Technology, Inc. 從事積體電路的設計、開發和銷售。其產品包括資料處理單元、安全解決方案、汽車、相干 DSP、DCI 光學模組、乙太網路控制器、乙太網路 PHY、乙太網路交換器、線性驅動器、PAM DSP、互阻抗放大器、光纖通道、HDD、SSD 控制器、儲存加速器、ASIC 和 Marvell 政府解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、新加坡、以色列、印度、中國等。該公司由 Wei Li Dai 和 Pantas Sutardja 於 1995 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Biogen, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovering, developing, and delivering therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases. Its products include TECFIDERA, VUMERITY, AVONEX, PLEGRIDY, TYSABRI, and FAMPYRA for the treatment of MS, SPINRAZA for the treatment of SMA, ADUHELM for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, and FUMADERM for the treatment of severe plaque psoriasis. The company was founded by Charles Weissmann, Heinz Schaller, Kenneth Murray, Walter Gilbert, and Phillip Allen Sharp in 1978 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Biogen, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和提供神經系統和神經退化性疾病的治療方法。其產品包括用於治療多發性硬化症的TECFIDERA、VUMERITY、AVONEX、PLEGRIDY、TYSABRI和FAMPYRA，用於治療SMA的SPINRAZA，用於治療阿茲海默症的ADUHELM，以及用於治療嚴重斑塊狀乾癬的FUMADERM。該公司由 Charles Weissmann、Heinz Schaller、Kenneth Murray、Walter Gilbert 和 Phillip Allen Sharp 於 1978 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: The Estee Lauder Companies, Inc. engages in the manufacture of skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. It sells products under Estee Lauder, Clinique, Origins, MAC, Bobbi Brown, La Mer, Jo Malone London, Aveda and Too Faced. The company was founded by Estee Lauder and Joseph Lauder in 1946 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 雅詩蘭黛公司從事護膚、化妝品、香水和護髮產品的製造。該公司銷售雅詩蘭黛、倩碧、Origins、MAC、Bobbi Brown、La Mer、Jo Malone London、Aveda 和 Too Faced 品牌的產品。該公司由雅詩蘭黛和約瑟夫蘭黛於 1946 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Halliburton Co. engages in the provision of products and services to the energy industry. It operates through the Completion and Production, and Drilling and Evaluation segments. The Completion and Production segment focuses on cementing, stimulation, specialty chemicals, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, and completion products and services. The Drilling and Evaluation segment provides field and reservoir modeling, drilling, fluids, evaluation, and wellbore placement solutions that enable customers to model, measure, drill, and optimize well construction activities. The company was founded by Erle P. Halliburton in 1919 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: 哈里伯頓公司從事為能源產業提供產品和服務。它透過完井和生產以及鑽井和評估部門運作。完井和生產部門專注於固井、增產、特殊化學品、幹預、壓力控制、人工舉升以及完井產品和服務。鑽井和評估部門提供現場和油藏建模、鑽井、流體、評估和井眼佈置解決方案，使客戶能夠建模、測量、鑽井和優化建井活動。該公司由 Erle P. Halliburton 於 1919 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Eli Lilly & Co. engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceutical products. The firm's products include diabetes, oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and other products and therapies. The company was founded by Eli Lilly on May 10, 1876 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: 禮來公司 (Eli Lilly & Co.) 從事醫藥產品的發現、開發、製造和銷售。該公司的產品包括糖尿病、腫瘤學、免疫學、神經科學以及其他產品和療法。該公司由禮來公司於 1876 年 5 月 10 日創立，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: Strive, Inc. engages in the provision of an asset management Bitcoin treasury. It is focused on maximizing value for shareholders, accumulating bitcoin and outperforming bitcoin over the long run. The company was founded by Arshia Sarkhani, Jackson Fairbanks, Arman Sarkhani, and Kyle Fairbanks on March 9, 2022 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Strive, Inc. 從事提供資產管理比特幣金庫業務。它專注於為股東實現價值最大化、累積比特幣並從長遠來看超越比特幣。該公司由 Arshia Sarkhani、Jackson Fairbanks、Arman Sarkhani 和 Kyle Fairbanks 於 2022 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares 寻求与 AVGO 每日表现相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投资结果（扣除费用和开支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which refer to throughout this prospectus as initial business combination. The company was founded on June 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。其成立的目的是与一个或多个企业进行合并、合并、股份交换、资产收购、股份购买、重组或类似的业务合并，在本招股说明书中将其称为初始业务合并。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 9 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: BTCS, Inc. is a blockchain technology company. Its operations include Validator Node Operations, Block Building, and Decentralized Finance Operations. The company was founded by Timothy Sidie and Michal Handerhan on April 15, 2008 and is headquartered in Wayne, PA.
info.description_zh: BTCS, Inc.是一家區塊鏈技術公司。其營運包括驗證節點運營、區塊構建和去中心化金融運營。該公司由 Timothy Sidie 和 Michal Handerhan 於 2008 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州韋恩。

info.description: F/m Compoundr U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF seeks investment results, that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the Nasdaq Compoundr 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note Index. The index is designed to offer exposure consistent with the total return of U.S. investment-grade aggregate bonds, without receiving and reinvesting dividend income, by investing in ETFs. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments LLC (the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in underlying funds that primarily invest in U.S. dollar denominated investment-grade bonds.
info.description_zh: F/m 複合美國綜合債券 ETF 追求的投資結果通常與納斯達克複合 10 年期美國公債指數相對應（未計費用和開支）。該指數旨在透過投資 ETF 提供與美國投資等級總債券總回報一致的風險敞口，而無需接收股息收入並進行再投資。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments LLC（「顧問」）尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於主要投資於以美元計價的投資級債券的基礎基金來實現基金的目標。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRCL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of CRCL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRCL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRCL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CRCL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具綜合起來為 CRCL 的價格提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: DeFi Development Corp. provides business and commercial property financing services. It provides technology that connects commercial mortgage borrowers looking for debt to refinance, build, or buy commercial property including apartment buildings to commercial property lenders (including banks, credit unions, REITs, debt funds, and more) looking to deploy capital into commercial mortgages. The company was founded by Blake E. Janover on November 28, 2018 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: DeFi Development Corp. 提供商業和商業房地產融資服務。它提供的技術將尋求債務再融資、建造或購買商業房地產（包括公寓大樓）的商業抵押貸款借款人與尋求將資本配置到商業抵押貸款的商業房地產貸款人（包括銀行、信用合作社、房地產投資信託基金、債務基金等）聯繫起來。該公司由 Blake E. Janover 於 2018 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. produces and distributes doughnuts. It offers yeast-raised doughnuts, pies, coffees and espresso drinks, chillers and iced beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. and Canada, International, and Market Development. The U.S. and Canada segment includes all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the U.S. and Canada, Insomnia-branded retail shops and consumer packaged goods operations. The International segment consists of all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Mexico. The Market Development segment handles the franchise operations across the globe, as well as Krispy Kreme company-owned shops in Japan. The firm sells its products through mass merchant, grocery and convenience stores. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Krispy Kreme, Inc. 生產和分銷甜甜圈。它提供酵母甜甜圈、餡餅、咖啡和濃縮咖啡、冰鎮飲料和冰鎮飲料。它透過以下部門運作：美國和加拿大部門、國際部門和市場開發部門。美國和加拿大部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在美國和加拿大的所有業務、Insomnia 品牌零售店和消費品業務。國際部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在英國、愛爾蘭、澳洲、紐西蘭和墨西哥的所有業務。市場開發部門負責全球範圍內的特許經營業務以及 Krispy Kreme 公司在日本的自營商店。該公司透過大型商家、雜貨店和便利商店銷售其產品。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. is a clinical-stage oncology therapeutics company, which focuses on the research, development, and commercialization of diffusing alpha-emitters radiation therapy for the treatment of cancer. The firm is involved in the clinical trials at cancer centers with indications that include skin cancer, oral cavity cancer, breast cancer, and pancreatic cancer. The company was founded by Uzi Sofer, Yona Keisari, and Itzhak Kelson in November 2015 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
info.description_zh: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤治療公司，專注於用於癌症治療的擴散 α 發射體放射療法的研究、開發和商業化。該公司參與癌症中心的臨床試驗，適應症包括皮膚癌、口腔癌、乳癌和胰臟癌。該公司由 Uzi Sofer、Yona Keisari 和 Itzhak Kelson 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於以色列耶路撒冷。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long DUOL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of DUOL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of DUOL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 DUOL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 DUOL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 DUOL 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Editas Medicine, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of genome editing technology. Its technology includes clustered, regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR), and CRISPR associated protein 9 (Cas9). The company was founded by Feng Zhang, Jennifer A. Doudna, George McDonald Church, J. Keith Joung and David R. Liu on September 3, 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Editas Medicine, Inc. 從事基因組編輯技術的開發和商業化。其技術包括成簇、規則間隔的短回文重複序列 (CRISPR) 和 CRISPR 相關蛋白 9 (Cas9)。該公司由 Feng Zhang、Jennifer A. Doudna、George McDonald Church、J. Keith Joung 和 David R. Liu 於 2013 年 9 月 3 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Corporate Bond Fund seeks a high level of total return consisting of both income and capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in corporate debt. The manager attempts to maintain an aggregate portfolio duration of between two and ten years under normal market conditions. The fund may invest up to 20% of its net assets in derivatives, such as swaps, U.S. Treasury futures and forward currency contracts. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree新興市場企業債券基金尋求高水準的總回報，包括收入和資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於公司債務。在正常市場條件下，管理人試圖將投資組合的總久期維持在兩年到十年之間。該基金最多可將其淨資產的 20% 投資於衍生品，例如掉期、美國國債期貨和遠期貨幣合約。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on May 14, 2018 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2018年5月14日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Forward Industries, Inc. is a Solana focused digital asset treasury company, with the strategy to buy, hold, stake, trade, invest in, and grow SOL and SOL related digital assets, protocols and businesses. The firm mission is to expand and strengthen the Solana ecosystem by acquiring and staking SOL and engaging with, providing tools to and investing in the Solana network, Solana developers and Solana related projects in order to increase shareholder value. It operates through the following segments: Design and Digital Assets. The Design segment consists of two operating segments that provide a full spectrum of hardware and software product design and engineering services to customers predominantly located in the U.S. The Digital Assets segment captures SOL-based yield generated by participating in the Solana network's staking protocol, which currently comprises rewards received from native staking. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Forward Industries, Inc. 是一家專注於 Solana 的數位資產財務公司，其策略是購買、持有、入股、交易、投資和發展 SOL 以及 SOL 相關的數位資產、協議和業務。該公司的使命是透過收購和質押 SOL 以及與 Solana 網路、Solana 開發人員和 Solana 相關項目互動、提供工具和投資來擴大和加強 Solana 生態系統，以增加股東價值。它透過以下部門運作：設計和數位資產。設計部門由兩個營運部門組成，為主要位於美國的客戶提供全方位的硬體和軟體產品設計和工程服務。數位資產部門捕獲透過參與 Solana 網路的質押協議產生的基於 SOL 的收益，目前包括從本地質押獲得的獎勵。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded product that is solely and passively invested in HYPE, the native token of the Hyperliquid blockchain protocol, aiming to reflect the value of the token held by the fund less expenses and liabilities. The strategy provides direct single-asset crypto exposure in an exchange-traded product wrapper, including capturing potential native protocol staking rewards generated by the underlying digital asset.
info.description_zh: Grayscale Hyperliquid Stake ETF 是一種被動管理的交易所交易產品，單獨被動投資於 Hyperliquid 區塊鏈協議的原生代幣 HYPE，旨在反映基金持有的代幣減去費用和負債後的價值。該策略在交易所交易產品包裝器中提供直接的單一資產加密貨幣敞口，包括捕獲基礎數位資產產生的潛在本機協議質押獎勵。

info.description: IN8bio, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of gamma-delta T cellular therapy product candidates for solid and liquid tumors and gamma-delta T cell engagers for cancer and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Lawrence S. Lamb and William T. Ho on February 8, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: IN8bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於實體和液體腫瘤的 γ-δ T 細胞治療候選產品以及癌症和自體免疫疾病的 γ-δ T 細胞接合劑的發現、開發和商業化。該公司由 Lawrence S. Lamb 和 William T. Ho 於 2016 年 2 月 8 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. operates a preclinical stage biopharmaceutical company which engages in developing therapeutics based on the Tumor Activated T Cell Engager platform technology. The company was founded by David Campbell in June 2017 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. 經營一家臨床前階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於腫瘤活化 T 細胞接合器平台技術的療法。該公司由 David Campbell 於 2017 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and invests primarily in equity securities of life science companies selected by Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust, the fund's investment sub-adviser, under the supervision of the adviser. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities issued by life science companies demonstrating innovation.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於該基金的投資副顧問 Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust 選擇的生命科學公司的股本證券，並接受顧問的監督。在正常市場條件下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於具有創新能力的生命科學公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: LKQ Corp. engages in the distribution of vehicle products and its parts to repair, maintain, and accessorize automobiles. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale-North America, Europe, and Specialty. The Wholesale-North America segment consists of aftermarket and salvage operations and sells five product types to professional collision and mechanical vehicle repair businesses. The Europe segment offers aftermarket operations. The Specialty segment distributes specialty vehicle aftermarket products and accessories in North America. The company was founded by Donald F. Flynn on February 13, 1998 and is headquartered in Antioch, TN.
info.description_zh: LKQ Corp. 從事汽車產品及其零件的分銷，以維修、保養和裝飾汽車。它透過以下部門運作：北美批發部門、歐洲部門和專業部門。北美批發部門包括售後市場和救助業務，並向專業碰撞和機械車輛維修企業銷售五種產品類型。歐洲部門提供售後業務。特種車輛部門在北美分銷特種車輛售後市場產品和配件。該公司由 Donald F. Flynn 於 1998 年 2 月 13 日創立，總部位於田納西州安提阿。

info.description: Leishen Energy Holding Co., Ltd. is engaged in the oil and gas industry. It operates through the following business segments; Clean-Energy Equipment; Oil and Gas Engineering Technical Services; New Energy Production and Operation; and Digitalization and Integration Equipment. The Clean-Energy Equipment segment supplies wellhead heating systems, wellhead safety control systems, oil-water separation systems, natural gas online sampling systems, oil and gas skid-mounted equipment and polymer flexible composite pipes. The Oil and Gas Engineering Technical Services segment provides technical solutions for oil and gas production. The New Energy Production and Operation segment focuses on the production, storage and transportation of natural gas, traditional fuels, development of distributed energy, and the planning and operation of new energy and new energy industries. The Digitalization and Integration Equipment segment is designed to provide informatization solutions for industrial intelligence, mobility, industrial interconnection and big data trends. The company was founded by Hongqi Li in 2007 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: 雷神能源控股股份有限公司從事石油和天然氣行業。它透過以下業務部門運作；清潔能源設備；石油天然氣工程技術服務；新能源生產經營；以及數位化和整合設備。清潔能源設備部門提供井口加熱系統、井口安全控制系統、油水分離系統、天然氣線上採樣系統、油氣撬裝設備和聚合物柔性複合管。油氣工程技術服務部門為油氣生產提供技術解決方案。新能源生產營運板塊專注於天然氣、傳統燃料的生產、儲運、分散式能源開發以及新能源及新能源產業的規劃與營運。數位化及整合設備板塊旨在為工業智慧化、行動化、工業互聯和大數據趨勢提供資訊化解決方案。該公司由李紅旗於2007年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Simplify Bitcoin Strategy PLUS Income ETF seeks income and capital gains. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (an "ETF"). The fund's adviser seeks to achieve its investment objective by using three strategies: (1) a Bitcoin futures strategy, (2) an income strategy, and (3) an option overlay strategy. Even though the adviser employs three strategies, the fund's portfolio is composed primarily of income producing securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 簡化比特幣策略加收入 ETF 尋求收入和資本利得。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的顧問尋求透過使用三種策略來實現其投資目標：（1）比特幣期貨策略，（2）收入策略，以及（3）選擇權覆蓋策略。儘管顧問採用三種策略，但該基金的投資組合主要由創收證券組成。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Marker Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of novel cell-based immunotherapies and peptide-based vaccines for the treatment of hematological malignancies and solid tumor indications. The company was founded on October 22, 1991 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Marker Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的免疫腫瘤公司，致力於新型細胞免疫療法和勝肽疫苗的開發和商業化，用於治療血液惡性腫瘤和實體瘤適應症。該公司成立於1991年10月22日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Muzero Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 10, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Muzero Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年10月10日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2027 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2027, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2027 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2027 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nanobiotix SA is a late-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of therapeutic approaches to the treatment of cancer. Its technologies include NanoXray that improves the efficacy of radiation therapy against tumor cells. The company was founded by Laurent Levy and Abdel Kader Boussaha on March 4, 2003 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Nanobiotix SA 是一家後期生物技術公司，致力於開發癌症治療方法。其技術包括 NanoXray，可提高放射治療對腫瘤細胞的功效。該公司由Laurent Levy和Abdel Kader Boussaha於2003年3月4日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Nuveen Core Plus Bond ETF seeks total return, primarily through current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pursue its investment objective by investing under normal market conditions, at least 80% of the sum of its net assets and the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in income producing fixed income securities.
info.description_zh: Nuveen Core Plus Bond ETF 主要透過當前收入尋求總回報。該基金是一種主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常市場條件下將其淨資產總和以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額的至少 80% 投資於產生收入的固定收益證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Gold Miners ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on the NYSE Arca Gold Miners Index by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the index and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Gold Miners ETF 尋求透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 NYSE Arca Gold Miners Index 選擇權出售所產生的收入的 2 倍 (200%)，該基金旨在提供 2 倍 (200%) 的指數每日表現，並獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 表現的風險上限，但受潛在投資收益上限的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎槓桿 ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Peace Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 24, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Peace Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Pilgrim's Pride Corp. engages in the production, processing, marketing, and distribution of fresh, frozen and value-added chicken and pork products to retailers, distributors, and foodservice operators. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Europe, and Mexico. The company was founded by Lonnie A. Pilgrim and Aubrey Pilgrim on October 2, 1946, and is headquartered in Greeley, CO.
info.description_zh: Pilgrim's Pride Corp. 從事新鮮、冷凍和加值雞肉和豬肉產品的生產、加工、行銷和分銷給零售商、分銷​​商和餐飲服務業者。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲和墨西哥。該公司由 Lonnie A. Pilgrim 和 Aubrey Pilgrim 於 1946 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州格里利。

info.description: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance, Inc. is a commercial mortgage real estate investment trust. It engages in a series of transactions of senior secured loans and other real estate related assets. The company was founded on March 30, 2021 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 抵押貸款
info.description_zh: 芝加哥大西洋房地產金融公司是一家商業抵押房地產投資信託公司。它從事一系列優先擔保貸款和其他房地產相關資產的交易。該公司成立於2021年3月30日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: Solid Biosciences, Inc. is a life science company, which engages in the development of treatments for patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It also focuses on developing treatments for neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Ilan Ganot, Andrey J. Zarur, Matthew Bennett Arnold, Annie Ganot, and Gilad David Hayeem in March 2013 and is headquartered in Charlestown, MA.
info.description_zh: Solid Biosciences, Inc.是一家生命科學公司，致力於開發杜氏肌肉營養不良症患者的治療方法。它還專注於開發神經肌肉和心臟病的治療方法。該公司由 Ilan Ganot、Andrey J. Zarur、Matthew Bennett Arnold、Annie Ganot 和 Gilad David Hayeem 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州查爾斯敦。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2033. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2033.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2033 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2033 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: NEOS Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income with the potential for appreciation based on exposure to exchange-traded products (ETPs) that have direct exposure to Bitcoin. The fund implements a multi-part strategy including a 100% core exposure to spot Bitcoin ETPs and an additional synthetic options strategy designed to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure, while generating income through a data-driven call option overlay.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF 尋求透過產生高額月收入來提高業績，並且基於直接接觸比特幣的交易所交易產品 (ETP) 的升值潛力。該基金實施多部分策略，包括 100% 核心敞口為現貨比特幣 ETP，以及額外的合成期權策略，旨在創建約 150% 名義投資組合敞口，同時透過數據驅動的看漲期權疊加產生收入。

info.description: Lafayette Digital Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 5, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Lafayette Digital Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月5日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Versant Media Group, Inc. operates as an industry media and entertainment business that operates in four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf and athletics participation and sports and genre entertainment. It also serves on markets primarily through a strong portfolio of brands consisting of renowned networks and complementary digital platforms. The company was founded on May 1, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Versant Media Group, Inc. 是一家行業媒體和娛樂企業，業務涉及四個核心市場：政治新聞和輿論、商業新聞和個人理財、高爾夫和田徑參與以及體育和流派娛樂。它也主要透過由知名網路和互補數位平台組成的強大品牌組合在市場上提供服務。該公司成立於2025年5月1日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2030年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Inhibrx Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which includes a pipeline of novel biologic therapeutic candidates, developed using proprietary modular protein engineering platforms. Its clinical pipeline of therapeutic candidates includes INBRX-109 and INBRX-106, both of which utilize multivalent formats where the precise valency can be optimized in a target-centric way to mediate what is believed to be the most appropriate agonist function. The company was founded by Brendan P. Eckelman on January 8, 2024 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: Inhibrx Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，擁有一系列採用專有模組化蛋白質工程平台開發的新型生物治療候選藥物。其治療候選藥物的臨床管道包括INBRX-109和INBRX-106，這兩種藥物都採用多價形式，可以以標靶為中心的方式優化精確的效價，以介導被認為是最合適的激動劑功能。該公司由 Brendan P. Eckelman 於 2024 年 1 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: iShares USD Green Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI USD Green Bond Select Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds that are issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund environmental projects. The fund seeks to track the investment results of the underlying index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund projects with direct environmental benefits.
info.description_zh: iShares 美元綠色債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美元綠色債券精選指數的投資結果，該指數由美國和非美國發行人發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券組成，為環保項目提供資金。該基金旨在追蹤基礎指數的投資結果，該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人為資助具有直接環境效益的項目而發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券的表現。

info.description: VictoryShares US Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility ETF seeks to provide investment results that track the performance of the Nasdaq Victory US Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility Index before fees and expenses. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in securities included in the Nasdaq Victory US Multi-Factor Minimum Volatility Index (the "index"). The index utilizes a rules-based approach designed to generate investment returns with less volatility than the broader U.S. market.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 美國多因子最低波動率 ETF 旨在提供追蹤納斯達克勝利美國多因素最低波動指數（未計費用和開支）表現的投資結果。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將其至少 80% 的資產投資於納斯達克勝利美國多因素最低波動指數（「指數」）所包含的證券來實現其投資目標。該指數採用基於規則的方法，旨在產生比更廣泛的美國市場波動性更小的投資回報。

info.description: Cerus Corp. engages in the research, development, and manufacturing of biomedical and surgical products. The firm produces blood system for platelets and plasma. It operates through Blood Safety segment. It markets products under the INTERCEPT brand. The company was founded by Laurence M. Corash and John E. Hearst on September 19, 1991 and is headquartered in Concord, CA.
info.description_zh: Cerus Corp. 從事生物醫學和外科產品的研究、開發和製造。該公司生產血小板和血漿的血液系統。它透過血液安全部門運作。它以 INTERCEPT 品牌銷售產品。該公司由 Laurence M. Corash 和 John E. Hearst 於 1991 年 9 月 19 日創立，總部位於加州康科德。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Intermediate ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize current income exempt from federal income tax while prioritizing capital preservation. The strategy primarily targets investment-grademunicipal bonds with an intermediate-term profile, generally maintaining an average effective portfolio duration between three and eight years.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政中級 ETF 是一隻積極管理的基金，旨在最大限度地提高當前免繳聯邦所得稅的收入，同時優先考慮資本保值。該策略主要針對具有中期特徵的投資等級市政債券，通常將平均有效投資期間維持在三到八年之間。
