info.description: Spruce Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing and commercializing novel therapies for rare endocrine disorders with significant unmet medical need. The company was founded on November 13, 2014 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Spruce Biosciences, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化針對醫療需求未滿足的罕見內分泌疾病的新療法。該公司成立於2014年11月13日，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF seeks to provide a high current yield exempt from federal income tax. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax (but may be subject to the federal alternative minimum tax). It normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities included in the Fidelity Systematic U.S. Municipal Bond IndexSM, which aims to increase exposure to municipal bonds with higher risk-adjusted performance and liquidity characteristics relative to traditional market-capitalization weighted U.S. investment grade municipal bond indices.
info.description_zh: 富達系統市政債券指數 ETF 尋求提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高當期收益率。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於市政證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅（但可能需繳納聯邦替代性最低稅）。它通常將至少80%的資產投資於富達系統美國市政債券指數SM中包含的證券，該指數旨在增加對相對於傳統市值加權美國投資級市政債券指數具有更高風險調整表現和流動性特徵的市政債券的投資。

info.description: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Real Estate, Residential Real Estate, Commercial and Industrial, and Consumer. The Commercial Estate segment is involved in construction, non-residential, and multi-family. The Residential Real Estate Segment focuses on borrower's residential real estate generally in a first lien position. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes loans made for purposes of financing the activities of commercial customers. The Consumer segment engages in indirect automobile loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on August 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY.
info.description_zh: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業以及消費者。商業地產部門涉及建築、非住宅和多戶住宅。住宅房地產部分主要關注借款人的住宅房地產，通常處於第一留置權位置。商業和工業部門包括為商業客戶活動融資而發放的貸款。消費者部門從事間接汽車貸款、房屋淨值貸款和其他消費貸款。該公司成立於2018年8月30日，總部位於紐約州波基普西。

info.description: iShares J.P. Morgan USD Emerging Markets Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the J.P. Morgan EMBI Global Core Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, emerging market bonds. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is a broad, diverse U.S. dollar-denominated emerging markets debt benchmark that tracks the total return of actively traded external debt instruments in emerging market countries.
info.description_zh: iShares 摩根大通美元新興市場債券 ETF 旨在追蹤由以美元計價的新興市場債券組成的摩根大通 EMBI 全球核心指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數是一個廣泛、多樣化的以美元計價的新興市場債務基準，追蹤新興市場國家交易活躍的外債工具的總回報。

info.description: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg USD Emerging Markets Government RIC Capped Index that measures the investment return of U.S. dollar-denominated bonds issued by governments and government-related issuers in emerging market countries. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of index. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and under normal circumstances at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美元新興市場政府 RIC 上限指數的表現，該指數衡量新興市場國家政府和政府相關發行人發行的美元計價債券的投資回報。管理人採用旨在追蹤指數表現的指數投資方法。基金的所有投資都會透過抽樣過程進行篩選，一般情況下基金資產的至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. engages in the acquisition and development of oil and natural gas properties. It operates in the Rockies, Mid-Continent, South Texas, and West Texas. The company was founded on January 26, 1966 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. 從事石油和天然氣資產的收購和開發。該公司在落基山脈、中大陸、德克薩斯州南部和德克薩斯州西部開展業務。該公司成立於1966年1月26日，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Intermediate Municipal Income ETF seeks the highest level of income exempt from federal income taxes consistent with moderate price fluctuation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in investment-grade municipal securities or derivatives that are linked to or provides investment exposure to the municipal market. Under normal conditions, the fund's weighted average effective maturity will be four to twelve years. There are no maturity limitations on individual securities.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 中等市政收入 ETF 尋求與溫和的價格波動相一致的最高水平的聯邦所得稅豁免收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於與市政市場相關或提供投資風險的投資等級市政證券或衍生性商品。在正常情況下，該基金的加權平均有效期限為四至十二年。個別證券沒有期限限制。

info.description: HCM III Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: HCM III Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月15日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: D. Boral Acquisition I Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: D. Boral Acquisition I Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月3日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: 374Water, Inc. is a clean technology company. It offers supercritical water oxidation (SWCO) waste processors. It caters to municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, food waste, chemical plants, and army camps and emergency situations. The company was founded by Yaacov Nagar and Marc Deshusses on September 8, 2005 and is headquartered in Morrisville, NC.
info.description_zh: 374Water, Inc. 是一家清潔技術公司。它提供超臨界水氧化（SWCO）廢物處理器。它適用於市政和工業廢水處理廠、食物垃圾、化工廠、軍營和緊急情況。該公司由 Yaacov Nagar 和 Marc Deshusses 於 2005 年 9 月 8 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州莫里斯維爾。

info.description: Canopy Growth Corp. engages in the production, distribution, and sale of cannabis and cannabinoid-based products for both adult-use and medical purposes. It operates through the following segments: Cannabis, Storz and Bickel. The Cannabis segment includes the global production, distribution and sale of a diverse range of cannabis and cannabis-related products. The Storz and Bickel segment produces and sells vaporizers. The company was founded by Bruce Linton on August 5, 2009 and is headquartered in Smith Falls, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Canopy Growth Corp. 從事成人使用和醫療用途的大麻和大麻素產品的生產、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：Cannabis、Storz 和 Bickel。大麻部門包括全球生產、分銷和銷售各種大麻和大麻相關產品。 Storz 和 Bickel 部門生產和銷售蒸發器。該公司由 Bruce Linton 於 2009 年 8 月 5 日創立，總部位於加拿大史密斯福爾斯。

info.description: First Trust Asia Pacific Ex-Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 亞太地區（日本除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 亞太地區（日本除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克亞太（日本除外）指數中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. is a redefining drug discovery company, which identifies and optimizes allosteric binding sites that never targeted before. Its See-Tx target identification platform uses the published 3D structure of enzymes and a proprietary computational technology to discover new allosteric binding sites and predict their druggability. The firm is also unlocking new treatment options to treat disorders characterized by protein misfolding. The company was founded by Khalid Islam in 2017 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家重新定義的藥物發現公司，該公司識別並優化以前從未靶向的變構結合位點。其 See-Tx 標靶識別平台使用已發布的酶 3D 結構和專有計算技術來發現新的變構結合位點並預測其成藥性。該公司還正在開發新的治療方案來治療以蛋白質錯誤折疊為特徵的疾病。該公司由 Khalid Islam 於 2017 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Intelligent Real Estate ETF seeks total return. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest in a diversified portfolio of publicly-traded real estate investment trusts ("REITs") and mortgage-backed securities ("MBS") listed primarily on U.S. stock exchanges, and to a lesser extent, stock exchanges in Canada, Europe, and Asia. The fund will invest in REITs and MBS that, in the determination of the fund's sub-adviser, have similar qualitative characteristics to the aggregate real estate portfolio holdings of a select group of public, non-traded REITs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智慧房地產ETF追求總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），將投資於主要在美國證券交易所上市的公開交易房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）和抵押貸款支持證券（「MBS」）的多元化投資組合，其次是在加拿大、歐洲和亞洲的證券交易所上市。該基金將投資於基金副顧問確定的房地產投資信託基金和抵押貸款支持證券，這些房地產投資信託基金和抵押貸款支持證券與選定的一組公共非交易房地產投資信託基金的總房地產投資組合持有量具有相似的品質特徵。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Patria Investments Ltd. engages in the provision of asset management. Its businesses include private equity, infrastructure, real estate, and credit. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Patria Investments Ltd. 從事提供資產管理業務。其業務包括私募股權、基礎設施、房地產和信貸。該公司成立於2001年，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: Entrada Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which provides of a class of medicines that engages in intracellular targets. Its Endosomal Escape Vehicle (EEV) therapeutics are designed to enable the efficient intracellular delivery of a wide range of therapeutics into a variety of organs and tissues, resulting in an improved therapeutic index. The company was founded by Dehua Pei in 2016 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Entrada Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，提供一類涉及細胞內標靶的藥物。其內體逃脫載體（EEV）療法旨在實現多種療法在細胞內有效遞送至各種器官和組織，從而提高治療指數。該公司由裴德華於2016年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Hennessy Stance ESG ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest, under normal circumstances at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in exchange-traded equity securities of U.S. issuers that meet environmental, social, and governance ("ESG") standards, as determined by its sub-adviser.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Stance ESG ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，將至少將其淨資產價值的 80% 加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於符合其副顧問確定的環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）標準的美國發行人的交易所交易股票證券。

info.description: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities-including common and preferred stock, depositary receipts (ADRs, GDRs, EDRs), and ETFs-issued by companies located in or tied economically to emerging and frontier markets. The investment strategy combines quantitative screening through a proprietary alpha model with fundamental research to build a diversified portfolio targeting companies across all market capitalizations positioned for sustainable earnings growth and positive earnings revisions at attractive valuations.
info.description_zh: Sophus Capital Emerging Market ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於由位於新興和前沿市場或與新興和前沿市場經濟相關的公司發行的股本證券（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證（ADR、GDR、EDR）和 ETF）來尋求長期資本增值。該投資策略將透過專有的阿爾法模型進行定量篩選與基礎研究相結合，建立一個多元化的投資組合，針對所有市值的公司，這些公司定位於可持續盈利增長，並以有吸引力的估值進行積極的盈利修正。

info.description: First Trust BuyWrite Income ETF seeks current income; capital appreciation is a secondary objective. The fund will pursue its objectives by investing primarily in equity securities listed on U.S. exchanges and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the Standard & Poor's 500 Index (the "index"). The call options written by the fund will be a laddered portfolio of call options with expirations of less than one year, written at-the-money to slightly out-of-the-money.
info.description_zh: First Trust BuyWrite Income ETF 尋求當前收益；資本增值是次要目標。該基金將透過主要投資於美國交易所上市的股票證券並利用「選擇權策略」來實現其目標，該策略包括賣出（出售）標準普爾 500 指數（「指數」）的美國交易所交易看漲期權。該基金賣出的買權將是到期日不到一年的階梯式買權投資組合，賣出選擇權為平價至輕微虛值。

info.description: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance of the index. The index is composed of the common stock of large capitalization U.S. companies. The index is constructed by evaluating the components of the index, using the Russell IdealRatings system, to identify companies that comply with Shariah principles. These ratings were developed based on the AAOFI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF 旨在追蹤 Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」的方式來追蹤指數的表現。該指數由大型美國公司的普通股組成。該指數是透過使用 Russell IdealRatings 系統評估該指數的組成部分來建構的，以識別符合伊斯蘭教法原則的公司。這些評級是根據 AAOFI 制定的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: T.Rowe Price High Income Municipal ETF seeks to provide a high level of income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T.Rowe Price 高收入市政 ETF 旨在提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF seeks to provide current income. The fund will pursue its investment objective by investing primarily in equity securities listed on U.S. exchanges and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the Nasdaq-100 Index. The call options written by the fund will have expirations of less than one year, and will be typically written at-the-money to out-of-the-money.
info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF 尋求提供當前收入。該基金將透過主要投資於美國交易所上市的股本證券以及利用「選擇權策略」來實現其投資目標，其中包括賣出（出售）納斯達克 100 指數的美國交易所交易看漲期權。該基金所簽發的買權的到期日將少於一年，並且通常會以平價或價外形式出售。

info.description: Invesco Electric Vehicle Metals Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal circumstances, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the tradeable metals widely used in the production of an electric vehicle (which include, but are not limited to, iron ore, copper, aluminum, nickel, cobalt and lithium). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順電動車金屬商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，尋求透過投資與電動車生產中廣泛使用的可交易金屬（包括但不限於鐵礦石、銅、鋁、鎳、鈷和鋰）經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright International Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright International Focus Five TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the ETFs that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust country/region-based ETFs that the index provider believes offer the greatest potential to outperform the other ETFs in the selection universe.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright International Focus 5 ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright International Focus Five TM 指數的指數的價格和收益率（未計費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的 ETF。該指數旨在提供對 First Trust 五個基於國家/地區的 ETF 的有針對性的投資，指數提供者認為這些 ETF 具有超越精選範圍內其他 ETF 的最大潛力。

info.description: Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of therapeutic proteins and antibodies that modulate the activity of G protein-coupled receptors (GPCR). It develops a proprietary technology platform called GEODe to enable the discovery and development of GPCR-targeted biologic medicines. The company was founded by Timothy A. Springer and Andrew Kruse in November 2015 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發調節 G 蛋白偶聯受體 (GPCR) 活性的治療性蛋白質和抗體。它開發了一個名為 GEODe 的專有技術平台，以實現 GPCR 標靶生物藥物的發現和開發。該公司由 Timothy A. Springer 和 Andrew Kruse 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a Major League Baseball (MLB) club. It operates through the Baseball and Mixed-Use Development segments. The Baseball segment includes its operations relating to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park and includes revenue generated from ticket sales, concessions, local broadcasting rights, advertising sponsorships, suites, and premium seat fees, retail and licensing revenue, shared MLB revenue streams, including national broadcasting rights and licensing, and other sources. Ticket sales, concessions, broadcasting rights and advertising sponsorship sales are the baseball segment's primary revenue drivers. The Mixed-Use Development segment includes retail, office, hotel and entertainment operations within The Battery Atlanta. The Battery Atlanta derives revenue primarily from office and retail rental income including overage rent and tenant reimbursements and, to a lesser extent, parking and advertising sponsorships. The company was founded on December 7, 2022 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 亞特蘭大勇士控股公司 (Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.) 擁有並經營美國職棒大聯盟 (MLB) 俱樂部。它透過棒球和混合用途開發部門運作。棒球部門包括與勇敢者棒球特許經營權和Truist Park相關的業務，包括門票銷售、特許權、當地廣播權、廣告贊助、套房和高級座位費、零售和許可收入、共享MLB收入流（包括國家廣播權和許可）以及其他來源產生的收入。門票銷售、優惠、轉播權和廣告贊助銷售是棒球業務的主要收入來源。混合用途開發部門包括亞特蘭大砲台內的零售、辦公室、飯店和娛樂業務。亞特蘭大砲台的收入主要來自辦公室和零售租金收入，包括超額租金和租戶報銷，以及較小程度的停車和廣告贊助。該公司成立於2022年12月7日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: VegaShares SPX NDX RTY Premium Income ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic covered call strategy by combining long exposure to major U.S. equity benchmarks with the systematic sale of zero-days-to-expiration (0DTE) or one-day-to-expiration (1DTE) out-of-the-money call options. The strategy utilizes a quantitative framework to dynamically weight exposure across the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, and Russell 2000 indices based on implied volatility, correlation, and liquidity, aiming to harvest short-dated volatility risk premiums to generate high weekly income.
info.description_zh: VegaShares SPX NDX RTY Premium Income ETF 是一款主動式管理基金，採用合成備兌看漲策略，將主要美國股票基準的長期曝險與系統性銷售零日到期 (0DTE) 或一日到期 (1DTE) 價外買權相結合。此策略利用定量框架，根據隱含波動率、相關性和流動性動態權衡標準普爾 500、納斯達克 100 和羅素 2000 指數的風險敞口，旨在獲取短期波動風險溢價，從而產生高週收入。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that captures large- and mid-capitalization stocks across 23 of the 24 Emerging Markets countries, excluding China.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）指数（“基础指数”）的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，涵蓋 24 個新興市場國家中 23 個國家（不包括中國）的大中型股票。

info.description: SEI Select Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of emerging market issuers. The fund normally maintains investments in at least six emerging market countries, however, it may invest a substantial amount of its assets in issuers located in a single country or a limited number of countries.
info.description_zh: SEI Select 新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金通常在至少六個新興市場國家進行投資，但也可能將大量資產投資於位於單一國家或有限數量國家的發行人。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Target Hospitality Corp. engages in the provision of rental accommodation with catering and hospitality services. It operates through the following business segments: HFS South, WHS, Government, and All Other. The HFS South segment consists primarily of rental and vertically integrated hospitality services revenue from customers in the natural resources and development industry located primarily in Texas and New Mexico. The WHS segment consist primarily of revenue from the construction phase of the contract with Lithium Nevada LLC, supporting a North American critical mineral supply chain, as well as specialty rental and vertically integrated hospitality services revenue from customers in support of the development of a regional data center campus located in Southwestern United States. The Government segment is involved in rental and vertically integrated hospitality services revenue from customers with Government contracts in Texas. The All Other segment focuses on rental and vertically integrated hospitality services revenue from customers primarily in the natural resources and development industry located outside of the HFS South segment. The company was founded by Brian Scott Lash in 1978 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Target Hospitality Corp. 從事提供住宿租賃以及餐飲和旅館服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：HFS South、WHS、政府和所有其他部門。 HFS South 部門主要包括來自主要位於德克薩斯州和新墨西哥州的自然資源和開發行業客戶的租賃和垂直整合酒店服務收入。 WHS部門主要包括與Lithium Nevada LLC合約建設階段的收入，支持北美關鍵礦產供應鏈，以及來自客戶的專業租賃和垂直整合酒店服務收入，以支持位於美國西南部的區域數據中心園區的開發。政府部門涉及來自德克薩斯州政府合約客戶的租賃和垂直整合的酒店服務收入。所有其他部門專注於來自 HFS South 部門之外的自然資源和開發行業客戶的租賃和垂直整合酒店服務收入。該公司由 Brian Scott Lash 於 1978 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: FedEx Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of transportation, e-commerce, and business services. It operates through the following segments: Federal Express, FedEx Freight, and FedEx Corporate and Other. The Federal Express segment provides transportation, delivery, and related logistics services for packages and freight worldwide. The FedEx Freight segment offers less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation services. The FedEx Corporate and Other segment includes corporate headquarters costs for executive officers and certain legal and finance functions, as well as certain other costs and credits not allocated to the company's transportation businesses. The company was founded by Frederick Wallace Smith on June 18, 1971, and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: 聯邦快遞公司是一家控股公司，從事提供運輸、電子商務和商業服務。它透過以下部門運作：聯邦快遞、聯邦快遞貨運、聯邦快遞企業及其他部門。聯邦快遞部門為全球包裹和貨運提供運輸、遞送和相關物流服務。聯邦快遞貨運部門提供零擔 (LTL) 貨運服務。聯邦快遞企業和其他部門包括公司總部執行官和某些法律和財務職能的成本，以及未分配給公司運輸業務的某些其他成本和信貸。該公司由 Frederick Wallace Smith 於 1971 年 6 月 18 日創立，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. engages in the biopharmaceutical business, which engages in the development of transformative medicine. Its product portfolio includes Vtama, Batoclimab, Brepocitinib, Namilumab, and RVT-2001, which aims to treat psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, thyroid eye disease, and other illnesses. The company was founded by Vivek Ramaswamy on April 7, 2014 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Roivant Sciences Ltd.從事生物製藥業務，致力於變革醫學的開發。其產品組合包括 Vtama、Batoclimab、Brepocitinib、Namilumab 和 RVT-2001，旨在治療牛皮癬、異位性皮膚炎、甲狀腺眼疾和其他疾病。該公司由Vivek Ramaswamy於2014年4月7日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp. engages in the provision of crop productivity solutions. The firm includes seeds, seed traits, seed treatments, biologicals, high-value adjuvants and fertilizers. It operates through the following segments: Seed and Integrated Products, Crop Protection, and Crop Nutrition. The Seed and Integrated Products segment deals with the development and commercialization of integrated products that combine three complementary components biotechnological events, germplasm and seed treatments in order to increase crop productivity and create value for customers. The Crop Protection segment develops and produces adjuvants, insecticides and fungicides. The Crop Nutrition segment focuses on the development, production and commercialization of inoculants that allow the biological fixation of nitrogen in the crops and of fertilizers including bio fertilizers and micro granulated fertilizers that increases the productivity and yield of the crops. The company was founded on November 14, 2017 and is headquartered in Rosario, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp. 致力於提供作物生產力解決方案。該公司業務包括種子、種子性狀、種子處理劑、生物製品、高價值助劑和肥料。它透過以下部門運作：種子和綜合產品、作物保護和作物營養。種子和綜合產品部門致力於綜合產品的開發和商業化，這些產品結合了三個互補的生物技術事件、種質和種子處理，以提高作物生產力並為客戶創造價值。作物保護部門開發生產助劑、殺蟲劑和殺菌劑。作物營養部門專注於接種劑的開發、生產和商業化，這些接種劑可以對作物中的氮進行生物固定，以及肥料（包括生物肥料和微顆粒肥料）的開發、生產和商業化，以提高作物的生產力和產量。該公司成立於2017年11月14日，總部位於阿根廷羅薩裡奧。

info.description: Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally, before fees and expenses, to the performance of its underlying index, the Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha Index. The fund pursues its investment objective by normally investing at least 80% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of common stocks of small-sized companies that are included in the Solactive Small Cap Index, a universe of 2,000 small-sized capitalization stocks.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前與其基礎指數 Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha Index 的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金通常透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成基礎指數的證券來實現其投資目標。基礎指數由 Solactive 小型股指數（包含 2,000 隻小型股）中包含的小型公司的普通股組成。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Nasdaq-100 Core Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity investments of companies that are included in the fund's benchmark. The fund will generally seek to maintain style, capitalization and industry characteristics similar to its benchmark. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 Nasdaq-100 核心溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於納入該基金基準的公司的股權投資。該基金通常會尋求保持與其基準相似的風格、資本規模和行業特徵。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Wahed Dow Jones Islamic World ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to invests in equity securities of global companies (excluding U.S. domiciled companies) the characteristics of which meet the requirements of Shariah and are consistent with Islamic principles as interpreted by subject-matter experts (each, a "Shariah Compliant Company"). The adviser seeks to invest the fund's assets in securities similar to the components of, and to achieve returns similar to those of, the Dow Jones Islamic Market International Titans 100 Index (the "Index"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wahed Dow Jones Islam World ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在投資於全球公司（不包括美國註冊公司）的股本證券，這些公司的特徵符合伊斯蘭教法的要求，並符合主題專家解釋的伊斯蘭原則（每個公司都是「符合伊斯蘭教法的公司」）。該顧問尋求將基金資產投資於與道瓊伊斯蘭市場國際泰坦 100 指數（「指數」）成分類似的證券，並獲得與道瓊伊斯蘭市場國際泰坦 100 指數（「指數」）類似的回報。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Multi Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Multi Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM, NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM and NASDAQ US 700 Small Cap Index TM that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Multi Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求與納斯達克 AlphaDEX Multi Cap Growth Index 的價格和收益率（未計基金費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，從納斯達克美國 500 大型股指數 TM、納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM 和納斯達克美國 700 小型股指數 TM 中選擇成長型股票，這些股票相對於傳統指數可能產生正的阿爾法或風險調整回報。

info.description: LightPath Technologies, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and distribution of optical and infrared components. Its products include molded glass and assemblies, infrared molded lenses, diamond turned, conventional ground and polished ground lenses and assemblies, and collimator assemblies, which are used in applications involving light detection and ranging technology. The firm supports a range of customers in the field of industrial, laser, defense, medical, telecommunications, and instrumentation. The company was founded in1985 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: LightPath Technologies, Inc. 從事光學和紅外線元件的設計、開發、製造和分銷。其產品包括模製玻璃和組件、紅外線模製透鏡、鑽石車削、傳統磨削和拋光磨削透鏡和組件以及準直器組件，這些產品用於涉及光探測和測距技術的應用。該公司為工業、雷射、國防、醫療、電信和儀器儀表領域的眾多客戶提供支援。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Targa Resources Corp. engages in the business of gathering, compressing, treating, processing, transporting, and purchasing and selling natural gas. It operates through the following segments: Gathering and Processing, and Logistics and Transportation, and Other. The Gathering and Processing segment includes assets used in the gathering, and purchase and sale of natural gas produced from oil and gas wells. The Logistics and Transportation segment refers to the activities and assets necessary to convert mixed natural gas liquids (NGLs) into NGL products. The Other contains the results of commodity derivative activity mark-to-market gains and losses related to derivative contracts. The company was founded on October 27, 2005 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Targa Resources Corp. 從事天然氣採集、壓縮、處理、加工、運輸以及採購和銷售業務。它透過以下部門運作：收集和加工部門、物流和運輸部門以及其他部門。收集和加工部門包括用於收集、購買和銷售石油和天然氣井生產的天然氣的資產。物流和運輸部門是指將混合天然氣液體（NGL）轉化為 NGL 產品所需的活動和資產。其他包含與衍生性商品合約相關的商品衍生性商品活動以市價計價的損益結果。該公司成立於2005年10月27日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Nomura Transformational Technologies ETF is an actively managed fund targeting capital growth by investing in global technology companies at the forefront of secular shifts and disruptive innovations. The strategy emphasizes a bottom-up stock selection process to identify businesses across any market capitalization that demonstrate high barriers to entry and the potential for rapid earnings growth relative to the broader economy.
info.description_zh: 野村轉型技術 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資處於長期變革和顛覆性創新前沿的全球科技公司來實現資本成長。該策略強調自下而上的選股流程，以識別任何市值的企業，這些企業表現出較高的進入障礙以及相對於更廣泛的經濟而言具有快速盈利增長潛力的企業。

info.description: Wise Group Plc operates as a global payment solutions. It offers cross-border payment services to banks and customers. The company was founded on June 17, 2025 and is headquartered in St. Helier, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Wise Group Plc 是一家全球支付解決方案提供商。它為銀行和客戶提供跨境支付服務。該公司成立於2025年6月17日，總部位於英國聖赫利爾。

info.description: Eightco Holdings, Inc. operates as a universal foundation to invest in the transformative technologies shaping the future of humanity. The firm sits at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and next-generation consumer platforms. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Easton, PA.
info.description_zh: Evenco Holdings, Inc. 是一個投資塑造人類未來的變革性技術的全球基金會。該公司位於區塊鏈基礎設施、人工智慧和下一代消費者平台的交叉點。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伊斯頓。

info.description: GoDaddy, Inc. engages in the provision of simple and easy-to-use products on a single technology platform, complemented by personalized guidance. It operates through the following segments: Applications and Commerce (A&C) and Core Platform (Core). The Applications and Commerce (A&C) segment sells products containing proprietary software, commerce solutions, third-party email services, productivity tools, and certain products bundled with proprietary software offerings. The Core Platform (Core) segment provides domain registrations and renewals, aftermarket domain sales, website hosting services, website security products that are not included in bundled proprietary software offerings, and other products that do not contain a software component. The company was founded by Robert R. Parsons in 1997 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: GoDaddy, Inc. 致力於在單一技術平台上提供簡單易用的產品，並輔以個人化指導。它透過以下部門運作：應用程式和商務（A＆C）以及核心平台（Core）。應用程式和商務 (A&C) 部門銷售的產品包含專有軟體、商務解決方案、第三方電子郵件服務、生產力工具以及與專有軟體產品捆綁在一起的某些產品。核心平台（核心）部門提供網域名稱註冊和續約、售後網域銷售、網站寄存服務、不包含在捆綁專有軟體產品中的網站安全產品以及其他不包含軟體元件的產品。該公司由 Robert R. Parsons 於 1997 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Daily Covered Call Index. The index is designed to replicate the performance of an investment strategy that combines a long position in the Nasdaq-100 Index with a short position in Nasdaq-100 Index call options. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 高收入 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 每日備兌買權指數表現的投資結果。該指數旨在複製將納斯達克 100 指數多頭頭寸與納斯達克 100 指數看漲期權空頭頭寸相結合的投資策略的績效。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於指數的組成證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Harmonic, Inc. engages in the development and sale of video delivery software, products, system solutions, and services. It operates through the Video and Broadband segments. The Video segment sells video processing and production and playout services to cable operators, satellite and telecommunications pay-TV service providers, and broadcast and media companies. The Broadband segment offers solutions to cable operators broadband access solutions and related services, including cOS software-based broadband access solution, to broadband operators globally. The company was founded in June 1988 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Harmonic, Inc. 從事視訊傳輸軟體、產品、系統解決方案和服務的開發和銷售。它透過視訊和寬頻部門運作。 The Video segment sells video processing and production and playout services to cable operators, satellite and telecommunications pay-TV service providers, and broadcast and media companies. The Broadway segment accers solutions toelmoc​​ion sar​​st the grautionsirutions 比這software-based broadband access solution, to broadband operators globally.該公司成立於 1988 年 6 月，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: YieldMax Nasdaq 100 0DTE Covered Call Strategy ETF seeks current income; the fund's secondary objective being capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by employing a synthetic covered call strategy, designed to generate current income on a weekly basis while also providing exposure to the price return of the Nasdaq 100 Index. In executing this strategy, the manager will utilize call options that reference the Index or on passively managed ETFs that seek to track the index's performance ("index ETFs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: YieldMax Nasdaq 100 0DTE 備兌買權策略 ETF 尋求當前收益；該基金的次要目標是資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用綜合備兌買權策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在每週產生當前收入，同時還提供納斯達克 100 指數價格回報的曝險。在執行該策略時，管理人將利用參考指數或尋求追蹤指數表現的被動管理 ETF（「指數 ETF」）的看漲選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SMCI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Super Micro Computer, Inc. (Nasdaq: SMCI"). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by entering into swap agreements on the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SMCI ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前，獲得 Super Micro Computer, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SMCI”）股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金 (“ETF”)，試圖通過簽訂基礎證券掉期百分比來實現平均證券掉期百分比的兩倍 (20%)。

info.description: AIR Global Plc engages in the provision of branded flavored molasses (commonly known as "hookah", "shisha" or "mu'assel"), a tobacco-based mixture that is commonly around 15% to 25% tobacco by weight and typically inhaled via a water pipe. It operates through the following segments: Core-Americas, Core-Europe, Core-Middle East, Africa, and Asia (MEAA), and New Growth Categories. The Core-Americas segment Includes the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco and other non-New Growth Categories ("non-NGC") brands, distributed in the Americas through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The Core-Europe segment refers to the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco under the Al Fakher and other non-NGC brands, distributed throughout Europe through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The Core-Middle East, Africa, and Asia segment focuses on the the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco under the Al Fakher and other non-NGC brands, distributed throughout the Middle East through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The New Growth Categories segment covers the Group's offering under the OOKA brand (including proprietary devices and related consumables), modern oral nicotine pouches, and both nicotine and non-nicotine inhalation devices under the VANT and Crown Switch brands. The company was founded on October 28, 2025 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
info.description_zh: AIR Global Plc 從事品牌風味糖蜜（通常稱為「水煙」、「水煙」或「mu'assel」）的供應，這是一種基於菸草的混合物，通常含有約 15% 至 25% 的菸草重量，通常透過水管吸入。它透過以下部門運作：核心美洲部門、核心歐洲部門、核心中東、非洲和亞洲部門 (MEAA) 以及新增長類別部門。核心美洲部門包括傳統水煙菸草和其他非新增長類別（「非NGC」）品牌的生產和銷售，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道在美洲分銷。核心歐洲部門是指生產和銷售 Al Fakher 和其他非 NGC 品牌的傳統水煙，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道分銷到整個歐洲。核心中東、非洲和亞洲部門專注於生產和銷售 Al Fakher 和其他非 NGC 品牌的傳統水煙，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道分銷到整個中東地區。新成長類別部門涵蓋集團以 OOKA 品牌提供的產品（包括專有設備和相關消耗品）、現代口服尼古丁袋，以及 VANT 和 Crown Switch 品牌下的尼古丁和非尼古丁吸入設備。該公司成立於2025年10月28日，總部位於阿拉伯聯合大公國杜拜。

info.description: International Money Express, Inc. engages in the provision of money transmittal services. It offers online money transfer, in person wire transfer, check processing, prepaid debit card, bill payment, and telewire services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: International Money Express, Inc. 從事提供貨幣傳輸服務。它提供線上匯款、親自電匯、支票處理、預付借記卡、帳單支付和電話電匯服務。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long SMCI Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Super Micro Computer Inc. (NASDAQ: SMCI). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long SMCI Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Super Micro Computer Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SMCI）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment and Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment. The Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical, and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products in the United States. The Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health brand medical, surgical, and laboratory products, which are sold in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia, and other markets. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和專業解決方案部門以及全球醫療產品和分銷部門運營。製藥和專業解決方案部門在美國分銷品牌和仿製藥、專業藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。全球醫療產品和分銷部門生產、採購和分銷 Cardinal Health 品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品，這些產品銷往美國、加拿大、歐洲、亞洲和其他市場。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: Pharming Group NV is a holding company, which engages in the development of pharmaceutical products for the treatment of rare diseases and unmet medical needs. The firm offers RUCONEST, which is a recombinant human C1-esterase inhibitor for the treatment of acute hereditary angioedema. It operates through the following segments: RUCONEST, Joenja, Europe, and Rest of the World. The company was founded on November 11, 1988, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: Pharming Group NV 是一家控股公司，從事治療罕見疾病和未滿足醫療需求的藥品開發。該公司提供 RUCONEST，這是一種重組人類 C1 酯酶抑制劑，用於治療急性遺傳性血管性水腫。它透過以下部門運作：RUCONEST、Joenja、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司成立於1988年11月11日，總部位於荷蘭萊頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BLSH Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BLSH. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the underlying security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of the underlying security, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BLSH 每日 ETF 尋求 BLSH 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些證券和金融工具結合起來提供標的證券價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: ALPS Electrification Infrastructure ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the performance of the Ladenburg Thalmann Electrification Infrastructure Index. The underlying index utilizes a proprietary, rules-based methodology developed by Ladenburg Thalmann Index, LLC (the "index provider"), which is designed to measure the performance of publicly-listed large-capitalization and mid-capitalization companies that are positioned to benefit from "electrification". The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in securities that comprise the underlying index.
info.description_zh: ALPS 電氣化基礎設施 ETF 尋求與 Ladenburg Thalmann 電氣化基礎設施指數表現大致相符的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。基礎指數採用由 Ladenburg Thalmann Index, LLC（「指數提供者」）開發的專有的、基於規則的方法，旨在衡量那些有望從「電氣化」中受益的上市大市值和中市值公司的業績。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成基礎指數的證券。

info.description: Connect Biopharma Holdings Ltd. operates as clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on advancing rademikibart, an anti-interleukin-4-receptor alpha antibody, to transform acute and chronic care in asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. The company was founded by Zheng Wei and Wu Bin Pan on November 23, 2015 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Connect Biopharma Holdings Ltd. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它專注於推進 rademikibart（一種抗白細胞介素 4 受體 α 抗體）的發展，以改變氣喘和慢性阻塞性肺病的急性和慢性護理。該公司由鄭偉和潘吳斌於2015年11月23日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

Alico, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operations of agriculture, land management, and natural resources. It operates through the Alico Citrus, and Land Management and Other Operations segments. The Alico Citrus segment cultivates citrus trees to produce citrus for delivery to the processed and fresh citrus markets. The Land Management and Other Operations segment offers land leasing for recreational and grazing purposes, conservation, and mining activities. The company was founded on February 29, 1960 and is headquartered in Fort Myers, FL.
info.description_zh: Alico, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事農業、土地管理和自然資源業務。它透過 Alico Citrus 以及土地管理和其他營運部門進行運作。 Alico Citrus 部門種植柑橘樹來生產柑橘，然後運送到加工和新鮮柑橘市場。土地管理和其他營運部門提供娛樂和放牧、保護和採礦活動的土地租賃。該公司成立於 1960 年 2 月 29 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁爾斯堡。

info.description: Ramaco Resources, Inc. engages in the operation and development of coal mining properties. The firm deals with metallurgical coal in central and southern West Virginia, southwestern Virginia and southwestern Pennsylvania. Its portfolio consists of Elk Creek, Berwind, RAM Mine, and Knox Creek. The company was founded by Randall W. Atkins in 2015 and is headquartered in Lexington, KY.
info.description_zh: Ramaco Resources, Inc. 從事煤礦資產的營運和開發。該公司在西維吉尼亞州中部和南部、維吉尼亞州西南部和賓夕法尼亞州西南部經營冶金煤。其投資組合包括 Elk Creek、Berwind、RAM Mine 和 Knox Creek。該公司由 Randall W. Atkins 於 2015 年創立，總部位於肯塔基州列剋星敦。

info.description: Alpha Architect U.S. Quantitative Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Adviser employs a multi-step, quantitative, rules-based methodology to identify a portfolio of approximately 50 to 100 equity securities with the highest relative momentum. A "momentum" style of investing emphasizes investing in securities that have had higher recent total return performance compared to other securities. The Adviser then employs proprietary screens to eliminate companies with issues that may negatively impact their momentum. The fund may also invest up to 20% of its assets in cash and cash equivalents, other investment companies, as well as securities and other instruments.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect美國量化動量ETF尋求長期資本增值。該顧問採用多步驟、定量、基於規則的方法來確定由大約 50 至 100 種相對動量最高的股票證券組成的投資組合。 「動量」投資風格強調投資於近期總回報表現高於其他證券的證券。然後，顧問採用專有篩選來消除存在可能對其發展勢頭產生負面影響的問題的公司。該基金還可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於現金和現金等價物、其他投資公司以及證券和其他工具。

info.description: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the IPOX  International Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market-cap weighted portfolio measuring the performance of the top 50 companies domiciled outside the United States ranked quarterly by market capitalization in the IPOX  Global Composite Index and represents, on average, 25% of the total market capitalization of the base index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 IPOX International Index 的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是一個市值加權投資組合，衡量美國境外註冊的前 50 名公司的業績，按季度在 IPOX 全球綜合指數中的市值排名，平均佔基礎指數總市值的 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IREN Ltd. is a vertically integrated data center business powering the future of Bitcoin, AI and beyond with renewable energy. It is strategically located in renewable-rich, fiber-connected regions across the US and Canada. IREN's large-scale, grid-connected facilities are purpose-built for the next generation of power-dense computing applications. The company was founded by Daniel Roberts and William Roberts on November 6, 2018, and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
info.description_zh: IREN Ltd. 是一家垂直整合的資料中心企業，透過再生能源為比特幣、人工智慧及其他領域的未來提供動力。它地理位置優越，位於美國和加拿大可再生能源豐富、光纖連接的地區。 IREN 的大型併網設施專為新一代功率密集運算應用而建置。該公司由丹尼爾·羅伯茨和威廉·羅伯茨於2018年11月6日創立，總部位於澳洲雪梨。

info.description: Isabella Bank Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services through its subsidiary. It offers checking accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, direct deposits, cash management services, mobile and internet banking, electronic bill pay services, and automated teller machines. It operates through the following segments: Commercial, Agricultural, Residential Real Estate, and Consumer. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Mount Pleasant, MI.
info.description_zh: 伊莎貝拉銀行公司是一家控股公司，透過其子公司提供金融服務。它提供支票帳戶、儲蓄帳戶、存款證、直接存款、現金管理服務、行動和網路銀行、電子帳單支付服務和自動櫃員機。它透過以下部門運作：商業部門、農業部門、住宅房地產部門和消費者部門。該公司成立於 1903 年，總部位於密西根州芒特普萊森特。

info.description: JFrog Ltd. engages in the provision of an end-to-end, hybrid, universal development operations platform that powers and controls the software supply chain, which enables organizations to continuously and securely deliver software updates across any system. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Israel, India, and Rest of World. It is also involved in creating software delivered without friction from developer to device. The company was founded by Frederic Simon, Shlomi Ben Haim, and Yoav Landman in 2008 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: JFrog Ltd. 致力於提供端到端、混合、通用的開發營運平台，該平台支援和控制軟體供應鏈，使組織能夠在任何系統上持續、安全地交付軟體更新。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、以色列、印度和世界其他地區。它還參與創建從開發人員到設備之間無摩擦交付的軟體。該公司由 Frederic Simon、Shlomi Ben Haim 和 Yoav Landman 於 2008 年創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Dolphin Entertainment, Inc. engages in the provision of entertainment marketing and content development. It operates through the following segments: Entertainment Publicity and Marketing, and Content Production. The Entertainment Publicity and Marketing segment consists of 42West, The Door, Elle, Digital Department, Special Projects, and Shore Fire Media. The Content Production segment consists of Dolphin Films and a department within Dolphin which develops, produces, and distributes feature films, television and digital content. The company was founded on March 7, 1995 and is headquartered in Coral Gables, FL.
info.description_zh: Dolphin Entertainment, Inc. 從事提供娛樂行銷和內容開發。它透過以下部門運作：娛樂宣傳和行銷以及內容製作。娛樂宣傳和行銷部門由 42West、The Door、Elle、數位部門、Special Projects 和 Shore Fire Media 組成。內容製作部門由 Dolphin Films 和 Dolphin 內負責開發、製作和發行長片、電視和數位內容的部門組成。該公司成立於1995年3月7日，總部位於佛羅裡達州科勒爾蓋布爾斯。

info.description: Global X Data Center REITs & Digital Infrastructure ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Data Center REITs & Digital Infrastructure Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes, in the securities of the Solactive Data Center REITs & Digital Infrastructure Index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the fields of data centers, cellular towers, and/or digital infrastructure hardware. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 資料中心 REIT 和數位基礎設施 ETF 尋求提供與 Solactive 資料中心 REIT 和數位基礎設施指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和支出）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於 Solactive Data Center REITs 和數位基礎設施指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該指數旨在為在資料中心、蜂窩塔和/或數位基礎設施硬體領域開展業務的公司提供投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is an equal-weighted index composed of the securities comprising the NASDAQ-100 Index that are classified as "technology" according to the Industry Classification Benchmark classification system.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是一個等權重指數，由納斯達克 100 指數中根據行業分類基準分類系統歸類為「科技」的證券組成。

info.description: Smart Sand, Inc. engages in supplying frac sand and related services. The firm offers complete mine to wellsite proppant supply and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: Sand and SmartSystems. The Sand segment includes both frac sand sales and IPS sales. The SmartSystems segment focuses on the rental of patented SmartSystems equipment and related services provided to customers. The company was founded by Charles E. Young on July 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Yardley, PA.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Smart Sand, Inc. 從事供應壓裂砂及相關服務。該公司提供完整的礦山到井場支撐劑供應和物流解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Sand 部門和 SmartSystems 部門。砂子部門包括壓裂砂銷售和 IPS 銷售。 SmartSystems 部門專注於向客戶提供專利的 SmartSystems 設備的租賃和相關服務。該公司由 Charles E. Young 於 2011 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州亞德利。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: META) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying META ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF 尋求當前收入；暴露於一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Meta Platforms, Inc. A 類（納斯達克股票代碼：META）普通每日百分比的 2 倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益股票的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎 META ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lantronix, Inc. engages in the provision of software as a service (SaaS), engineering services, and hardware for Edge Computing, the Internet of Things (IoT), and Remote Environment Management (REM). Its services include Embedded IoT Solutions, IoT Systems Solutions, and Software and Engineering Services. The company was founded by Bernhard Bruscha in June 1989 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Lantronix, Inc. 致力於為邊緣運算、物聯網 (IoT) 和遠端環境管理 (REM) 提供軟體即服務 (SaaS)、工程服務和硬體。其服務包括嵌入式物聯網解決方案、物聯網系統解決方案以及軟體和工程服務。該公司由 Bernhard Bruscha 於 1989 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Cohu, Inc. engages in the provision of back-end semiconductor equipment and services. It offers test and handling capital equipment, interface products, and related services to the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cohu, Inc. 從事提供後端半導體設備和服務。它為半導體和電子製造業提供測試和處理資本設備、介面產品以及相關服務。該公司成立於 1947 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Heritage Global, Inc. engages in the provision of corporate and financial asset liquidation transactions, valuations, and advisory services. It operates through the following segments: Auction and Liquidation, Refurbishment and Resale, Brokerage, and Specialty Lending. The Auction and Liquidation segment focuses on operating a global full-service auction, appraisal, and asset advisory firm, including the acquisition of turnkey manufacturing facilities and used industrial machinery and equipment. The Refurbishment and Resale segment acquires, refurbishes, and supplies specialized laboratory equipment. The Brokerage segment manages charged-off receivables in the U.S. and Canada on behalf of financial institutions. The Specialty Lending segment provides specialty financing solutions to investors in charged-off and non-performing asset portfolios. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Heritage Global, Inc. 從事提供企業和金融資產清算交易、估值和諮詢服務。它透過以下部門運作：拍賣和清算、翻新和轉售、經紀和專業貸款。拍賣和清算部門​​專注於經營一家全球全方位服務拍賣、評估和資產諮詢公司，包括收購交鑰匙製造設施和二手工業機械和設備。翻新和轉售部門收購、翻新和供應專業實驗室設備。經紀部門代表金融機構管理美國和加拿大的應收帳款。專業貸款部門為沖銷和不良資產組合的投資者提供專業融資解決方案。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 100 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 1,000 securities of the largest constituents by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index 的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 100 檔證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數中市值最大的成分股的約 1,000 只合格證券。

info.description: Research Solutions, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of a cloud-based software-as-a-service research platform and sale of published scientific, technical, and medical content. It also develops proprietary software, information logistics technology backbone, and Internet-based interfaces. The company was founded by Peter Victor Derycz on November 2, 2006 and is headquartered in Henderson, NV.
info.description_zh: Research Solutions, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供基於雲端的軟體即服務研究平台以及銷售已出版的科學、技術和醫學內容。它還開發專有軟體、資訊物流技術骨幹和基於互聯網的介面。該公司由 Peter Victor Derycz 於 2006 年 11 月 2 日創立，總部位於內華達州亨德森。

info.description: DraftKings, Inc. is a digital sports entertainment and gaming company, which engages in the provision of online sports betting, online casino, daily fantasy sports product offerings, DraftKings Marketplace, retail sportsbook, media, and other consumer product offerings. The company was founded by Jason D. Robins, Matthew Kalish, and Paul Liberman on December 31, 2011 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: DraftKings, Inc.是一家數位運動娛樂和遊戲公司，從事提供線上體育博彩、線上賭場、每日夢幻體育產品、DraftKings Marketplace、零售體育博彩、媒體和其他消費性產品。該公司由 Jason D. Robins、Matthew Kalish 和 Paul Liberman 於 2011 年 12 月 31 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: First Trust RBA American Industrial RenaissanceTM ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Richard Bernstein Advisors American Industrial Renaissance  Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the equity securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to measure the performance of small and mid cap U.S. companies in the industrial and community banking sectors.
info.description_zh: First Trust RBA American Industrial RenaissanceTM ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Richard Bernstein Advisors American Industrial Renaissance Index（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和支出之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的股本證券。該指數旨在衡量美國中小型企業在工業和社區銀行領域的表現。

info.description: McKesson Corp. engages in providing healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology and Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions (RxTS), and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The North American Pharmaceutical segment focuses on distribution of branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar and over-the-counter pharmaceutical drugs to customers in U.S. and Canada. The Oncology and Multispecialty segment includes provision of solutions that includes specialty drug distribution, group purchasing organizations, infusion services, direct to patient pharmacy capabilities, InspiroGene cell and gene therapy services, technology solutions, practice consulting services, and vaccine distribution. The RxTS segment focuses on solving medication access, affordability, and adherence challenges for patients by working across healthcare to connect patients, pharmacies, providers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, and biopharma companies. The Medical-Surgical Solutions segment provides medical-surgical supply distribution, logistics, and other services to healthcare providers. The company was founded by John McKesson and Charles Olcott in 1833 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: McKesson Corp. 從事提供醫療保健服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：北美製藥部門、腫瘤學和多專科部門、處方技術解決方案（RxTS）部門和醫療外科解決方案部門。北美製藥部門專注於向美國和加拿大的客戶分銷品牌藥品、仿製藥、特殊藥品、生物相似藥和非處方藥品。腫瘤學和多專科部門提供的解決方案包括特殊藥物分銷、團體採購組織、輸液服務、直接面向患者的藥房能力、InspiroGene 細胞和基因治療服務、技術解決方案、實踐諮詢服務和疫苗分銷。 RxTS 部門專注於透過跨醫療保健領域連接患者、藥房、提供者、藥品福利管理者、健康計劃和生物製藥公司，解決患者的藥物取得、負擔能力和依從性挑戰。醫療外科解決方案部門為醫療保健提供者提供醫療外科用品分銷、物流和其他服務。該公司由 John McKesson 和 Charles Olcott 於 1833 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Kopin Corp. engages in the development, manufacture and sale of wearable technologies which include components and systems. Its portfolio includes AMLCD, LCOS displays, OLED displays, ASIC, backlights, and optical lenses. The firm uses semiconductor material technology to design, manufacture and market its component products for use in military, enterprise and consumer electronic applications, training and simulation equipment and 3D metrology equipment. The company was founded by John C.C. Fan on April 23, 1984 and is headquartered in Westborough, MA.
info.description_zh: Kopin Corp. 從事穿戴式技術（包括組件和系統）的開發、製造和銷售。其產品組合包括 AMLCD、LCOS 顯示器、OLED 顯示器、ASIC、背光和光學鏡頭。該公司利用半導體材料技術設計、製造和銷售其組件產品，用於軍事、企業和消費性電子應用、培訓和模擬設備以及 3D 計量設備。該公司由 John C.C. 創立。 Fan 於 1984 年 4 月 23 日成立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州韋斯特伯勒。

info.description: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company. It engages in the provision of structure-guided drug design with the goal of developing oral small-molecule and protein therapeutics to target difficult-to-treat rare diseases. The company was founded by William M. Spencer III, Charles E. Bugg, and John A. Montgomery in 1986 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生技公司。它致力於提供結構指導的藥物設計，目標是開發口服小分子和蛋白質療法來治療難以治療的罕見疾病。該公司由 William M. Spencer III、Charles E. Bugg 和 John A. Montgomery 於 1986 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: Tema Electrification ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, which include borrowings for investment purposes, common and preferred stocks of publicly listed companies that are directly or indirectly economically tied to global electrification. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tema Electrification ETF 尋求提供長期資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過投資至少80%的淨資產來實現其投資目標，其中包括用於投資目的的借款、與全球電氣化經濟直接或間接相關的上市公司的普通股和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance AI & Power Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the MarketVector US Listed AI and Power Infrastructure Index. The index is a thematic index tracking the performance of U.S. exchange-listed companies contributing to critical electrical grid, artificial intelligence ("AI") and data infrastructure through decentralized energy technologies, electrical utilities and related components and construction, data center operations, and AI-related computing hardware. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets will be invested in securities of AI & Power Infrastructure Companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance AI 和電力基礎設施 ETF 旨在追蹤 MarketVector 美國上市的 AI 和電力基礎設施指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數是主題指數，追蹤美國交易所上市公司透過去中心化能源技術、電力公用事業及相關組件和建設、資料中心營運以及人工智慧相關運算硬體為關鍵電網、人工智慧（「AI」）和資料基礎設施做出貢獻的業績。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%將投資於人工智慧和電力基礎設施公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Purecycle Technologies, Inc. engages in recycling waste polypropylene into virgin polymer. Its process includes two steps: Feed Pre-Processing and the use of the Technology for purification. The company was founded by John Scott in September 2015 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Purecycle Technologies, Inc. 致力於將廢棄聚丙烯回收成原始聚合物。其製程包括兩個步驟：飼料預處理和利用此技術進行純化。該公司由 John Scott 於 2015 年 9 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Everspin Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of magnetoresistive random access memory (MRAM) solutions. Its products include Toggle MRAM, Spin-transfer Torque MRAM, TMR Sensors, and Embedded MRAM. The company was founded by Saied Tehrani on May 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: Everspin Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供磁阻隨機存取記憶體 (MRAM) 解決方案。其產品包括切換 MRAM、自旋轉移扭矩 MRAM、TMR 感測器和嵌入式 MRAM。該公司由 Saied Tehrani 於 2008 年 5 月 16 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: ProShares UltraPro QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to three times (3x) the daily performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index includes 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraPro QQQ 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 NASDAQ-100 指數每日表現的三倍 (3x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數包括納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司（按市值計算）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. operates as a blank check company. The company was founded on December 13, 2024 and is headquartered in Cornelius, NC.
info.description_zh: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。該公司成立於2024年12月13日，總部位於北卡羅來納州科尼利厄斯。

info.description: Teradyne, Inc. engages in the development and sale of automatic test systems. It operates through the following business segments: Semiconductor Test, Robotics, and All Other. The Semiconductor Test segment designs, manufactures, and markets semiconductor test products and services. The Robotics segment includes operations related to the design, manufacturing, and marketing of collaborative robotic arms, autonomous mobile robots, and advanced robotic control software. The company was founded by Alexander V. d'Arbeloff and Nicholas DeWolf in 1960 and is headquartered in North Reading, MA.
info.description_zh: Teradyne, Inc. 從事自動測試系統的開發和銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：半導體測試、機器人和所有其他業務。半導體測試部門設計、製造和銷售半導體測試產品和服務。機器人部門包括與協作機器人手臂、自主移動機器人和先進機器人控制軟體的設計、製造和行銷相關的業務。該公司由 Alexander V. d'Arbeloff 和 Nicholas DeWolf 於 1960 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州北雷丁。

info.description: XBiotech, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutic antibodies. Its product pipeline includes oncology, infectious diseases, dermatology and inflammatory disorders. The company was founded by John Simard on March 22, 2005 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: XBiotech, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事治療性抗體的開發和商業化。其產品線包括腫瘤學、傳染病學、皮膚病學和發炎性疾病。該公司由 John Simard 於 2005 年 3 月 22 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: NestYield Visionary ETF seeks long-term growth; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek current income. The fund's strategy involves two components: (1) purchasing a portfolio of equity securities either directly, or "synthetically" by using options to gain exposure to one or more equity securities; and (2) generating income through an options portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: NestYield Visionary ETF尋求長期成長；該基金的次要投資目標是尋求當前收入。本基金的策略涉及兩個組成部分：(1) 直接購買股權證券投資組合，或透過使用選擇權「綜合」購買一種或多種股權證券； (2) 透過選擇權投資組合產生收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VirTra, Inc. is a provider of judgmental use of force training simulators, firearms training simulators and driving simulators for law enforcement, military, educational and commercial markets. Its simulators use software, hardware and content to create realistic training that does not require live ammunition or less-than-lethal munitions. It operates through the following segments: Simulators and Accessories, Extended Service-type Warranties, Customized Software and Custom Content, Installation and Training, Design and Prototyping, and Subscription Training Equipment Partnership. The company was founded by Robert D. Ferris in May 1993 and headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: VirTra, Inc. 是一家為執法、軍事、教育和商業市場提供武力判斷使用訓練模擬器、槍械訓練模擬器和駕駛模擬器的提供者。其模擬器使用軟體、硬體和內容來創建不需要實彈或非致命彈藥的真實訓練。它透過以下部門運作：模擬器和配件、擴展服務型保固、客製化軟體和客製化內容、安裝和培訓、設計和原型製作以及訂閱培訓設備合作夥伴關係。該公司由 Robert D. Ferris 於 1993 年 5 月創立，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: SEALSQ Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the security of microcontrollers. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and Latin America. It focuses on authentication process, digital certification, and covering individual patents of semiconductors. The company was founded on April 1, 2022 and is headquartered in Cointrin, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: SEALSQ Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事微控制器安全業務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東、非洲、亞太地區和拉丁美洲。它專注於認證過程、數位認證，並涵蓋半導體的個人專利。該公司成立於2022年4月1日，總部位於瑞士科因特林。

info.description: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Semiconductor ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the semiconductor industry and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Semiconductor ESG 篩選指數的表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數投資方法，尋求與相關指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在半導體行業開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Photronics, Inc. engages in the provision of photomasks, which are quartz or glass plates containing microscopic images of electronic circuits for use in the fabrication of integrated circuits and flat-panel displays. The company was founded by Constantine S. Macricostas in 1969 and is headquartered in Brookfield, CT.
info.description_zh: Photronics, Inc. 從事提供光掩模業務，光掩模是包含電子電路顯微圖像的石英或玻璃板，用於製造積體電路和平板顯示器。該公司由 Constantine S. Macricostas 於 1969 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州布魯克菲爾德。

info.description: Laser Photonics Corp. engages in the business of manufacturing, research, and development of industrial laser technologies and systems. The firm offers operations that enable customers to reduce development and advanced laser equipment manufacturing time, achieve better pricing, maintain quality control, and protect proprietary know-how and technology compared to other laser cleaning companies and competing technologies. The company was founded on November 8, 2019 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.

info.description_zh: Laser Photonics Corp. 從事工業雷射技術和系統的製造、研究和開發業務。與其他雷射清潔公司和競爭技術相比，該公司提供的業務使客戶能夠減少開發和先進雷射設備的製造時間、實現更好的定價、保持品質控制並保護專有知識和技術。該公司成立於2019年11月8日，總部位於佛羅裡達州瑪麗湖。

info.description: Sidus Space, Inc. is a space-as-a-service company. The firm focuses on commercial satellite design, manufacture, launch planning, mission operations and in-orbit support, and data collection with a vision to demonstrate space operations for new technologies, and deliver data and predictive analytics to both domestic and global customers. The company was founded by Carol M. Craig on July 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Merritt Island, FL.
info.description_zh: Sidus Space, Inc. 是一家空間即服務公司。該公司專注於商業衛星設計、製造、發射規劃、任務操作和在軌支援以及數據收集，旨在展示新技術的空間操作，並向國內和全球客戶提供數據和預測分析。該公司由 Carol M. Craig 於 2012 年 7 月 17 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州梅里特島。

info.description: Schmid Group NV provides industrial equipment and services. It operates through following Technical equipment and processes; and Spare parts and services segments. The Technical equipment and processes segment includes mainly the sale of machines including installation and extended warranties. The Spare parts and services segment includes the sale of spare parts as well as services including repairs, modifications of machines and inspections. The company was founded in 1864 and is headquartered in Freudenstadt, Germany.
info.description_zh: Schmid Group NV 提供工業設備和服務。它透過以下技術設備和流程運作；備件和服務部門。技術設備和工藝部門主要包括機器銷售，包括安裝和延長保固。備件和服務部門包括備件銷售以及維修、機器改裝和檢查等服務。該公司成立於1864年，總部位於德國弗羅伊登施塔特。

info.description: Himax Technologies, Inc. is a semiconductor solution provider dedicated to display imaging processing technologies. It operates through the Driver Integrated Circuit and Non-Driver Products segments. The company's products include display drivers, timing controllers, wafer level optics, video and display technology solutions, liquid crystal over silicon silicon, complementary metal-oxide semiconductor image sensor, and power integrated circuit. Its products used in TVs, laptops, monitors, mobile phones, tablets, digital cameras, car navigation, virtual reality (VR) devices and many other consumer electronics devices. Himax Technologies was founded by Biing Seng Wu and Jordan Wu on June 12, 2001 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: 奇景光電 (Himax Technologies, Inc.) 是一家致力於顯示影像處理技術的半導體解決方案供應商。它透過驅動器積體電路和非驅動器產品部門運作。該公司的產品包括顯示驅動器、時序控制器、晶圓級光學元件、視訊和顯示技術解決方案、矽基液晶、互補金屬氧化物半導體影像感測器和功率集成電路。其產品應用於電視、筆記型電腦、顯示器、手機、平板電腦、數位相機、汽車導航、虛擬實境（VR）設備和許多其他消費性電子設備。奇景科技由 Bing Seng Wu 和 Jordan Wu 於 2001 年 6 月 12 日創立，總部位於台灣台南。

info.description: Maris-Tech Ltd. engages in the business of developing, designing, and manufacturing digital video and audio products and solutions for the professional, civilian, and home security markets. The firm is also involved in the provision of video transmission technology with artificial intelligence and acceleration for edge platforms using digital video, audio, and wireless communication technologies. The company was founded by Israel Bar in May 2008 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Maris-Tech Ltd. 從事為專業、民用和家庭安全市場開發、設計和製造數位視訊和音訊產品及解決方案的業務。該公司還致力於為使用數位視訊、音訊和無線通訊技術的邊緣平台提供具有人工智慧和加速功能的視訊傳輸技術。該公司由 Israel Bar 於 2008 年 5 月創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Commvault Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of data protection, information management software applications, and related services. The firm offers platform, solution packages, use cases, and workloads. It operates through the United States and Other geographical segments. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Tinton Falls, NJ.
info.description_zh: Commvault Systems, Inc. 從事提供資料保護、資訊管理軟體應用程式和相關服務。該公司提供平台、解決方案包、用例和工作負載。它透過美國和其他地區的部門運作。該公司成立於 1996 年，總部位於新澤西州廷頓福爾斯。

info.description: Radware Ltd. engages in the provision of application security and delivery solutions for multi-cloud environments. The company's cloud application, infrastructure, and API security solutions use AI-driven algorithms for precise, hands-free, real-time protection from the most sophisticated web, application, and DDoS attacks, API abuse, and bad bots. It operates through the following segments: Radware's Core Business and Hawks' Business. The Radware's Core Business segment engages in providing cloud security-as-a-service products, application and data center security solutions, and application availability services. The Hawks' Business segment provides cloud security solutions, including threat detection, entitlement management, and posture management. The company was founded by Yehuda Zisapel and Roy Zisapel on May 16, 1996 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.

info.description: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company that develops and delivers GPU cloud computing and AI solutions. The company was founded on December 30, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，開發和提供 GPU 雲端運算和人工智慧解決方案。該公司成立於2024年12月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NU Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NU. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NU 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NU 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具結合起來提供 NU 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Richtech Robotics, Inc. engages in the development of robotics and artificial intelligence. The firm designs, manufactures, and sells robots to restaurants, hotels, senior living centers, casinos, factories, and movie theaters. Its robots perform a variety of services including restaurant running and bussing, hotel room service delivery, floor scrubbing and vacuuming, and beverage and food preparation. The company was founded by Zhen Wu Huang and Zhen Qiang Huang on July 19, 2016 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Richtech Robotics, Inc. 從事機器人和人工智慧的開發。該公司設計、製造並向餐廳、酒店、老年生活中心、賭場、工廠和電影院銷售機器人。其機器人執行各種服務，包括餐廳營運和公車、飯店客房服務交付、地板擦洗和吸塵、以及飲料和食物準備。該公司由黃真武和黃真強於2016年7月19日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the technology sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家科技業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Lam Research Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, refurbishment, and provision of semiconductor processing equipment used in the fabrication of integrated circuits.
