It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, China, Europe, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, and Taiwan. The company was founded by David K. Lam in 1980 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Lam Research Corp. 從事設計、製造、行銷、翻新和提供用於積體電路製造的半導體加工設備。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、中國、歐洲、日本、韓國、東南亞和台灣。該公司由 David K. Lam 於 1980 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long OSCR ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Oscar Health, Inc. - Class A (NYSE: OSCR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") where the fund manager attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. It aims to achieve this daily percentage change for a single day, and not for any other period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long OSCR ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Oscar Health, Inc. - A 類（NYSE：OSCR）股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），基金經理人試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。它的目標是在一天內實現每日百分比變化，而不是在任何其他時期內實現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BBAI Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of BBAI. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BBAI, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BBAI 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 BBAI 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BBAI 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ciena Corp. is a network technology company, which engages in the provision of hardware, software, and services to network operators, as well as enabling enhanced network capacity, service delivery, and automation. It operates through the following segments: Networking Platforms, Platform Software and Services, Blue Planet Automation Software and Services, and Global Services. The Networking Platforms segment consists of converged packet optical and packet networking portfolios. The Platform Software and Services segment provides analytics, data, and planning tools to assist customers in managing its networking platforms products. The Blue Planet Automation Software and Services segment enables customers to implement large-scale software and IT-led OSS transformations by transforming legacy networks into service ready networks. The Global Services segment offers a broad suite of value-added services. The company was founded by Patrick H. Nettles and Kevin Brian Kimberlin in 1992 and is headquartered in Hanover, MD.
info.description_zh: Ciena Corp. 是一家網路技術公司，致力於向網路營運商提供硬體、軟體和服務，並增強網路容量、服務交付和自動化。它透過以下部門運作：網路平台、平台軟體和服務、藍色星球自動化軟體和服務以及全球服務。網路平台部分由融合分組光纖和分組網路產品組合組成。平台軟體和服務部門提供分析、數據和規劃工具，以協助客戶管理其網路平台產品。 Blue Planet自動化軟體和服務部門使客戶能夠透過將傳統網路轉變為服務就緒網路來實施大規模軟體和IT主導的OSS轉型。全球服務部門提供廣泛的增值服務。該公司由 Patrick H. Nettles 和 Kevin Brian Kimberlin 於 1992 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州漢諾威。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ASML Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ASML. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to ASML, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ASML 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ASML 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 ASML 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Evaxion AS engages in the discovery and development of immunotherapies for cancer and infectious diseases. Its technologies include the immuno-oncology platform PIONEER, the bacterial disease platform EDEN, the viral disease platform RAVEN, and the proprietary AI platform technology ObsERV. The company was founded by Niels Iversen Moller and Andreas Holm Mattsson on August 11, 2008 and is headquartered in Hoersholm, Denmark.
info.description_zh: Evaxion AS 致力於癌症和傳染病免疫療法的發現和開發。其技術包括免疫腫瘤學平台PIONEER、細菌性疾病平台EDEN、病毒性疾病平台RAVEN以及專有的人工智慧平台技術ObsERV。該公司由 Niels Iversen Moller 和 Andreas Holm Mattsson 於 2008 年 8 月 11 日創立，總部位於丹麥霍爾斯霍爾姆。

info.description: Sandisk Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and provision of storage devices and solutions based on NAND flash technology. Its products include solid state drives, memory cards, and USB flash drives. The company was founded on February 5, 2024 and is headquartered in Milpitas, CA.
info.description_zh: Sandisk Corp. 從事開發、製造和提供基於 NAND 快閃記憶體技術的儲存設備和解決方案。其產品包括固態硬碟、記憶卡和USB隨身碟。該公司成立於 2024 年 2 月 5 日，總部位於加州米爾皮塔斯。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long IONQ ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of IonQ, Inc. (NYSE: IONQ). The fund is an actively managed ETF that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 IONQ ETF 尋求 IonQ, Inc.（NYSE：IONQ）每日股價變動百分比兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. engages in building a broadband cellular network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on an intellectual property and patent portfolio. It focuses on providing mobile broadband services with global coverage to all end-users, without the need to purchase special equipment. The company was founded by Abel Avellan on May 31, 2017 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.description_zh: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. 致力於在太空中建立寬頻蜂窩網絡，以便直接使用基於智慧財產權和專利組合的標準、未經修改的行動裝置進行操作。它專注於向所有最終用戶提供覆蓋全球的行動寬頻服務，而無需購買特殊設備。該公司由 Abel Avellan 於 2017 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long IONQ Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of IonQ, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x 多頭 IONQ 每日 ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 IonQ, Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Navitas Semiconductor Corp. engages in the development of ultra-efficient gallium nitride (GaN) semiconductors. Its GaN power ICs integrate GaN power with drive, control and protection to enable charging, power density, and energy savings for mobile, consumer, enterprise, eMobility and new energy markets. The company was founded by Daniel Kinzer, Nick Fichtenbaum, Gene Sheridan, and Jason Zhang on August 12, 2020 and is headquartered in Torrance, CA.
info.description_zh: Navitas Semiconductor Corp. 從事超高效氮化鎵 (GaN) 半導體的開發。其 GaN 功率 IC 將 GaN 功率與驅動、控制和保護整合在一起，為行動、消費者、企業、電動車和新能源市場實現充電、功率密度和節能。該公司由 Daniel Kinzer、Nick Fichtenbaum、Gene Sheridan 和 Jason Zhang 於 2020 年 8 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州托倫斯。

info.description: CECO Environmental Corp. engages in the provision of engineering technology and solutions. It offers services in the field of environment, energy, fluid handling, and filtration. The firm operates through the following segments: Engineered Systems and Industrial Process Solutions segment. The Engineered Systems segment serves the power generation, hydrocarbon processing, water/wastewater treatment, oily water separation and treatment, marine and naval vessels, and midstream oil and gas sectors. The Industrial Process Solutions segment serves the broad industrial sector with solutions for air pollution and contamination control, fluid handling, and process filtration in applications such as aluminum beverage can production, automobile production, food and beverage processing, semiconductor fabrication, electronics production, steel and aluminum mill processing, wood manufacturing, desalination, and aquaculture markets. The company was founded by Phillip DeZwirek in 1966 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: 希柯環保股份有限公司從事提供工程技術和解決方案。它提供環境、能源、流體處理和過濾領域的服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：工程系統和工業過程解決方案部門。工程系統部門服務於發電、碳氫化合物加工、水/廢水處理、含油水分離和處理、船舶和中游石油和天然氣領域。工業製程解決方案部門為廣泛的工業領域提供空氣污染和污染控制、流體處理和製程過濾解決方案，應用於鋁製飲料罐生產、汽車生產、食品和飲料加工、半導體製造、電子產品生產、鋼鐵和鋁廠加工、木材製造、海水淡化和水產養殖市場。該公司由 Phillip DeZwirek 於 1966 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Tenable Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of security software solutions. The firm offers Cyber Exposure which is a discipline for managing and measuring cybersecurity risk in the digital era. Its products include tenable.io, tenable.sc, tenable.ot, and nessus professional. The firm delivers solutions in the field of application security, cloud security, compliance, energy, finance, healthcare, and retail. It operates through the following geographical segments: The Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by John C. Huffard, Jr. and Renaud M. Deraison in 2002 and is headquartered in Columbia, MD.
info.description_zh: Tenable Holdings, Inc. 從事安全軟體解決方案的開發。該公司提供 Cyber​​ Exposure，這是一門用於管理和衡量數位時代網路安全風險的學科。其產品包括 tenable.io、tenable.sc、tenable.ot 和 nessus professional。該公司提供應用安全、雲端安全、合規性、能源、金融、醫療保健和零售領域的解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 John C. Huffard, Jr. 和 Renaud M. Deraison 於 2002 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州哥倫比亞。

info.description: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. engages in the development of connectivity solutions and products for the data infrastructure market. Its products include integrated circuits, active electrical cables, and SerDes chiplets. The company was founded by Chi Fung Cheng and Yat Tung Lam on 2008 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. 致力於為資料基礎設施市場開發連接解決方案和產品。其產品包括積體電路、主動電纜和 SerDes 小晶片。該公司由 Chi Fung Cheng 和 Yat Tung Lam 於 2008 年創立，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: Chaince Digital Holdings, Inc. engages in provision of financial advisory, capital markets advisory, brokerage-related services, and corporate consulting services to corporate clients and institutional investors globally. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Hong Kong, and People's Republic of China. The company was founded by Mao Dong Xu in 2011 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 暢思數位控股有限公司致力於為全球企業客戶和機構投資者提供財務諮詢、資本市場諮詢、經紀相關服務和企業諮詢服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、香港和中華人民共和國。該公司由毛東徐於2011年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Mercury Systems, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the delivery of processing technology for aerospace and defense missions. Its processing technologies include signal solutions, display, software applications, networking, storage, and secure processing. It operates through the following geographical segments: US, Asia Pacific, and Europe. The company was founded on July 14, 1981 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.
info.description_zh: Mercury Systems, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於為航空航太和國防任務提供處理技術。其處理技術包括訊號解決方案、顯示、軟體應用、網路、儲存和安全處理。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、亞太地區和歐洲。該公司成立於 1981 年 7 月 14 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州安多弗。

info.description: Camtek Ltd. engages in the business of developing and manufacturing high-end inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. The firm is also involved in inspecting integrated circuits and measuring its features on wafers throughout the production process of semiconductor devices, covering the front and mid-end and up to the beginning of assembly. The company was founded on October 21, 1987 and is headquartered in Migdal HaEmek, Israel.
info.description_zh: Camtek Ltd.從事半導體行業高端檢測和計量設備的開發和製造業務。該公司還參與在整個半導體裝置生產過程中檢查積體電路並測量其在晶圓上的特徵，涵蓋前端和中端直至組裝開始。該公司成立於1987年10月21日，總部位於以色列Migdal HaEmek。

info.description: Nebius Group NV is a technology company that provides infrastructure and services to AI builders worldwide. It offers Nebius AI, an AI-centric cloud platform provides full-stack infrastructure, including large-scale GPU clusters, cloud services, and developer tools. The company also operates through specialized brands: Toloka AI, which partners in data for generative AI development; TripleTen, an edtech platform focused on re-skilling individuals for tech careers; and Avride, which develops autonomous driving technology. Nebius Group was founded by Elena Kolmanovskaya, Ilya Segalovich, Mikhail Fadeev, and Arkady Volozh in 1989 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: Nebius Group NV 是一家為全球人工智慧建構者提供基礎設施和服務的科技公司。 Nebius AI是一個以AI為中心的雲端平台，提供全端基礎設施，包括大規模GPU叢集、雲端服務和開發者工具。該公司還透過專業品牌運營：Toloka AI，與生成人工智慧開發的數據合作； TripleTen，一個教育技術平台，專注於為個人提供技術職業再培訓；以及開發自動駕駛技術的 Avride。 Nebius 集團由 Elena Kolmanovskaya、Ilya Segalovich、Mikhail Fadeev 和 Arkady Volozh 於 1989 年創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: POET Technologies, Inc. engages in the designing, developing, manufacturing and sale of opto-electronic solutions for the sensing, data communications and telecommunications markets. It developed POET Optical Interposer platform, which allows the integration of electronic and photonic devices into a single multi-chip module. The company was founded on November 14, 1985 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: POET Technologies, Inc. 從事感測、數據通訊和電信市場的光電解決方案的設計、開發、製造和銷售。它開發了 POET 光學中介層平台，允許將電子和光子裝置整合到單一多晶片模組中。該公司成立於1985年11月14日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Wah Fu Education Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online exam preparation services and related technology solutions, and production of online training course materials. It operates through the Online Education Cloud Service (B2B2C) and Online Training Service (B2C). The B2B2C segment comprises online education platforms to institutions, such as universities, training institutions, and online course development service companies. The B2C segment provides online training and examination preparation services directly to students for a fee. The company was founded on July 23, 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 華富教育集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上考試準備服務和相關技術解決方案以及製作線上培訓課程材料。它透過線上教育雲端服務（B2B2C）和線上培訓服務（B2C）運作。 B2B2C 領域包括大學、培訓機構和線上課程開發服務公司等機構的線上教育平台。 B2C 部門直接向學生提供收費的線上培訓和考試準備服務。公司成立於2012年7月23日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Metals Royalty Co Inc. engages in the acquisition and management of critical metals and mineral royalties, streams, and other similar interests. The firm focuses on providing capital to support mineral security and independence in North America in support of accelerating domestic industry growth, including energy, defense and re-industrialization. It operates through Metal and Minerals, and Oil and Gas segments. The company was founded on October 27, 2022, and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.description_zh: Metals Royal Co Inc. 從事關鍵金屬和礦物特許權使用費、礦產資源和其他類似權益的收購和管理。該公司專注於提供資金支持北美的礦產安全和獨立，以支持加速國內工業成長，包括能源、國防和再工業化。它透過金屬和礦產以及石油和天然氣部門運作。該公司成立於2022年10月27日，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc operates as holding company that is engaged in the development, production, and distribution of data storage products and electronic data storage solutions. Its products include hard disk drives, solid state hybrid drives, solid state drives, peripheral component interconnect express cards, serial advanced technology attachment controllers, storage subsystems and computing solutions. The firm offers its products under the Backup Plus and Expansion product lines, and Maxtor and LaCie brands. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc 作為控股公司運營，從事資料儲存產品和電子資料儲存解決方案的開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括硬碟、固態混合​​驅動器、固態驅動器、週邊組件互連快速卡、串列先進技術附件控制器、儲存子系統和運算解決方案。該公司提供 Backup Plus 和 Expansion 產品線以及 Maxtor 和 LaCie 品牌的產品。該公司成立於1978年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Data Storage Corp. engages in the provision of business continuity services. These services include disaster recovery, infrastructure as a service, and cyber security. Its other services and solutions include data protection services, data center and security, voice and data solutions, and email archival solutions. The company was founded by Charles M. Piluso in June 2001 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Data Storage Corp. 從事提供業務連續性服務。這些服務包括災難復原、基礎設施即服務和網路安全。其其他服務和解決方案包括資料保護服務、資料中心和安全性、語音和資料解決方案以及電子郵件存檔解決方案。該公司由 Charles M. Piluso 於 2001 年 6 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Viavi Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of network test, monitoring, and assurance solutions for communications service providers, enterprises, network equipment manufacturers, government and avionics. It operates through the following segments: Network and Service Enablement, and Optical Security and Performance. The Network and Service Enablement segment provides an integrated portfolio of testing, monitoring, assurance and security solutions to help build, maintain and optimize telecom and datacom networks. The Optical Security and Performance segment leverages its core optical coating technologies and volume manufacturing capability to design, manufacture and sell technologies for the anti-counterfeiting, 3D sensing, government and aerospace, automotive and industrial markets. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: Viavi Solutions, Inc. 致力於為通訊服務供應商、企業、網路設備製造商、政府和航空電子設備提供網路測試、監控和保障解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：網路和服務支援以及光安全和效能。網路和服務支援部門提供測試、監控、保證和安全解決方案的整合產品組合，以協助建置、維護和最佳化電信和資料通訊網路。光學安全和性能部門利用其核心光學鍍膜技術和批量製造能力，為防偽、3D 感測、政府和航空航天、汽車和工業市場設計、製造和銷售技術。該公司成立於 1979 年，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long DELL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Dell Technologies Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long DELL Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為戴爾科技公司普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Semtech Corp. engages in the manufacture and supply of analog and mixed signal semiconductor products for high-end consumer, enterprise computing, communications, and industrial equipment. It operates through the following segments: Signal Integrity, Analog Mixed Signal and Wireless, and Internet of Things (IoT) Systems and Connectivity. The Signal Integrity segment includes designing, development, manufacturing, and marketing of a portfolio of optical and copper data communications and video transport products used in a wide variety of infrastructure and industrial applications. The Analog Mixed Signal and Wireless segment focus on designing, development, manufacturing, and marketing of transient voltage suppressors and specialized sensing products. The IoT Systems and Connectivity segment includes designing, development, operation, and marketing of a portfolio of IoT solutions that enable businesses to connect and manage devices, collect and analyze data, and improve decision-making. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Camarillo, CA.
info.description_zh: Semtech Corp. 致力於為高端消費、企業運算、通訊和工業設備製造和供應類比和混合訊號半導體產品。它透過以下部門運作：訊號完整性、類比混合訊號和無線、以及物聯網 (IoT) 系統和連接。訊號完整性部門包括設計、開發、製造和行銷用於各種基礎設施和工業應用的光和銅數據通訊以及視訊傳輸產品組合。類比混合訊號和無線部門專注於瞬態電壓抑制器和專用感測產品的設計、開發、製造和行銷。物聯網系統和連接部門包括物聯網解決方案組合的設計、開發、營運和行銷，使企業能夠連接和管理設備、收集和分析數據以及改善決策。該公司成立於 1960 年，總部位於加州卡馬裡奧。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long TER Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of TER. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of TER, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 TER 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 TER 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 TER 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: enCore Energy Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of resource properties. Its projects portfolio includes the Kingsville Dome, Rosita, Vasquez, Butler Ranch in Texas, Crownpoint & Hosta Butte, Nose Rock, Cebolleta, Juan Tafoya, West Largo, Ambrosia Lake-Treeline, Marquez, Checkerboard Mineral Rights in New Mexico, Moonshine Springs in Arizona, and White Canyon District in Utah. The company was founded on October 30, 2009 and is headquartered in Corpus Christi, TX.
info.description_zh: enCore Energy Corp. 從事資源資產的收購和勘探。其項目組合包括德克薩斯州的 Kingsville Dome、Rosita、Vasquez、Butler Ranch、Crownpoint & Hosta Butte、Nose Rock、Cebolleta、Juan Tafoya、West Largo、Ambrosia Lake-Treeline、Marquez、新墨西哥州的 Checkerboard Mineral Rights、亞利桑那州的 White Districtshine Springs 和猶他州的 White Canyon。該公司成立於2009年10月30日，總部位於德克薩斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂。

info.description: Quantinuum Inc. is a quantum computing platform that offers solutions like hardware platforms, developer tools, application libraries and solution-targeted intellectual property ("IP"). The company was founded on January 20, 2026 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Quantinuum Inc. 是一個量子運算平台，提供硬體平台、開發人員工具、應用程式庫和針對解決方​​案的智慧財產權（「IP」）等解決方案。該公司成立於2026年1月20日，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Profusa, Inc. engages in biofeedback for chronic disease management and healthy living services. The company is founded by Natalie Wisniewski and Bill McMillan and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: Profusa, Inc. 致力於慢性病管理和健康生活服務的生物回饋。該公司由 Natalie Wisniewski 和 Bill McMillan 創立，總部位於加州伯克利。

info.description: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in developing, producing, selling and installing sewage treatment systems and providing sewage treatment services. The firm operates through the Sewage Treatment Systems and Sewage Treatment Services and Others business lines. The Sewage Treatment Systems sells and installs proprietary rural sewage treatment systems and provides on-going operation and maintenance services to its customers. The Sewage Treatment Services and Others offers on-site treatment services with its mobile and fixed septic tank treatment systems. The company was founded on November 28, 2016, and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 大唐環保科技投資控股有限公司是一家從事污水處理系統開發、生產、銷售、安裝及提供污水處理服務的控股公司。該公司透過污水處理系統和污水處理服務及其他業務線運作。污水處理系統銷售和安裝專有的農村污水處理系統，並向客戶提供持續的營運和維護服務。污水處理服務及其他透過其移動和固定化糞池處理系統提供現場處理服務。公司成立於2016年11月28日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: HeartFlow, Inc. operates as a cardiovascular company which engages in diagnosing coronary artery diseases. The firm provides a patient-specific analysis of coronary blood flow utilizing coronary CT scans and proprietary computer algorithms based on computational fluid dynamics. The company was founded by Charles A. Taylor, Nathan M. Wilson, and Christopher K. Zarins in July 2007 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: HeartFlow, Inc. 是一家從事冠狀動脈疾病診斷的心血管公司。該公司利用冠狀動脈 CT 掃描和基於計算流體動力學的專有電腦演算法，提供針對患者的冠狀動脈血流分析。該公司由 Charles A. Taylor、Nathan M. Wilson 和 Christopher K. Zarins 於 2007 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: 4DMT operates as a clinical-stage genetic medicines company focused on inventing and developing genetic medicines to treat large market diseases in ophthalmology, pulmonology and cardiology. It develops genetic medicines using its proprietary invention platform, Therapeutic Vector Evolution. The company combines the power of the Nobel Prize-winning technology, directed evolution, with approximately one billion synthetic AAV capsid-derived sequences. Its product design, development and manufacturing engine creates a valuable and diverse product pipeline. The company is currently advancing five clinical-stage and two preclinical product candidates, each tailored to address rare and large market diseases. 4DMT was founded by David H. Kirn, Melissa Kotterman, Theresa Janke, and David Schaffer on September 12, 2013 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: 4DMT 是一家臨床階段基因藥物公司，專注於發明和開發基因藥物，以治療眼科、肺科和心臟病學等大型市場疾病。它利用其專有的發明平台「治療載體進化」開發基因藥物。該公司將獲得諾貝爾獎的技術、定向進化技術與大約十億個合成的 AAV 衣殼衍生序列相結合。其產品設計、開發和製造引擎創造了有價值且多樣化的產品線。該公司目前正在推進五種臨床階段和兩種臨床前候選產品，每種產品都是針對罕見和大型市場疾病量身定制的。 4DMT 由 David H. Kirn、Melissa Kotterman、Theresa Janke 和 David Schaffer 於 2013 年 9 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. provides public market investors with broad exposure to the programmable intellectual property economy in a regulated equity format. Its treasury reserve of digital tokens enables direct participation in the Story ecosystem, which supports on-chain registration, licensing, and monetization of intellectual property. The company was founded by Justin B. Stiefel and Jennifer D. H. Stiefel on July 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Gig Harbor, WA.
info.description_zh: IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. 以受監管的股權形式為公開市場投資者提供廣泛的可編程智慧財產權經濟投資機會。其數位代幣的財務儲備可以直接參與 Story 生態系統，支援智慧財產權的鏈上註冊、授權和貨幣化。該公司由 Justin B. Stiefel 和 Jennifer D. H. Stiefel 於 2011 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州吉格港。

info.description: Greenland Technologies Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture of drivetrain systems for material handling machineries and electric vehicles, as well as electric industrial vehicles. Its products include the GEF-series electric forklifts, a series of lithium-powered forklifts with three models ranging in size from 1.8 tons to 3.5 tons, and GEL-1800, a 1.8 ton rated load lithium-powered electric wheeled front loader and GEX-8000, an all-electric 8.0 ton rated load lithium-powered wheeled excavator. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in East Windsor, NJ.
info.description_zh: 格陵蘭科技控股公司從事物料搬運機械和電動汽車以及電動工業車輛傳動系統的製造。產品包括GEF系列電動堆高機、1.8噸至3.5噸三種型號的鋰動力堆高機、1.8噸額定載重鋰動力電動輪式裝載機GEL-1800及8.0噸額定載重全電動鋰動力輪式挖土機GEX-8000。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於新澤西州東溫莎。

info.description: CL Workshop Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in forest management, harvesting, and down-stream wood processing and distribution of logs, decking, flooring, and sawn timber products. Its products include wood decking, wood flooring, sawn timber, log, and charcoal. It operates through the Direct Purchase and Original Design Manufacturer (ODM), and Manufacturing Segments. The Direct Purchase and ODM segment represent sourcing of live wood and owning designed design on wood products for sale to end customers. The Manufacturing segment includes manufacturing decking, flooring, and sawn timbers. The company was founded on September 22, 2011 and is headquartered in Macau, China.
info.description_zh: CL Workshop Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事森林管理、採伐和下游木材加工以及原木、地板、地板和鋸材產品的分銷。其產品包括木地板、木地板、鋸材、原木和木炭。它透過直接採​​購和原始設計製造商 (ODM) 以及製造部門運作。直接採購和 ODM 部門代表採購活木材並擁有木製品的設計設計以銷售給最終客戶。製造部門包括製造裝飾板、地板和鋸材。該公司成立於2011年9月22日，總部位於中國澳門。

info.description: Alset, Inc. engages through its subsidiaries in the development of ehome communities and other property development, financial services, digital transformation technologies, biohealth activities and consumer products. It operates through the following business segments: Real Estate, Digital Transformation Technology, Biohealth, and Other Business. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the development of real estate projects near Houston, Texas. The Digital Transformation Technology segment focuses on serving business-to-business (B2B) needs in e-commerce, collaboration and social networking functions. The Biohealth segment includes the sale of consumer products. The Other Business segment consists of several smaller business activities that complement the company's three principal business areas. The company was founded by Chan Heng Fai on March 7, 2018 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Alset, Inc. 透過其子公司從事 ehome 社區和其他房地產開發、金融服務、數位轉型技術、生物健康活動和消費品的開發。它透過以下業務部門運作：房地產、數位轉型技術、生物健康和其他業務。房地產部門從事德克薩斯州休斯頓附近的房地產項目開發。數位轉型技術部門專注於滿足電子商務、協作和社交網路功能中的企業對企業（B2B）需求。生物健康部門包括消費品的銷售。其他業務部門由幾項較小的業務活動組成，這些活動補充了公司的三個主要業務領域。該公司由陳恆輝於2018年3月7日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Greenpro Capital Corp. engages in the provision of business solution services to small and medium-size enterprises. It operates through the following business segments: Service Business, Digital Business, and Real Estate Business. The Service Business segment offers advisory and business solution services. The Digital Business segment focuses on the digital platform and trading of digital assets. The Real Estate Business segment trades or leases commercial real estate properties in Hong Kong and Malaysia. The company was founded by Lee Chong Kuang on July 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 綠專資本致力於為中小企業提供商業解決方案服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務業務、數位業務和房地產業務。服務業務部門提供諮詢和業務解決方案服務。數位業務部門專注於數位平台和數位資產交易。房地產業務部門在香港和馬來西亞交易或租賃商業房地產。該公司由李宗光於2013年7月19日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: YD Bio Ltd. is a biotechnology company building an integrated healthcare platform across regulated diagnostics, clinical services, and commercial healthcare markets. It operates DNA methylation-based oncology testing programs under an LDT-first strategy and provides compliant life science distribution and clinical trial supply chain services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners. The company's offerings include cancer detection products, regenerative ophthalmology solutions, and exosome-based technologies. YD Bio was founded on February 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: YD Bio Ltd. 是一家生物技術公司，在受監管的診斷、臨床服務和商業醫療保健市場上建立綜合醫療保健平台。該公司在 LDT 優先策略下經營基於 DNA 甲基化的腫瘤檢測項目，並為製藥和生物技術合作夥伴提供合規的生命科學分銷和臨床試驗供應鏈服務。該公司的產品包括癌症檢測產品、再生眼科解決方案和基於外泌體的技術。勇鼎生物成立於2024年2月6日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: PS International Group Ltd. engages in providing logistics and supply chain solutions. The company was founded on September 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: PS International Group Ltd. 致力於提供物流和供應鏈解決方案。該公司成立於2023年9月12日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Valneva SE is a specialty vaccine company that develops, manufactures, and commercializes prophylactic vaccines for infectious diseases addressing unmet medical needs. It currently provides three proprietary travel vaccines: IXIARO, DUKORAL, and IXCHIQ. The IXIARO is an inactivated Vero cell culture-derived Japanese encephalitis vaccine indicated for active immunization against Japanese encephalitis in adults, adolescents, children, and infants aged two months and older. The DUKORAL is a drinkable vaccine that helps prevent diarrhea caused by heat-labile toxin-producing ETEC, as well as cholera. The IXCHIQ is a single-dose, live-attenuated vaccine for the prevention of disease caused by chikungunya virus. The company also offers additional vaccines, including VLA1553, VLA15, VLA160, VLA200, VLA1601 and others. Valneva was founded on May 28, 2013 and is headquartered in Saint-Herblain, France.
info.description_zh: Valneva SE 是一家特種疫苗公司，致力於開發、生產和商業化傳染病預防性疫苗，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。目前，該公司提供三種專有旅行疫苗：IXIARO、DUKORAL 和 IXCHIQ。 IXIARO 是一種滅活的 Vero 細胞培養衍生的日本腦炎疫苗，適用於成人、青少年、兒童和兩個月及以上嬰兒的日本腦炎主動免疫。 DUKORAL 是一種飲用疫苗，有助於預防不耐熱毒素產生的 ETEC 引起的腹瀉以及霍亂。 IXCHIQ 是一種單劑量減毒活疫苗，用於預防基孔肯雅病毒引起的疾病。該公司還提供其他疫苗，包括 VLA1553、VLA15、VLA160、VLA200、VLA1601 等。 Valneva成立於2013年5月28日，總部位於法國聖埃爾布蘭。

info.description: FiEE, Inc. is a digital service provider focused on integrating artificial intelligence and data analytics into content creation and brand management. It offers a range of services designed to support creators, artists, and businesses in developing, managing, and optimizing their digital presence across global platforms, including customized graphic and posts, short videos, and editorial calendars aligned with brand goals. The company was founded by Frank Blase Manning and Peter Robin Kramer in May 1977 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: FiEE, Inc. 是一家數位服務供應商，專注於將人工智慧和數據分析整合到內容創建和品牌管理中。它提供一系列服務，旨在支持創作者、藝術家和企業在全球平台上開發、管理和優化他們的數位形象，包括與品牌目標一致的定製圖形和貼文、短影片和編輯日曆。該公司由 Frank Blase Manning 和 Peter Robin Kramer 於 1977 年 5 月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Psyence Biomedical Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the development and commercialization of pharmaceutical products in neurology. It develops natural psilocybin products for the healing of psychological trauma and its mental health consequences in the context of palliative care. The company was founded on February 25, 2021 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Psyence Biomedical Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事神經病學藥品的開發和商業化。它開發天然裸蓋菇素產品，用於治療心理創傷及其在安寧療護中的心理健康後果。該公司成立於2021年2月25日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for diseases and conditions of the eye. Its product pipeline includes Dextenza, OTX-TP, and OTX-TIC. The company was founded by Amarpreet S. Sawhney and Farhad Khosravi on September 12, 2006 and is headquartered in Bedford, MA.
info.description_zh: Oural Therapeutix, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於眼部疾病和病症療法的開發和商業化。其產品線包括Dextenza、OTX-TP和OTX-TIC。該公司由 Amarpreet S. Sawhney 和 Farhad Khosravi 於 2006 年 9 月 12 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州貝德福德。

info.description: Advanced Flower Capital, Inc. provides commercial real estate finance services. It primarily engages in originating, structuring, underwriting and managing senior secured loans and other types of loans for established companies operating in the cannabis industry in states. The company was founded by Leonard Mark Tannenbaum on July 6, 2020 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Advanced Flower Capital, Inc. 提供商業房地產金融服務。它主要為各州大麻產業的老牌公司發起、建構、承銷和管理優先擔保貸款和其他類型的貸款。該公司由 Leonard Mark Tannenbaum 於 2020 年 7 月 6 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: KIDZ AI Inc. is a technology-driven education company focused on developing artificial intelligence-powered learning systems for the K-12 and broader education markets. Its platform enhances learning accessibility, personalization, and efficiency through advanced AI technologies. The company offers a diverse curriculum tailored to various learning levels and interests, enabling students through personalized instruction, innovative course design, and data-driven educational solutions. Classover Holdings was founded on May 2, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: KIDZ AI Inc. 是一家技術驅動型教育公司，專注於為 K-12 和更廣泛的教育市場開發人工智慧驅動的學習系統。其平台透過先進的人工智慧技術提高學習的可及性、個人化和效率。該公司提供針對不同學習水平和興趣的多樣化課程，透過個人化指導、創新課程設計和數據驅動的教育解決方案為學生提供支援。 Classover Holdings 成立於 2024 年 5 月 2 日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Quantum Corp. engages in the manufacture of computer storage devices. It provides solutions for storing and protecting information in physical, virtual, and cloud environments. Its products and services include Myriad All-Flash File and Object, StorNext File System Unified Surveillance Platform, ActiveScale Object Storage, DXi Backup Appliances, Scalar Tape Storage, CatDV Media Asset Management, and Cloud-Based Analytics. The company was founded by Joel N. Harrison and James M. McCoy in 1980 and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: Quantum Corp. 從事電腦儲存設備的製造。它提供了在實體、虛擬和雲端環境中儲存和保護資訊的解決方案。其產品和服務包括 Myriad 全快閃檔案和物件、StorNext 檔案系統統一監控平台、ActiveScale 物件儲存、DXi 備份設備、標量磁帶儲存、CatDV 媒體資產管理和基於雲端的分析。該公司由 Joel N. Harrison 和 James M. McCoy 於 1980 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: RUM Group, Inc. engages in operating an online neutral video platform. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Canada, and Other. The company was founded in October 2013 by Chris Pavlovski and is headquartered in Longboat Key, FL.
info.description_zh: RUM Group, Inc. 從事營運線上中立視訊平台。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、加拿大和其他地區。該公司由 Chris Pavlovski 於 2013 年 10 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朗博特島。

info.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the development of medicines for unmet medical needs. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Millbrae, CA.
info.description_zh: Eikon Therapeutics 是一家生物製藥公司。它致力於開發藥物以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司成立於 2019 年，總部位於加州米爾布雷。

info.description: NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It develops novel molecular technology that provides enhanced targeted delivery of technologies for treating central nervous system diseases. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Calabasas, CA.
info.description_zh: NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它開發新穎的分子技術，提供增強的標靶治療中樞神經系統疾病的技術。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於加州卡拉巴薩斯。

info.description: Prelude Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company, which engages in the development of novel precision cancer medicines. It also focuses on the design and development of small molecule agents for cancer medicines. The company was founded by Krishna Vaddi in 2016 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Prelude Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段腫瘤公司，致力於開發新型精準癌症藥物。它還專注於癌症藥物小分子藥物的設計和開發。該公司由 Krishna Vaddi 於 2016 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages and develops medicines and diagnostics for Alzheimer's disease. The company was founded by William L. Klein, Grant A. Krafft, and Caleb Finch in 1996 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事和開發阿茲海默症的藥物和診斷方法。該公司由 William L. Klein、Grant A. Krafft 和 Caleb Finch 於 1996 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: Siebert Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of brokerage and financial advisory services. It conducts the following lines of business through wholly owned subsidiaries: Retail Brokerage Business, Investment Advisory Services, Insurance Services, Robo-Advisory Technology Development, and Prime Brokerage Services. The company was founded by Siebert Muriel F. on April 9, 1934 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Siebert Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供經紀和財務諮詢服務。它透過全資子公司開展以下業務：零售經紀業務、投資諮詢服務、保險服務、機器人諮詢技術開發和大宗經紀服務。該公司由 Siebert Muriel F. 於 1934 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: Yesway, Inc. operates a chain of convenience stores. It offers packaged food, drinks, groceries, and snacks. The company was founded by Thomas Nicholas Trkla in 2015 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.
info.description_zh: Yesway, Inc. 經營連鎖便利商店。它提供包装食品、饮料、杂货和小吃。该公司由 Thomas Nicholas Trkla 于 2015 年创立，总部位于德克萨斯州沃思堡。

info.description: CXApp, Inc. engages in the provision of workplace experience solutions. Its solutions are used in workplace experience, employee engagement, desk and meeting room reservations, workplace analytics, occupancy management, content delivery, corporate communications and notifications, event management, live indoor mapping, and wayfinding and navigation. The company was founded on September 19, 2022 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: CXApp, Inc. 致力於提供工作場所體驗解決方案。其解決方案用於工作場所體驗、員工敬業度、辦公桌和會議室預訂、工作場所分析、佔用管理、內容交付、企業通訊和通知、活動管理、即時室內測繪以及尋路和導航。該公司成立於 2022 年 9 月 19 日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Collective Mining Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in South America. It holds interests in San Antonio and Guayabales projects. The company was founded on February 21, 2018 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Collective Mining Ltd. 從事南美洲礦產的收購、勘探和開發業務。它擁有聖安東尼奧和瓜亞巴萊斯項目的權益。該公司成立於2018年2月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. operates as a tanker pool company. It is engaged primarily in the commercial management and chartering of crude oil and refined petroleum product tankers. The company was founded on May 7, 2024 and is headquartered in Piraeus, Greece.
info.description_zh: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. 是一家油輪聯營公司。它主要從事原油和成品油油輪的商業管理和租賃。該公司成立於2024年5月7日，總部位於希臘比雷埃夫斯。

info.description: Intelligent Bio Solutions, Inc. is a medical technology company, which engages in delivering testing solutions. It operates through the Intelligent Fingerprinting Products (IFPG) and Saliva Glucose Biosensor Platform (SGBP) segments. It offers biochemistry, immunology, tumor markers, hormones, and nucleic acid diagnostic modalities. The company was founded on December 5, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Intelligence Bio Solutions, Inc.是一家醫療技術公司，致力於提供測試解決方案。它透過智慧指紋產品（IFPG）和唾液葡萄糖生物感測器平台（SGBP）部門運作。它提供生物化學、免疫學、腫瘤標記、荷爾蒙和核酸診斷方式。該公司成立於2016年12月5日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Design Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company that develops therapies for serious degenerative disorders. It is created to design, develop and commercialize a novel class of small molecule therapeutic candidates (GeneTACs) designed to directly address the underlying basis of genetic disease. The company was founded by Pratik Shah and Aseem Z. Ansari on December 18, 2017 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: Design Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生技公司，開發嚴重退化性疾病的療法。它的創建是為了設計、開發和商業化一類新型小分子候選治療藥物 (GeneTAC)，旨在直接解決遺傳疾病的根本問題。該公司由 Pratik Shah 和 Asem Z. Ansari 於 2017 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Seneca Foods Corp. engages in the processing and sale of packaged fruits and vegetables. It offers canned, frozen and bottled produce, and snack chips products. It operates through the following business segments: Canned Vegetables, Frozen Vegetables, Fruit Products, Snack Products, and Other. The company was founded by Arthur S. Wolcott in 1949 and is headquartered in Fairport, NY.
info.description_zh: Seneca Foods Corp. 從事包裝水果和蔬菜的加工和銷售。它提供罐裝、冷凍和瓶裝產品以及零食薯片產品。它透過以下業務部門運作：罐裝蔬菜、冷凍蔬菜、水果產品、休閒產品等。該公司由 Arthur S. Wolcott 於 1949 年創立，總部位於紐約州費爾波特。

info.description: MeiraGTx Holdings Plc is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company with a broad pipeline of late-stage clinical programs, including Parkinson's disease, radiation-induced xerostomia and AIPL1-associated retinal dystrophy. It targets local delivery of small doses of genetic medicines to treat both inherited and more common conditions with severe unmet needs. The company was founded on March 20, 2015 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MeiraGTx Holdings Plc 是一家臨床階段的基因藥物公司，擁有廣泛的後期臨床項目，包括帕金森氏症、輻射引起的口乾症和 AIPL1 相關的視網膜營養不良。它的目標是在當地提供小劑量的基因藥物，以治療嚴重未滿足需求的遺傳性疾病和更常見的疾病。該公司成立於2015年3月20日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Nutriband, Inc. engages in the development of a portfolio of transdermal pharmaceutical products. It operates through the Pocono Pharmaceuticals and 4P Therapeutics segments. The Pocono Pharmaceuticals segment relates to a coated products manufacturing entity. The 4P Therapeutics segment performs contract research and development services. The company was founded by Gareth R. Sheridan and Serguei Melnik in 2012 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Nutriband, Inc. 從事透皮醫藥產品組合的開發。它透過 Pocono Pharmaceuticals 和 4P Therapeutics 部門運作。 Pocono Pharmaceuticals 部門涉及塗層產品製造實體。 4P Therapeutics 部門提供合約研究和開發服務。該公司由 Gareth R. Sheridan 和 Serguei Melnik 於 2012 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in the discovery and development of therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases. The company was founded on July 22, 1980 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發治療罕見疾病的療法。該公司成立於1980年7月22日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. is a premier global media and entertainment company, which engages in the provision of a differentiated portfolio of content, brands, and franchises across television, film, streaming, and gaming. It operates through the following segments: Studios, Networks, Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), and Corporate. The Studios segment includes producing and releasing feature films for initial exhibition in theaters, producing and initial licensing television programs to networks services as well as third parties, distributing films and television programs to various third party, internal television, and streaming services, distribution through the home entertainment market related consumer products, and themed experience licensing and interactive gaming. The Networks segment focuses on domestic and international television networks. The DTC segment is involved in premium pay-television and streaming services. The company was founded on June 17, 1985 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 華納兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.) 是一家全球領先的媒體和娛樂公司，致力於提供跨電視、電影、串流媒體和遊戲的差異化內容、品牌和特許經營權組合。它透過以下部門運作：工作室、網路、直接面向消費者 (DTC) 和企業。製片廠部門包括製作和發行用於在劇院首次放映的長片，向網路服務和第三方製作和初始授權電視節目，向各種第三方、內部電視和串流媒體服務分發電影和電視節目，透過家庭娛樂市場相關消費產品進行分發，以及主題體驗授權和互動遊戲。網路部門專注於國內和國際電視網絡。 DTC 部門涉及優質付費電視和串流媒體服務。該公司成立於1985年6月17日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Invivyd, Inc. engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of antibody-based solutions for infectious diseases with pandemic potential. The firm develops antibodies that can neutralize SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV-1, and additional emergent coronaviruses. It offers ADG20, a monoclonal antibody, targeting the spike protein of SARS-CoV-2 and related coronaviruses. The company was founded by Tillman U. Gerngross, Ren Russo and Laura Walker on June 3, 2020 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.description_zh: Invivyd, Inc. 致力於針對具有大流行潛力的傳染病的基於抗體的解決方案的發現、開發和商業化。該公司開發的抗體可以中和 SARS-CoV-2、SARS-CoV-1 和其他新出現的冠狀病毒。它提供 ADG20，一種單株抗體，針對 SARS-CoV-2 和相關冠狀病毒的刺突蛋白。該公司由 Tillman U. Gerngross、Ren Russo 和 Laura Walker 於 2020 年 6 月 3 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: Palatin Technologies, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of medicines based on molecules that modulate the activity of the melanocortin receptor system. Its primary product candidate is marketed under the Vyleesi brand, the trade name for bremelanotide, which is used for the treatment of premenopausal women with acquired, generalized, hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD). The company was founded by Carl Spana and John K. A. Prendergast on November 21, 1986 and is headquartered in Princeton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Palatin Technologies, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於調節黑皮質素受體系統活性的分子的藥物。其主要候選產品以 Vyleesi 品牌銷售，該品牌是 Bremelanotide 的商品名，用於治療後天、全身性、性慾減退症 (HSDD) 的停經前女性。該公司由 Carl Spana 和 John K. A. Prendergast 於 1986 年 11 月 21 日創立，總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: Orion Digital Corp. operates as a financial technology company. Its products and services include MogoMoney, MogoProtect, MogoCard, MogoMortgage, MogoCrypto and Moka services. The company was founded by David Feller and Gregory Feller on January 14, 1972 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Orion Digital Corp. 是一家金融科技公司。其產品和服務包括MogoMoney、MogoProtect、MogoCard、MogoMortgage、MogoCrypto 和Moka 服務。該公司由 David Feller 和 Gregory Feller 於 1972 年 1 月 14 日創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: U.S. GoldMining, Inc. operates as a gold and copper exploration company. It focuses on unlocking the substantial value of the Whistler gold-copper project. The company was founded on June 30, 2015 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: U.S. GoldMining, Inc. 是一家黃金和銅勘探公司。它的重點是釋放惠斯勒金銅計畫的實質價值。公司成立於2015年6月30日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Alector, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in pioneering of immuno-neurology. It develops portfolio of innate immune system programs, designed to functionally repair genetic mutations and enable the rejuvenated immune cells to counteract emerging brain pathologies. Its treatment targets immune dysfunction as a root cause of multiple pathologies that are drivers of degenerative brain disorders. The company was founded by Asa Abeliovich, Errik B. Anderson, Tillman U. Gerngross, and Arnon Rosenthal in May 2013 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Alector, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於免疫神經學領域的開拓。它開發了一系列先天免疫系統項目，旨在功能性修復基因突變，並使免疫細胞恢復活力，以對抗新出現的大腦病變。其治療目標是免疫功能障礙，這是多種病理學的根本原因，而這些病理學是退化性腦部疾病的驅動因素。該公司由 Asa Abeliovich、Errik B. Anderson、Tillman U. Gerngross 和 Arnon Rosenthal 於 2013 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. designs, develops, deploys, and operates intelligent technology solutions supporting rail, logistics, intermodal and government customers that streamlines operations, improves safety and reduces costs. It offers imaging, safety and security, software, and services. The firm also provides cutting edge solutions that automate the mechanical and security inspection of fast moving trains, trucks and automobiles through a broad range of proprietary hardware, software, information technology and artificial intelligence. The company was founded on May 31, 1994 and is headquartered in Jacksonville, FL.
info.description_zh: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. 設計、開發、部署和營運智慧技術解決方案，為鐵路、物流、聯運和政府客戶提供支持，從而簡化營運、提高安全性並降低成本。它提供影像、安全保障、軟體和服務。該公司還提供尖端的解決方案，透過廣泛的專有硬體、軟體、資訊技術和人工智慧，對快速移動的火車、卡車和汽車進行機械和安全檢查的自動化。該公司成立於1994年5月31日，總部位於佛羅裡達州傑克遜維爾。

info.description: HF Foods Group, Inc. engages in the marketing and distribution of fresh produce, frozen and dry food, and non-food products to primarily independently operated Asian restaurants and other foodservice customers. The company leverages its network of distribution centers covering the United States, and partners with domestic and international suppliers to offer fresh, specialty restaurant food products to supply the demand for Asian American cuisine. HF Foods was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: HF Foods Group, Inc. 致力於向主要獨立經營的亞洲餐廳和其他餐飲服務客戶行銷和分銷新鮮農產品、冷凍食品、乾燥食品以及非食品產品。該公司利用其覆蓋美國的配送中心網絡，並與國內和國際供應商合作，提供新鮮、特色的餐廳食品，以滿足對亞裔美式菜餚的需求。 HF Foods 成立於 1997 年，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Marwynn Holdings, Inc. engages in providing supply chain management solutions through its subsidiaries. The company focuses on the sourcing, distribution, and consulting of food and non-alcoholic beverages and has expanded its supply chain management offerings to include e-waste reverse supply chain services. The company was founded on February 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Marwynn Holdings, Inc. 透過其子公司提供供應鏈管理解決方案。該公司專注於食品和非酒精飲料的採購、分銷和諮詢，並將其供應鏈管理產品擴展到包括電子垃圾逆向供應鏈服務。該公司成立於2024年2月27日，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: RCI Hospitality Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of live adult entertainment and dining experiences. It operates through the following segments: Nightclubs and Bombshells. The Nightclubs segment includes operating adult entertainment nightclubs. The Bombshells segment operates a restaurant and bar. The company was founded by Robert L. Watters in 1983 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: RCI Hospitality Holdings, Inc. 從事提供現場成人娛樂和餐飲體驗。它透過以下部門運作：夜總會和重磅炸彈。夜總會部門包括經營成人娛樂夜總會。 Bombshel​​ls 部門經營餐廳和酒吧。該公司由 Robert L. Watters 於 1983 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. engages in the provision of conversational artificial intelligence assistants with the purpose of transforming engagement and analytics for businesses through security-focused, multimodal communication and human-like artificial intelligence assistants. The firm is also involved in delivering highly personalized, multi-modal artificial intelligence engagement with a focus on industries where there is a massive workforce gap and an opportunity to transform how consumers engage with networks, providers, and brands. The company is founded by Tyler J. Luck, Michael Lucas, Patrick Nunally & Hanseok Ko on March 14, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. 致力於提供對話式人工智慧助手，旨在透過以安全為中心的多模式通訊和類人人工智慧助理來改變企業的參與和分析。該公司也致力於提供高度個人化、多模式的人工智慧參與，重點關注勞動力缺口巨大的產業，並有機會改變消費者與網路、供應商和品牌的互動方式。該公司由 Tyler J. Luck、Michael Lucas、Patrick Nunally 和 Hanseok Ko 於 2024 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the restaurant's operation, delivery business, sales of condiment products, and food ingredients located in overseas market outside Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It operates through the following geographical segments: Singapore, United States of America, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Others. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 超喜國際控股有限公司是一家投資控股公司，主要從事餐廳經營、外帶業務、調味品及食材銷售，業務分佈於中國大陸、香港、澳門、台灣以外的海外市場。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：新加坡、美國、馬來西亞、越南等。該公司成立於2012年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: AIOS Tech, Inc. engages in the strategic transformation plan, is repositioning itself as a provider of artificial intelligence and technology-driven professional services. The firm delivering innovative information technology solutions, advanced data services, and AI-powered offerings to a diverse range of commercial client base. The core business encompasses digital transformation services, customized IT solutions for the financial sector, enterprise data solutions, and the development of artificial intelligence platforms and infrastructure, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and drive growth for clients across multiple industries. The company was founded on May 29, 2012 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: AIOS Tech, Inc.正在進行策略轉型計劃，將自身重新定位為人工智慧和技術驅動的專業服務提供者。該公司為各種商業客戶群提供創新的資訊技術解決方案、先進的數據服務和人工智慧驅動的產品。核心業務涵蓋數位轉型服務、金融業客製化IT解決方案、企業數據解決方案以及人工智慧平台和基礎設施開發，旨在提升各產業客戶的營運效率並推動成長。公司成立於2012年5月29日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Greenlane Holdings, Inc. engages in acquisition, staking, validator participation, and strategic deployment of digital assets. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale and Distribution and Digital Assets. The Wholesale and Distribution segment includes legacy e-commerce and drop-ship operations. The Digital Assets segment focuses on activities including acquisition, staking and validator participation. The company was founded by Aaron LoCascio in 2005 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Greenlane Holdings, Inc. 從事數位資產的收購、質押、驗證者參與和策略部署。它透過以下部門運作：批發和分銷部門以及數位資產部門。批發和分銷部門包括傳統的電子商務和代發貨業務。數位資產部門專注於收購、質押和驗證者參與等活動。該公司由 Aaron LoCascio 於 2005 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Mannatech, Inc. engages in the development of nutritional supplements, topical and skin care products and weight-management products that target optimal health and wellness. Its product category includes integrative health, targeted health, wealth and fitness, skin care, essentials, and home. The company was founded by Marlin Ray Robbins and Samuel L. Caster in November 1993 and is headquartered in Flower Mound, TX.
info.description_zh: Mannatech, Inc. 致力於開發以最佳健康為目標的營養補充劑、外用和皮膚護理產品以及體重管理產品。其產品類別包括綜合健康、針對性健康、財富與健身、皮膚護理、必需品和家居。該公司由 Marlin Ray Robbins 和 Samuel L. Caster 於 1993 年 11 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州 Flower Mound。

info.description: Iveda Solutions, Inc. enables cloud video surveillance via its Sentir data and video management platform, utilizing proprietary video streaming and big data storage technology. The firm provides services for telecommunications companies, datacenter operators, ISPs, and cable companies. It operates through the US and Taiwan segments. The company was founded by David Ly in 2003 and is headquartered in Mesa, AZ.
info.description_zh: Iveda Solutions, Inc. 利用專有的視訊串流和大數據儲存技術，透過其 Sentir 資料和視訊管理平台實現雲端視訊監控。該公司為電信公司、資料中心營運商、ISP 和有線電視公司提供服務。它透過美國和台灣部門運作。該公司由 David Ly 於 2003 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州梅薩。

info.description: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a clinical-stage drug development biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of oral therapy for the treatment of non-alcoholic steato-hepatitis (NASH). Its product candidate, Aramchol, is a synthetic fatty acid-bile acid conjugate molecule for the oral treatment of NASH in patients who are overweight or obese and have prediabetes or type II diabetes mellitus. The company was founded by Allen Baharaff and Tuvia Gilat in 2000 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd.是一家臨床階段藥物開發生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的口服療法。其候選產品Aramchol是一種合成脂肪酸-膽汁酸結合分子，用於口服治療超重或肥胖以及患有前驅糖尿病或II型糖尿病的患者的NASH。該公司由 Allen Baharaff 和 Tuvia Gilat 於 2000 年創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: GrowGeneration Corp. engages in the development, marketing, retail, and distribution of hydroponic products and services. It operates through the following segments: Cultivating and Gardening, Storage Solutions, and Corporate. The Cultivating and Gardening segment includes hydroponic and organic gardening business. The Storage Solutions segment involves benching and racking. The company was founded by Darren Lampert and Michael S. Salaman on March 6, 2014 and is headquartered in Greenwood Village, CO.
info.description_zh: GrowGeneration Corp. 從事水耕產品和服務的開發、行銷、零售和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：栽培和園藝部門、儲存解決方案部門和企業部門。栽培和園藝部門包括水耕和有機園藝業務。儲存解決方案部分涉及桌上型和機架。該公司由 Darren Lampert 和 Michael S. Salaman 於 2014 年 3 月 6 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州格林伍德村。

info.description: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of banking solutions through MainStreet Bank. It offers products and services such as checking, deposits, loans, credit cards, mortgages, and savings. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Real Estate Commercial, Construction, Commercial, and Consumer. The company was founded on March 28, 2003 and is headquartered in Fairfax, VA.
info.description_zh: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過 MainStreet Bank 提供銀行解決方案。它提供支票、存款、貸款、信用卡、抵押貸款和儲蓄等產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、房地產商業部門、建築部門、商業部門和消費者部門。該公司成立於2003年3月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州費爾法克斯。

info.description: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc. is a closed-end management investment company. It engages in the business of investing in loans and securities that are rated below investment grade by rating agencies or that may be rated below investment grade if they were so rated. The company was founded on December 28, 2011 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc.是一家封閉式管理投資公司。它從事投資於評級機構評級低於投資級別或如果評級機構評級可能低於投資級別的貸款和證券的業務。該公司成立於2011年12月28日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: PrimeEnergy Resources Corp. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the business of acquiring, developing, and producing oil and natural gas. The firm is also involved in selling oil and natural gas and liquids production to a number of direct purchasers under direct contracts or through other operators under joint operating agreements. The company was founded on March 22, 1973 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: PrimeEnergy Resources Corp.是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，從事石油和天然氣的收購、開發和生產業務。該公司還根據直接合約或根據聯合經營協議透過其他業者向許多直接購買者銷售石油、天然氣和液體產品。該公司成立於1973年3月22日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Helix Acquisition Corp. III operates as blank check company. The company was founded on September 10, 2025 and is headquartered in Boston. MA.
info.description_zh: Helix Acquisition Corp. III 以空白支票公司經營。該公司成立於2025年9月10日，總部位於波士頓。馬。

info.description: AXS Astoria Inflation Sensitive ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation in inflation-adjusted terms. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to invests principally in securities across multiple asset classes which have the potential to benefit from increases in the rate of rising costs of goods and services (i.e., inflation). These investments are expected to include equity securities of companies engaged in the energy, financials, industrial, and materials sectors, as well as investments in other ETFs that directly or indirectly invest in commodities or fixed income securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS Astoria 通膨敏感 ETF 尋求經通膨調整後的長期資本增值。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於多種資產類別的證券，這些資產類別有可能從商品和服務成本上漲（即通貨膨脹）中受益。這些投資預計將包括能源、金融、工業和材料行業公司的股本證券，以及直接或間接投資於商品或固定收益證券的其他 ETF 的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Inflation Plus Fund seeks total return. The fund is actively managed using a model-based approach. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, either directly or through a wholly owned subsidiary, in a portfolio primarily composed of inflation-protected U.S. Treasury Bonds ("TIPS") and other debt securities issued by the U.S. Treasury, including bills, notes, bonds, and floating rate public obligations of the U.S. Treasury ("Floating Rate Notes"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Inflation Plus 基金追求總回報。該基金採用基於模型的方法進行積極管理。該基金尋求透過直接或透過全資子公司投資於主要由通膨保值美國國債（「TIPS」）和美國財政部發行的其他債務證券（包括票據、票據、債券和美國財政部浮動利率公共債務（「浮動利率票據」））組成的投資組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: C4 Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of targeted protein degradation science to develop a new generation of small molecule medicines used for treating diseases. It develops the Degronimid platform that incorporates small molecule binders to target disease-causing proteins and facilitate their destruction and clearance from the cell through the natural ubiquitin and proteasome system. The company was founded by James E. Bradner, Kenneth C. Anderson, Nathanael S. Gray and Marc A. Cohen in 2015 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: C4 Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發靶向蛋白質降解科學，以開發用於治療疾病的新一代小分子藥物。該公司開發了 Degronimid 平台，該平台結合了小分子結合劑來靶向致病蛋白質，並透過天然泛素和蛋白酶體系統促進其從細胞中的破壞和清除。該公司由 James E. Bradner、Kenneth C. Anderson、Nathanael S. Gray 和 Marc A. Cohen 於 2015 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Activate Energy Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which engages for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 10, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Activate Energy Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司經營，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月10日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: Illumination Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 18, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Illumination Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月18日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: SC II Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 30, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SC II Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Focus Five Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector-based ETFs that the index provider believes offer the greatest potential to outperform the other ETFs in the selection universe and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Focus Five 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。該指數旨在提供對 First Trust 五個基於行業的 ETF 的有針對性的投資，指數提供者認為這些 ETF 具有超越精選範圍內其他 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Origin Investment Corp. I is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 25, 2024 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Origin Investment Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年9月25日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Matthew Kiernan and Andrew McLean on April 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Camas, WA.
info.description_zh: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Matthew Kiernan 和 Andrew McLean 於 2025 年 4 月 7 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州卡馬斯。

info.description: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on August 8, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp.是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月8日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Incline Village, NV.
info.description_zh: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. II 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 10 月 16 日，總部位於內華達州 Incline Village。

info.description: Apollomics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of oncology therapies to address unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Liang Yu Guo and Sanjeev Redkar in May 2015 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Apollomics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發腫瘤療法，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司由梁宇國和桑吉夫·雷德卡於 2015 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: Moderna, Inc. engages in the development of transformative medicines based on messenger ribonucleic acid. The firm's product pipeline includes the following modalities: prophylactic vaccines, cancer vaccines, intratumoral immuno-oncology, localized regenerative therapeutics, systemic secreted therapeutics, inhaled pulmonary therapeutics and systemic intracellular therapeutics. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, and Rest of World. The company was founded by Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert S. Langer, Jr., Derrick J. Rossi, and Kenneth R. Chien in 2010 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Moderna, Inc. 致力於開發基於信使核糖核酸的轉化藥物。該公司的產品線包括以下模式：預防性疫苗、癌症疫苗、腫瘤內免疫腫瘤學、局部再生療法、全身性分泌療法、吸入性肺部療法和全身性細胞內療法。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司由 Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert S. Langer, Jr.、Derrick J. Rossi 和 Kenneth R. Chien 於 2010 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Arbutus Biopharma Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel therapeutics that target specific viral diseases. It focuses on the development of imdusiran (AB-729), proprietary, conjugated GalNAc, subcutaneously-delivered RNAi therapeutic, and AB-101, proprietary oral PD-L1 inhibitor, for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (cHBV). The company was founded on October 6, 2005 and is headquartered in Warminster, PA.
info.description_zh: Arbutus Biopharma Corp.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對特定病毒性疾病的新型療法。它專注於開發imdusiran (AB-729)，一種專有的綴合GalNAc，皮下遞送的RNAi治療劑，以及AB-101，一種專有的口服PD-L1抑制劑，用於治療慢性乙型肝炎(cHBV)。該公司成立於2005年10月6日，總部位於賓州沃明斯特。

info.description: AI Financial Corp. is a fintech company which engages in blockchain-powered technologies for digital asset trading, payments processing and related payment card services. It provides regulated institutional-grade Crypto-as-a-Service infrastructure for the digital asset economy. The company was founded by Edward R. Cameron in 1976 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: AI Financial Corp.是一家金融科技公司，從事數位資產交易、支付處理和相關支付卡服務的區塊鏈技術。它為數位資產經濟提供受監管的機構級加密即服務基礎設施。該公司由 Edward R. Cameron 於 1976 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: A SPAC III Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. The company was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on September 3, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: SPAC III Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。公司成立的目的是進行合併、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年9月3日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Anteris Technologies Global Corp. is a structural heart company, which engages in the development and commercialization of medical devices for heart diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, Australia, Switzerland, and Sweden. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Eagan, MN.
info.description_zh: Anteris Technologies Global Corp.是一家結構心臟公司，從事心臟病醫療設備的開發和商業化。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國、澳洲、瑞士和瑞典。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊根。

info.description: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of lifecycle automotive services. It operates through the following segments: New Car Sales, Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales, and Automotive Insurance Related Services. The New Car Sales segment offers parallel import car and new energy vehicle (NEV). The Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales segment conducts business primarily to auto part dealers and gradually upgrade to directly connect to local multiple-brand-service (MBS) stores. The Automotive Insurance Related Services segment refers to the value-added maintenance, claim and repair, and insurance intermediation services. The company was founded by Hou Qi Zhang in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Autozi互聯網科技（全球）有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供汽車全生命週期服務。它透過以下部門運作：新車銷售、汽車零件和汽車配件銷售以及汽車保險相關服務。新車銷售部門提供平行進口汽車和新能源汽車（NEV）。汽車零配件銷售板塊主要針對汽車零配件經銷商開展業務，並逐步升級為直連當地多品牌服務（MBS）店。汽車保險相關服務部門是指加值保養、索賠和維修以及保險中介服務。該公司由張侯奇於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2028 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2028 (collectively, "2028 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2028 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2028 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2028 年債券」）。

info.description: Celsius Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, sale, and distribution of functional drinks and liquid supplements. It also offers post-workout functional energy drinks and protein bars. The company was founded in April 2004 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Celeste Holdings, Inc. 從事功能性飲料和液體補充劑的開發、行銷、銷售和分銷。它還提供鍛煉後功能性能量飲料和蛋白質棒。該公司成立於 2004 年 4 月，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Coya Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company which engages in developing proprietary medicinal products to modulate the function of regulatory T cells. The company was founded by Howard Berman in 2020 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Coya Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發調節調節性T細胞功能的專有醫藥產品。該公司由 Howard Berman 於 2020 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a gene editing company, which engages in the development of transformative gene-based medicines for serious diseases using its proprietary CRISPR/Cas9 platform. Its CRISPR/Cas9 platform is a gene editing technology that allows for precise, directed changes to genomic DNA. The firm offers a portfolio of therapeutic programs across a broad range of disease areas including hemoglobinopathies, oncology, regenerative medicine, and rare diseases. The company was founded by Rodger Novak, Emmanuelle Charpentier, Shaun Patrick Foy, Matthew Porteus, Daniel Anderson, Chad Cowan, and Craig Mellow on October 31, 2013 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: CRISPR Therapeutics AG 是一家基因編輯公司，利用其專有的 CRISPR/Cas9 平台開發針對嚴重疾病的轉化基因藥物。其 CRISPR/Cas9 平台是一種基因編輯技術，可對基因組 DNA 進行精確、定向的改變。該公司提供涵蓋廣泛疾病領域的治療項目組合，包括血紅蛋白病、腫瘤學、再生醫學和罕見疾病。該公司由 Rodger Novak、Emmanuelle Charpentier、Shaun Patrick Foy、Matthew Porteus、Daniel Anderson、Chad Cowan 和 Craig Mellow 於 2013 年 10 月 31 日創立，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: Curanex Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the pharmaceutical business. It focuses on developing and commercializing botanical treatments for inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Ying Jing and Chang Liu in 1996 and is headquartered in Jericho, NY.
info.description_zh: Curanex Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 從事製藥業務。它專注於發炎性疾病植物療法的開發和商業化。該公司由晶瑩和劉暢於 1996 年創立，總部位於紐約州傑里科。

info.description: Precision BioSciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of genome editing technologies. It operates through the Therapeutics and Food segments. The Therapeutics segment focuses on the development of products in the field of immuno-oncology and of novel products outside immuno-oncology to treat human diseases. The Food segment applies ARCUS, the company's proprietary genome editing platform, to develop food and nutrition products through collaboration agreements with consumer-facing companies. The company was founded by Derek N. Jantz, Jeff Smith, and Matthew R. Kane on January 26, 2006 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Precision BioSciences, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事基因組編輯技術的開發。它透過治療和食品部門運作。治療部門專注於免疫腫瘤學領域的產品開發以及免疫腫瘤學以外治療人類疾病的新產品的開發。食品部門採用該公司專有的基因組編輯平台 ARCUS，透過與面向消費者的公司達成合作協議來開發食品和營養產品。該公司由 Derek N. Jantz、Jeff Smith 和 Matthew R. Kane 於 2006 年 1 月 26 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: EpicQuest Education Group International Ltd. engages in the provision of education solutions for domestic and international university students. It operates through the Foreign Language Education and Professional Training Programs. The company was founded by Jian Bo Zhang on December 13, 2017 and is headquartered in Toledo, OH.
info.description_zh: EpicQuest Education Group International Ltd.致力於為國內外大學生提供教育解決方案。它透過外語教育和專業培訓計畫運作。該公司由張建波於2017年12月13日創立，總部位於俄亥俄州托萊多。

info.description: Direxion Daily LLY Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of LLY. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of LLY and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to LLY, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily LLY Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 LLY 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 LLY 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 LLY 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. engages in the provision of software solutions and information technology professional services. It operates through the following segments: Matrix , Sapiens, Magic Software, Insync, Michpal, ZAP Group, and Other. The company was founded on April 2, 1985 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. 從事提供軟體解決方案和資訊科技專業服務。它透過以下部門運作：Matrix、Sapiens、Magic Software、Insync、Michpal、ZAP Group 和其他部門。該公司成立於1985年4月2日，總部位於以色列奧爾耶胡達。

info.description: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. is a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in biotechnology and drug design and development. The company was founded in 2018, and is headquartered in Somerville, MA.
info.description_zh: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生成生物學公司，引領生物技術和藥物設計與開發領域的人工智慧革命。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州薩默維爾。

info.description: First Trust High Income Strategic Focus ETF seeks risk-adjusted income; capital appreciation is the secondary objective. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing in a portfolio of U.S.-listed ETFs that is designed to follow the High Income Model developed by the advisor. The fund, through its investments in the underlying ETFs comprising the High Income Model, seeks to provide investors with a diversified income stream by holding a blend of fixed income assets that are actively managed to seek levels of high income and total return. It invests significantly in shares of the First Trust TCW Opportunistic Fixed Income ETF.
info.description_zh: First Trust High Income Strategy Focus ETF尋求風險調整後收益；資本增值是次要目標。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過投資於美國上市的 ETF 投資組合來實現其投資目標，該投資組合旨在遵循顧問開發的高收入模型。該基金透過對構成高收入模型的基礎 ETF 的投資，尋求透過持有積極管理的固定收益資產組合來為投資者提供多元化的收入來源，以尋求高收入和總回報水平。它大量投資於 First Trust TCW 機會性固定收益 ETF 的股票。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Robinhood Markets, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF 旨在通过出售杠杆交易所交易基金的期权来实现 2 倍 (200%) 出售 Robinhood Markets, Inc. 普通股期权所产生的收入，该基金旨在实现基础股票每日表现的 2 倍，并获得基础杠杆 ETF 表现的敞口，但须遵守潜在投资收益的上限。可能会实施下行保护，这可能会影响净利润水平。该基金将至少80%的净资产投资于以标的杠杆ETF作为参考资产的衍生品合约。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2046 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2046 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2046. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2046 and December 15, 2046, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
