info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2046 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2046 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2046 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2046 年 1 月 1 日至 2046 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2056 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2056 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2056. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2056 and December 15, 2056, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2056 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2056 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2056 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2056 年 1 月 1 日至 2056 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: iSpecimen, Inc. is a healthcare organization that engages in procurement of human biospecimen. It collects biofluids, human tissue, hematopoietic stem, and immune cells. The company was founded by Christopher Ianelli in 2009 and is headquartered in Woburn, MA.
info.description_zh: iSpecimen, Inc. 是一家從事人體生物樣本採購的醫療保健組織。它收集生物體液、人體組織、造血幹細胞和免疫細胞。該公司由 Christopher Ianelli 於 2009 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃本。

info.description: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它從事與一個或多個企業的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月20日，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: Maison Solutions, Inc. operates as a holding company with interests in food retailing. It offers traditional Asian food and merchandise to U.S. consumers, in particular to members of Asian-American communities. The firm's products include meats, seafood, and Asian vegetables and fruits such as Chinese broccoli, bitter melon, winter gourd, Shanghai baby bokchoy, longan and lychee. The company was founded in July 2019 and is headquartered in Monterey Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Maison Solutions, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，涉足食品零售業務。它向美國消費者，特別是亞裔美國人社區的成員提供傳統的亞洲食品和商品。該公司的產品包括肉類、海鮮以及亞洲蔬菜和水果，如綠花椰菜、苦瓜、冬瓜、上海小白菜、龍眼和荔枝。該公司成立於 2019 年 7 月，總部位於加州蒙特利公園。

info.description: Novavax, Inc. Is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of recombinant vaccines. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.
info.description_zh: Novavax, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事重組疫苗的發現、開發和商業化。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州蓋瑟斯堡。

info.description: Oculis Holding AG is a global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in sight and improving eye care. The firm's pipeline includes multiple product candidates in development such as, OCS-01, a topical retinal candidate for diabetic macular edema, OCS-02, a topical biologic candidate for dry eye disease, and OCS-05, a disease modifying candidate for acute optic neuritis and other neuro-ophtha disorders such as glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, geographic atrophy, and neurotrophic keratitis. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Oculis Holding AG 是一家全球生物製藥公司，致力於視力和改善眼部護理。該公司的產品線包括多種正在開發的候選產品，例如 OCS-01（一種治療糖尿病黃斑水腫的局部視網膜候選藥物）、OCS-02（一種治療乾眼症的局部生物候選藥物）和 OCS-05（一種治療急性視神經炎和其他神經眼病（如青光眼、糖尿病視網膜病變、地圖樣萎縮和神經營養性角膜炎）。該公司成立於2016年，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: Vaxcyte, Inc. engages in the development of vaccines for infectious diseases. It focuses on conjugate vaccines and protein-based vaccines developed through the Sutro Biopharma's Xpress CF Platform, a cell-free protein synthesis technology. The company was founded by Grant E. Pickering and Jeff Fairman on November 27, 2013, and is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.
info.description_zh: Vaxcyte, Inc. 從事傳染病疫苗的開發。它專注於透過 Sutro Biopharma 的 Xpress CF 平台（一種無細胞蛋白質合成技術）開發的結合疫苗和蛋白質疫苗。該公司由 Grant E. Pickering 和 Jeff Fairman 於 2013 年 11 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州聖卡洛斯。

info.description: Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of immuno-oncology therapeutics. The company was founded on September 8, 2011 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. 是一家生技公司，從事免疫腫瘤療法的開發。該公司成立於2011年9月8日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of therapies for fibrotic diseases. It offers a product discovery engine. The company is pursuing drug development programs for a range of fibrotic diseases, focusing on tissue-specific integrin modulation and TGF-ß1 signaling inhibition. The company was founded by Bradley Backes, Bill De Grado, Hal Chapman, and Dean Sheppard in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於纖維化疾病療法的發現、開發和商業化。它提供了一個產品發現引擎。該公司正在針對一系列纖維化疾病開展藥物開發計劃，重點關注組織特異性整合素調節和 TGF-ß1 訊號傳導抑制。該公司由 Bradley Backes、Bill De Grado、Hal Chapman 和 Dean Sheppard 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Personalis, Inc. engages in the provision of advanced genomic tests for cancer. The firm is also involved in providing sequencing and data analysis services to support population sequencing initiatives. The company was founded by Euan A. Ashley, Michael Snyder, Atul J. Butte, John S. West, and Russ B. Altman in February 2011 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Personalis, Inc. 致力於提供先進的癌症基因組測試。該公司還提供定序和數據分析服務，以支援群體定序計劃。該公司由 Euan A. Ashley、Michael Snyder、Atul J. Butte、John S. West 和 Russ B. Altman 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Hyperliquid Strategies, Inc. is a holding and operating company, which engages in the business of crypto asset management. The firm operates as a digital asset treasury company which focuses on the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded on July 2, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

The company was founded on March 8, 2024 and is headquartered in Taiyuan, China.

info.description: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in mRNA cell therapies for the treatment of autoimmune diseases. It operates in research and development of cell therapy product candidates. The company was founded on December 10, 2007 is headquartered in Frederick, MD.
info.description_zh: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事治療自體免疫疾病的 mRNA 細胞療法。它從事細胞治療產品候選產品的研究和開發。該公司成立於2007年12月10日，總部位於馬裡蘭州弗雷德里克。

info.description: SKK Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of civil engineering services in subsurface utility works, including power and telecommunication cable laying, water pipeline and sewer rehabilitation works. The company was founded by Chun Seong Ng and Koon Kiat Sze on October 16, 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: SKK Holdings Ltd.作為一家控股公司運營，從事提供地下公用事業工程的土木工程服務，包括電力和電信電纜鋪設、供水管道和下水道修復工程。該公司由Chun Seong Ng和Koon Kiat Sze於2013年10月16日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Starry Sea Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on December 5, 2024 and is headquartered in Albany, NY.
info.description_zh: Starry Sea Acquisition Corp.是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年12月5日，總部位於紐約州奧爾巴尼。

info.description: ZeroStack Corp. engages in the production of organic cannabis and pharmaceutical-grade medical products. It operates through the House of Brands and Commercial and Wholesale segments. The House of Brands segment includes multiple categories including food and beverage, nutraceuticals, cannabis accessories and technology, personal care and wellness. The Commercial and Wholesale segment includes distribution of pharmaceutical products to international markets. The company was founded on March 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: ZeroStack Corp. 從事有機大麻和醫藥級醫療產品的生產。它透過品牌之家以及商業和批發部門運作。 House of Brands 部門包括多個類別，包括食品和飲料、營養保健品、大麻配件和技術、個人護理和健康。商業和批發部門包括向國際市場分銷藥品。該公司成立於2019年3月13日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。它不會購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Aldel Financial II, Inc. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on July 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Itasca, IL.
info.description_zh: Aldel Financial II, Inc. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 7 月 15 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州伊塔斯卡。

The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index（「基本指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2031 年債券」）的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Solarius Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. The company was founded on April 1, 2025 and is headquartered in Darien, CT.

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2032 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2032 Maturity US Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2032. The index is market value-weighted based on amounts outstanding reduced by amounts held by the Federal Reserve SOMA. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index, in each case except during the last months of the fund's operations.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2032 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2032 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2032 年期美國國債指數的投資結果。該指數根據未償付金額減去聯準會 SOMA 持有的金額進行市值加權。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金跟踪該指數的美國國債，在每種情況下，基金運營的最後幾個月除外。

info.description: US Treasury 5 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 5-Year US Treasury Index (GA05). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 5-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 5-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國財政部 5 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 5 年期美國國債指數 (GA05) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE BofA 目前 5 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 5 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Vanguard Intermediate-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with an intermediate-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Treasury 3-10 Year Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities between 3 and 10 years. At least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 中期國債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有中期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國國債 3-10 年指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型），期限在 3 年至 10 年之間。該基金至少80%的資產將投資於該指數所包含的債券。

info.description: Liberty Defense Holdings Ltd. engages in the commercialization of an active 3D imaging technology system, HEXWAVE, to detect concealed threats. The firm is also involved in providing multi-technology security solutions for concealed weapons detection in high volume foot traffic areas and locations requiring enhanced security such as airports, stadiums, and schools. It operates through the following business segments: Corporate, HEXWAVE and Contract. The company was founded on June 8, 2012 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Liberty Defense Holdings Ltd. 致力於主動 3D 成像技術系統 HEXWAVE 的商業化，以偵測隱藏的威脅。該公司還提供多技術安全解決方案，用於高人流區域和需要增強安全性的地點（例如機場、體育場和學校）的隱藏武器檢測。它透過以下業務部門運作：企業部門、HEXWAVE 部門和合約部門。該公司成立於2012年6月8日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2032 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2032年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: USIO, Inc. operates as an integrated electronic payment solutions provider. The firm provides payment acceptance, card-based processing, prepaid cards, and payment facilitation and electronic billing products and services to businesses, merchants and consumers. It operates through the following segments: Output Solutions and Merchant Services. The Output Solutions segment offers electronic bill presentment, document composition, document decomposition and printing and mailing services serving hundreds of customers representing a wide range of industry verticals, including utilities and financial institutions. The Merchant Services segment offers integrated electronic payment processing services to merchants and businesses, including credit and debit card-based processing services and electronic funds transfer via the ACH network. The company was founded by Louis A. Hoch and Michael R. Long in 1998 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: USIO, Inc. 是一家綜合電子支付解決方案提供商。該公司向企業、商家和消費者提供支付受理、基於卡片的處理、預付卡以及支付便利和電子計費產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：輸出解決方案和商業服務。輸出解決方案部門提供電子帳單呈現、文件撰寫、文件分解以及列印和郵寄服務，為代表廣泛垂直行業（包括公用事業和金融機構）的數百家客戶提供服務。商家服務部門為商家和企業提供綜合電子支付處理服務，包括基於信用卡和金融卡的處理服務以及透過 ACH 網路的電子資金轉帳。該公司由 Louis A. Hoch 和 Michael R. Long 於 1998 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. Its business objective is purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 01, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。其業務目標是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組。該公司成立於2025年8月1日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of sports and entertainment. It operates through the following segments: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), and IMG. The UFC segment refers to a global sports brand and media content company. The WWE segment is involved in media organizations and global leaders in sports entertainment. The IMG segment manages the operations of the IMG business and on location. The company was founded on March 29, 2023 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. 從事提供體育和娛樂業務。它透過以下部門運作：終極格鬥錦標賽 (UFC)、世界摔角娛樂 (WWE) 和 IMG。 UFC 部門是指一家全球運動品牌和媒體內容公司。 WWE 部門涉及媒體組織和體育娛樂的全球領導者。 IMG 部門管理 IMG 業務和現場營運。該公司成立於2023年3月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: AC Immune SA is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of therapeutic and diagnostic products for neurodegenerative diseases. It leverages proprietary technology platforms to discover, design, and develop novel, proprietary medicines for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases associated with protein misfolding. The company was founded by Jean-Marie Lehn, Claude Nicolau, Roscoe Brady, Fred van Leuven, Ruth Greferath, Andrea Pfeifer, and Alexey V. Eliseev on February 13, 2003 and is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: AC Immune SA 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於神經退化性疾病治療和診斷產品的發現和開發。它利用專有技術平台來發現、設計和開發新穎的專有藥物，用於預防、診斷和治療與蛋白質錯誤折疊相關的神經退化性疾病。該公司由 Jean-Marie Lehn、Claude Nicolau、Roscoe Brady、Fred van Leuven、Ruth Greferath、Andrea Pfeifer 和 Alexey V. Eliseev 於 2003 年 2 月 13 日創立，總部位於瑞士洛桑。

info.description: Marathon Bancorp, Inc. is a mutual bank holding company. It offers traditional, commercial, and mortgage banking services. The company was founded in December 2020 and is headquartered in Wausau, WI.
info.description_zh: Marathon Bancorp, Inc. 是一家互助銀行控股公司。它提供傳統、商業和抵押銀行服務。該公司成立於 2020 年 12 月，總部位於威斯康辛州沃索。

info.description: The Marzetti Co. engages in the manufacture and sale of specialty food products. It operates through the Retail and Foodservice segments. The Retail segment focuses on the manufacture and sale of frozen breads, refrigerated dressings and dips, and shelf-stable dressings and croutons. The Foodservice segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of custom-formulated sauces, salad dressings, frozen breads, and yeast rolls. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Westerville, OH.
info.description_zh: Marzetti Co. 從事特色食品的製造和銷售。它透過零售和餐飲服務部門運作。零售部門專注於冷凍麵包、冷藏調味料和蘸醬以及耐儲存調味料和油炸麵包塊的製造和銷售。餐飲服務部門從事客製化醬料、沙拉醬、冷凍麵包和酵母捲的製造和銷售。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於俄亥俄州韋斯特維爾。

info.description: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 18, 2024 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年6月18日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Rail Vision Ltd. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of a technology that focuses on cognitive vision and safety system for the railway industry. It operates through the following segments: Locomotives for Shunting Yards, Locomotives for Passenger and Freight Trains, and Light Rail Vehicle. The Locomotives for Shunting Yards segment focuses on the sale of RV200 system to shunting yard operators. The Locomotives for Passenger and Freight Trains segment promotes sales to passenger and freight train operators. The Light Rail Vehicle segment are in the process of developing an LRV system that will be designed for the light rail market segment. The company was founded by Elen Katz, Shahar Hania, Noam Teich, and Yuval Isbi in 2015 and is headquartered in Ra'anana, Israel.
info.description_zh: Rail Vision Ltd. 從事鐵路行業認知視覺和安全系統技術的設計、開發和製造。它透過以下部門運作：調車場機車、客運和貨運列車機車以及輕軌車輛。調車場機車部門專注於向調車場營運商銷售 RV200 系統。客運和貨運列車機車部門促進對客運和貨運列車營運商的銷售。輕軌車輛部門正在開發專為輕軌市場設計的 LRV 系統。該公司由 Elen Katz、Shahar Hania、Noam Teich 和 Yuval Isbi 於 2015 年創立，總部位於以色列 Ra'anana。

info.description: Eaton Vance High Income Municipal ETF seeks to provide high current income exempt from regular federal income tax. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal obligations, the interest on which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund will primarily invest in "high yield" municipal obligations under normal market conditions.
info.description_zh: 伊頓萬斯高收入市政 ETF 旨在提供免繳常規聯邦所得稅的高額當期收入。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政債務，其利息免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金將主要投資於正常市場條件下的「高收益」市政債券。

info.description: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc. is a cell therapy clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the provision of treatments and potential cures for serious autoimmune diseases. The company was founded in June 2018 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc.是一家細胞治療臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於為嚴重的自體免疫疾病提供治療和潛在治癒方法。該公司成立於 2018 年 6 月，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: ENvue Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company, which specializes in the advancement of intelligent, non-invasive solutions for enteral care across clinical and home care settings. The firm focuses on two technology platforms, ENvue Navigation and ENvue Medical. The company was founded by Harold Jacob and Jona Zumeris on October 20, 2003 and is headquartered in Tyler, TX.
info.description_zh: ENvue Medical, Inc. 是一家医疗技术公司，专注于在临床和家庭护理环境中开发智能、非侵入性肠内护理解决方案。該公司專注於兩個技術平台：ENvue N​​avigation 和 ENvue Medical。該公司由 Harold Jacob 和 Jona Zumeris 於 2003 年 10 月 20 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州泰勒。

info.description: InflaRx NV is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of inhibitors of the complement activation factor known as C5a and its receptor C5aR. Its primary product candidate is Vilobelimab. The company was founded by Niels Christoph Riedemann, Renfeng Guo, and Nicolas Fulpius in December 2007 and is headquartered in Jena, Germany.
info.description_zh: InflaRx NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於補體活化因子 C5a 及其受體 C5aR 抑制劑的發現和開發。其主要候選產品為 Vilobelimab。該公司由 Niels Christoph Riedemann、RenfengGuo 和 Nicolas Fulpius 於 2007 年 12 月創立，總部位於德國耶拿。

info.description: Bridgewater Bancshares, Inc. is a holding company, which provides retail and commercial loan and deposit services. It offers deposits, lending, professional services, and business services. The company was founded by Jerry J. Baack and Jeffrey D. Shellberg in 2005 and is headquartered in St. Louis Park, MN.
info.description_zh: Bridgewater Bancshares, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供零售和商業貸款和存款服務。它提供存款、貸款、專業服務和商業服務。該公司由 Jerry J. Baack 和 Jeffrey D. Shellberg 於 2005 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州聖路易斯帕克。

info.description: Calamos Global Total Return Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. It seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. The fund primarily invests in equities, convertible bonds, and high yield corporate bonds. It employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against MSCI World Index. Calamos Global Total Return Fund was formed on March 30, 2004 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Global Total Return Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封闭式平衡共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。该基金投资于全球公共股权和固定收益市场。它寻求投资于多元化行业运营的公司的证券。该基金主要投资于股票、可转换债券和高收益公司债券。它采用基本面分析和定量分析来创建其投资组合。该基金将其投资组合的表现与 MSCI 世界指数进行比较。 Calamos Global Total Return Fund成立于2004年3月30日，注册地为美国。

info.description: China Automotive Systems, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive products through its subsidiaries. It operates through the following geographical segments: Henglong, Jiulong, Wuhu, Hubei Henglong, Henglong KYB, Brazil Henglong, and Other Entities. It also supplies power steering systems and components. The company was founded on June 29, 1999 and is headquartered in Jingzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 中國汽車系統股份有限公司是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事汽車產品的製造和銷售。它透過以下地理部門進行運作：恆隆、九龍、蕪湖、湖北恆隆、恆隆KYB、巴西恆隆和其他實體。它還提供動力轉向系統和組件。公司成立於1999年6月29日，總部位於中國荊州。

info.description: Northern Trust Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of asset servicing, fund administration, asset management, fiduciary, and banking solutions for corporations, institutions, families, and individuals. It operates through the Asset Servicing and Wealth Management segments. The Asset Servicing segment offers asset servicing, brokerage, banking and related services to corporate and public retirement funds, foundations, endowments, fund managers, insurance companies and sovereign wealth funds. The Wealth Management Segment includes trust, investment management, custody, and philanthropic services, financial consulting, guardianship and estate administration, family business consulting, family financial education, brokerage services and private and business banking. The company was founded on August 12, 1889 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust Corp.是一家金融控股公司，為企業、機構、家庭和個人提供資產服務、基金管理、資產管理、信託和銀行解決方案。它透過資產服務和財富管理部門運作。資產服務部門為企業和公共退休基金、基金會、捐贈基金、基金經理人、保險公司和主權財富基金提供資產服務、經紀、銀行及相關服務。財富管理部門包括信託、投資管理、託管和慈善服務、財務諮詢、監護和遺產管理、家族企業諮詢、家庭金融教育、經紀服務以及私人和商業銀行業務。該公司成立於 1889 年 8 月 12 日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST IONQ ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on IonQ, Inc. 's commons share (NYSE: IONQ) by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST IONQ ETF 尋求透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收益是透過出售 IonQ, Inc. 普通股（NYSE：IONQ）選擇權產生的，該基金旨在實現基礎股票上限 每日表現的 2 倍（200%），並獲得基礎槓桿收益的投資上限。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的槓桿ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Nasdaq 100 Income Target ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cboe QDIV ATM BuyWrite Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the constituent securities of the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that employs a covered call strategy, as determined by Cboe Global Indices, LLC. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Nasdaq 100 Income Target ETF 尋求提供與 Cboe QDIV ATM BuyWrite 指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於基礎指數的成分證券。基礎指數衡量採用有擔保買權策略的理論投資組合的表現，由 Cboe Global Indices, LLC 決定。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan ActiveBuilders Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: Almonty Industries, Inc. engages in the mining, processing, and shipment of tungsten concentrates. Its projects include Almonty Korea Tungsten, Panasquiera mine, Gentung, Almonty Korea Moly, Los Santos mine, and Valtreixal. The company was founded on September 28, 2009 and is headquartered in Dillon, MT.
info.description_zh: Almonty Industries, Inc. 從事鎢精礦的開採、加工和運輸。其項目包括阿爾蒙蒂韓國鎢礦、帕納斯奎拉礦、Gentung、阿爾蒙蒂韓國鉬業、洛斯桑托斯礦和Valtreixal。該公司成立於2009年9月28日，總部位於蒙大拿州狄龍。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST RGTI ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Rigetti Computing, Inc.'s common stock (NYSE: RGTI) (the "Underlying Stock"); to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains is a secondary consideration. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pay weekly distributions by selling put options on the Underlying Leveraged ETF, which provides exposure to 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST RGTI ETF 尋求實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收入是出售 Rigetti Computer, Inc. 普通股（NYSE：RGTI）（「基礎股票」）選擇權所產生的收入；獲得潛在投資收益上限的基礎槓桿ETF的表現是次要考慮因素。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過出售基礎槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權來支付每週分配，該 ETF 提供的曝險是基礎股票每日表現的 2 倍。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq International Patent Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq International Patent Leaders Index. The index is a rules-based full market capitalization-weighted index that consists of companies from the Nasdaq Global Ex United States Large Mid Cap Index with the most valuable patent portfolios. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq International Patent Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克國際專利領導者指數（未計費用和開支）的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的完整市值加權指數，由納斯達克全球（美國除外）大中型股指數中擁有最有價值專利組合的公司組成。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Haoxi Health Technology Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online marketing solutions. It produces online ads for advertisers to acquire, convert, and retain consumers on various media platforms. The company was founded on September 26, 2018 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 浩熙健康科技有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上行銷解決方案。它為廣告商製作線上廣告，以在各種媒體平台上獲取、轉換和留住消費者。公司成立於2018年9月26日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: iShares Asia 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Asia 50TM composed of 50 of the largest Asian equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Asia 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的亞洲股票組成的 S&P Asia 50TM 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 200 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 2,000 securities ranked 1,001 to 3,000 by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 200 種證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數市值排名 1,001 至 3,000 的約 2,000 種合格證券。

info.description: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過利用人工智慧增強的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市大型資本公司的證券。

info.description: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. is dedicated to building an ecosystem that integrates AI and blockchain while bridging Web2 and Web3. Its core products include the BesTrade DeAI Agent and the AIxC ecosystem products. The company was founded on March 29, 2004 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc.致力於建立一個融合人工智慧和區塊鏈、連接Web2和Web3的生態系統。其核心產品包括BesTrade DeAI Agent和AIxC生態產品。該公司成立於2004年3月29日，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Presurance Holdings, Inc. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the sale of property and casualty insurance products. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Lines, Personal Lines, and Corporate. The company was founded on October 27, 2009 and is headquartered in Troy, MI.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Presurance Holdings, Inc.是一家保險控股公司，從事財產和意外保險產品的銷售。它透過以下部門運作：商業部門、個人部門和企業部門。該公司成立於2009年10月27日，總部位於密西根州特洛伊。

info.description: NuCana Plc is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the business of developing a portfolio of new medicines to treat patients with cancer. The company was founded by Hugh Stephen Griffith and Christopher Barry Wood on January 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Edinburgh, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: NuCana Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它從事開發治療癌症患者的新藥組合的業務。該公司由休·史蒂芬·格里菲斯和克里斯托弗·巴里·伍德於1997年1月28日創立，總部位於英國愛丁堡。

info.description: Flux Power Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, development, and sale of rechargeable lithium-ion energy storage systems for industrial applications. It focuses on electric forklifts and airport ground support equipment. The company was founded by Christopher L. Anthony and Michael Johnson on September 21, 1998 and is headquartered in Vista, CA.
info.description_zh: Flux Power Holdings, Inc.從事工業應用可充電鋰離子儲能係統的設計、開發和銷售。專注於電動堆高機和機場地面保障設備。該公司由 Christopher L. Anthony 和 Michael Johnson 於 1998 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於加州維斯塔。

info.description: Gorilla Technology Group, Inc. engages in the provision of video intelligence, Internet of Things (IoT) security, edge AI data analytics, and operational technology security solutions and services in Asia Pacific. It operates through the following segments: Video IoT, Security Convergence, and Other. The company was founded by Spincer Koh in May 2001 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Gorilla Technology Group, Inc.在亞太地區提供視訊智慧、物聯網（IoT）安全、邊緣人工智慧資料分析以及營運技術安全解決方案和服務。它透過以下部分運作：視訊物聯網、安全融合等。該公司由Spincer Koh於2001年5月創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Atossa Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of novel therapeutics and delivery methods for the treatment of breast cancer and other breast conditions. The company was founded by Steven C. Quay and Shu Chih Chen in December 2008 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Atossa Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療乳癌和其他乳房疾病的新型療法和遞送方法。該公司由 Steven C. Quay 和 Shu Chih Chen 於 2008 年 12 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: MaxCyte, Inc. engages in the development and licensing of cell-engineering technologies to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Its propriety cell therapy is used in drug discovery and development, and biomanufacturing. Its products include ATx, STx, and GTx instruments. The company was founded by Douglas A. Doerfler on July 31, 1998 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: MaxCyte, Inc. 致力於為製藥和生物技術公司開發和授權細胞工程技術。其專有的細胞療法用於藥物發現和開發以及生物製造。其產品包括 ATx、STx 和 GTx 儀器。該公司由 Douglas A. Doerfler 於 1998 年 7 月 31 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Ideal Power, Inc. engages in the development of power converter solutions for photovoltaic generation, grid-storage and electrified vehicle charging. Its products include solar inverters, bi-directional battery, electric vehicle chargers, photovoltaic inverters and battery converters. It is focused on its patented Bidirectional, Bipolar Junction Transistor (B-TRAN) semiconductor technology. The company was founded by William C. Alexander on May 17, 2007 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Ideal Power, Inc. 致力於開發光伏發電、電網儲存和電動車充電的電源轉換器解決方案。其產品包括太陽能逆變器、雙向電池、電動車充電器、光伏逆變器和電池轉換器。它專注於其專利的雙向雙極結晶體管（B-TRAN）半導體技術。該公司由 William C. Alexander 於 2007 年 5 月 17 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: GigaMedia Ltd. is engaged in the provision of digital entertainment services. Through its subsidiary, FunTown, it manages mobile and browse-based casual games. Its portfolio includes MahJong, online card games, and multi-player role-playing online games. The company was founded in October 1998 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: GigaMedia Ltd. 從事提供數位娛樂服務。它透過其子公司 FunTown 管理行動和基於瀏覽的休閒遊戲。其產品包括麻將、線上紙牌遊戲和多人角色扮演線上遊戲。公司成立於1998年10月，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: MultiSensor AI Holdings, Inc. develops and manufactures infrared-sensor systems. Its AWS-powered software leverages ICI-built thermal imaging, acoustic imaging, and vibration sensing platforms for condition-based monitoring of critical mechanical and electrical assets and manufactured outputs. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: MultiSensor AI Holdings, Inc. 開發和製造紅外線感測器系統。其由 AWS 提供支援的軟體利用 ICI 建構的熱成像、聲學成像和振動感測平台，對關鍵機械和電氣資產以及製造輸出進行基於狀態的監控。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Arq, Inc. is a holding company. It engages in the provision of environmental and emission control equipment to the power generation industry. The company operates through the following Segments: Refined Coal and Advanced Purification Technologies. The Refined Coal segment includes the Tinuum Group, Tinuum Services, and GWN Manager. The Advanced Purification Technologies segment refers to the sale of Activated Carbon Injection and Dry Sorbent Injection equipment systems, chemical sales, consulting services, and other sales related to the reduction of emissions in the coal-fired electric generation process and the electric utility industry. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Greenwood Village, CO.
info.description_zh: Arq, Inc. 是一家控股公司。它致力於為發電行業提供環境和排放控制設備。該公司透過以下部門運作：精煉煤部門和先進淨化技術部門。精煉煤部門包括 Tinuum Group、Tinuum Services 和 GWN Manager。先進淨化技術部門涉及活性碳噴射和乾吸附劑噴射設備系統的銷售、化學品銷售、諮詢服務以及與燃煤發電過程和電力行業減排相關的其他銷售。該公司成立於 1996 年，總部位於科羅拉多州格林伍德村。

info.description: MDxHealth SA is a commercial-stage precision diagnostics company, which engages in the development and commercialization of molecular diagnostic products for personalized cancer treatment. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States of America, Europe and Rest of the World. The firm offers ConfirmMDx, SelectMDx, AssureMDx, InformMDx, SelectMDx, and MonitorMDx. The company was founded by Herman Spolders and Philip S. Devine on January 10, 2003 and is headquartered in Herstal, Belgium.
info.description_zh: MDxHealth SA 是一家商業階段的精準診斷公司，致力於用於個人化癌症治療的分子診斷產品的開發和商業化。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司提供ConfirmMDx、SelectMDx、AssureMDx、InformMDx、SelectMDx 和MonitorMDx。該公司由 Herman Spolders 和 Philip S. Devine 於 2003 年 1 月 10 日創立，總部位於比利時赫斯塔爾。

info.description: eXoZymes, Inc. is a development stage synthetic biochemical company. Its synthetic biology platform would enable the scalable exploration of many molecules and properties found in nature. The company was founded by Tyler Korman and Paul Opgenorth in April 2019 and is headquartered in Monrovia, NV.
info.description_zh: eXoZymes, Inc. 是一家處於發展階段的合成生化公司。其合成生物學平台將使對自然界中發現的許多分子和特性的可擴展探索成為可能。該公司由 Tyler Korman 和 Paul Opgenorth 於 2019 年 4 月創立，總部位於內華達州蒙羅維亞。

info.description: BGIN Blockchain Ltd. engages in the cryptocurrency mining business. The firm operates through cryptocurrency mining and sale of mining machines segments. The company was founded by Qingfeng Wu and Qiuhua Li in 2019 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: BGIN Blockchain Ltd.從事加密貨幣挖礦業務。該公司透過加密貨幣開採和礦機銷售業務運作。該公司由吳慶峰和李秋華於2019年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: GameSquare Holdings, Inc. is a digital media, entertainment, and technology company. The firm operates through the following segments: Owned and Operated IP, Agency, Software as a Service (SaaS) and managed services, and Yield. Its platforms include Code Red, Zoned, and Faze. The company was founded on April 8, 2011 and is headquartered in Frisco, TX.
info.description_zh: GameSquare Holdings, Inc. 是一家數位媒體、娛樂和科技公司。該公司透過以下部門運作：自有和營​​運的智慧財產權部門、代理部門、軟體即服務 (SaaS) 和託管服務部門以及收益部門。其平台包括 Code Red、Zoned 和 Faze。該公司成立於2011年4月8日，總部位於德克薩斯州弗里斯科。

info.description: Vuzix Corp. is a supplier of Smart-Glasses and Augmented Reality technologies and products for the consumer and enterprise markets. Its products include personal display and wearable computing devices that offer users a portable viewing experience, provide solutions for mobility, wearable displays and augmented reality. The firm also holds 246 patents and patents pending and numerous IP licenses in the Video Eyewear field. It has offices in Rochester, NY, Oxford, UK, and Tokyo, Japan. The company was founded by Paul J. Travers in 1997 and is headquartered in West Henrietta, NY.
info.description_zh: Vuzix Corp. 是一家為消費者和企業市場提供智慧眼鏡和擴增實境技術及產品的供應商。其產品包括個人顯示器和穿戴式運算設備，為使用者提供便攜式觀看體驗，並提供行動性、穿戴式顯示器和擴增實境解決方案。該公司還在視訊眼鏡領域擁有 246 項專利和正在申請的專利以及眾多智慧財產權許可。它在紐約羅徹斯特、英國牛津和日本東京設有辦事處。該公司由 Paul J. Travers 於 1997 年創立，總部位於紐約州西亨麗埃塔。

info.description: Arbe Robotics Ltd. develops radar and operating system for drones, automotive, and robots. It provides 4D imaging radar solution for autonomous vehicles. The company was founded by Kobi Marenko, Noam Arkind and Oz Fixman on 4th November, 2015 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Arbe Robotics Ltd. 為無人機、汽車和機器人開發雷達和作業系統。它為自動駕駛車輛提供4D成像雷達解決方案。該公司由 Kobi Marenko、Noam Arkind 和 Oz Fixman 於 2015 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Aduro Clean Technologies, Inc. engages in the manufacture of oils and specialty chemicals using waste plastics. It focuses on hydrochemolytic technology to transform post-consumer polymer waste into a resource for the circular economy. It also develops a novel chemical conversion process to transform waste plastics and low grade renewable oils into renewable fuels and specialty chemicals. The company was founded on January 10, 2018 by Ofer Vicus and William Marcus Trygstad and is headquartered in Sarnia, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aduro Clean Technologies, Inc. 從事利用廢塑膠生產油和特殊化學品。它專注於水化學分解技術，將消費後的聚合物廢物轉化為循環經濟的資源。它還開發了一種新穎的化學轉化工藝，將廢塑膠和低級可再生油轉化為可再生燃料和特殊化學品。該公司由 Ofer Vicus 和 William Marcus Trygstad 於 2018 年 1 月 10 日創立，總部位於加拿大薩尼亞。

info.description: GDS Holdings Ltd. engages in developing and operating data centers in China. It builds, operates, and transfers data centers at other locations. Its data centers are carrier and cloud-neutral, which enable customers to connect to major telecommunications carriers, and to access a number of cloud service providers. The firm also offers colocation and managed services, which include direct private connection to major public cloud platforms. The company was founded by William Wei Huang in 2001 and is headquartered in Pudong, China.
info.description_zh: 萬國資料控股有限公司在中國從事資料中心的開發和營運。它在其他地點建立、運作和轉移資料中心。其資料中心與營運商和雲端無關，使客戶能夠連接到主要電信營運商，並存取許多雲端服務供應商。該公司還提供託管和託管服務，其中包括與主要公有雲平台的直接私人連接。該公司由William Wei Huang於2001年創立，總部位於中國浦東。

info.description: AudioCodes Ltd. engages in the provision of communications software, products and productivity solutions for the digital workplace. The firm is involved in the development, manufacture, and market of products for transferring voice and data over the internet. Its products include products for Microsoft 365, session border controllers, multi-service business routers, meeting rooms, internet protocol phones, digital and analog media gateways, management products and solutions, and voice applications. The company was founded by Shabtai Adlersberg in 1992 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: AudioCodes Ltd. 致力於為數位工作場所提供通訊軟體、產品和生產力解決方案。該公司從事透過網路傳輸語音和數據的產品的開發、製造和銷售。其產品包括Microsoft 365產品、會話邊界控制器、多服務業務路由器、會議室、網際網路協定電話、數位和類比媒體閘道、管理產品和解決方案以及語音應用程式。該公司由 Shabtai Adlersberg 於 1992 年創立，總部位於以色列 Or Yehuda。

info.description: Aclarion, Inc. is a healthcare technology company, which engages in the provision of Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (MRS), and a proprietary biomarker to optimize clinical treatments. It utilizes Artificial Intelligence to assist in quality control processes that flag spectroscopy data indicative of a poor MRS study. It offers NOCISCAN Suite, a revolutionary software suite that works with existing high field Magnetic Resonance systems and Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy pulse sequence packages using an optimized protocol to conduct MRS exams of lumbar discs. The company was founded by James C. Peacock, David S. Bradford, and Jeffrey Lotz in 2008 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Aclarion, Inc. 是一家醫療保健技術公司，致力於提供磁振造影波譜 (MRS) 和用於優化臨床治療的專有生物標記。它利用人工智慧來協助品質控制過程，標記表明 MRS 研究不佳的光譜數據。它提供 NOCISCAN Suite，這是一款革命性的軟體套件，可與現有的高場磁共振系統和磁共振波譜脈衝序列包配合使用，使用優化的協議對腰椎間盤進行 MRS 檢查。該公司由 James C. Peacock、David S. Bradford 和 Jeffrey Lotz 於 2008 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: SOLV Energy, Inc. engages in providing infrastructure services to the power industry, including engineering, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, operations, maintenance, and repowering. It specialized in designing, building, and maintaining utility-scale solar and battery storage projects. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: SOLV Energy, Inc.致力於為電力產業提供基礎設施服務，包括工程、採購、施工、測試、調試、營運、維護和重新供電。它專門從事設計、建造和維護公用事業規模的太陽能和電池儲存專案。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: ATA Creativity Global engages in the provision of quality learning experiences that cultivate and enhance students' creativity. It offers a range of education services consisting primarily of portfolio training, research-based learning, overseas study counselling and other educational services through its training center network. It operates under the following segments: Overseas Art Study Services, Other Educational Services, and K-12 Education Assessment and Other Services. The company was founded by Kevin Xiaofeng Ma and Walter Lin Wang in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: ATA Creativity Global 致力於提供優質的學習體驗，培養並提升學生的創造力。它透過其培訓中心網絡提供一系列教育服務，主要包括作品集培訓、研究性學習、海外留學諮詢和其他教育服務。它的業務包括以下部門：海外藝術學習服務、其他教育服務以及 K-12 教育評估和其他服務。該公司由馬曉峰和王林於1999年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Quantum BioPharma Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in building a portfolio of assets and biotech solutions for the treatment of neurodegenerative, inflammatory, metabolic disorders, and alcohol misuse disorders with drug candidates in different stages of development. It operates through the Biopharmaceutical and Strategic Investments segments. The Biopharmaceutical segment focuses on furthering the research and development of the drug candidates and the development of a treatment for alcohol misuse for application in hospitals and other medical practices. The Strategic Investments segment is involved in the generation of returns and cash flow through the issuance of loans secured by residential property, with FSD Strategic Investments having a first or second collateral mortgage on the secured property. The company was founded by Thomas Fairfull, Zeeshan Saeed, and Anthony J. Durkacz on October 20, 1994 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Quantum BioPharma Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於建立資產組合和生物技術解決方案，以治療神經退化性疾病、發炎、代謝性疾病和酒精濫用疾病，其候選藥物處於不同的開發階段。它透過生物製藥和戰略投資部門運作。生物製藥部門專注於進一步候選藥物的研究和開發，以及開髮用於醫院和其他醫療實踐的酒精濫用治療方法。戰略投資部門透過發行以住宅房產為抵押的貸款來產生回報和現金流，FSD 戰略投資部門對有擔保的房產擁有第一或第二抵押抵押貸款。該公司由 Thomas Fairfull、Zeeshan Saeed 和 Anthony J. Durkacz 於 1994 年 10 月 20 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Pixelworks, Inc. engages in the design and development of integrated circuits used in electronic display devices. It offers consumer electronics and professional display products, video delivery, and streaming solutions for content service providers. Its product categories consist of ImageProcessor integrated circuits (ICs), video co-processor ICs, and transcode ICs. The company was founded by Allen H. Alley, Michael G. West, Kenneth Hunkins, Robert Y. Greenberg and Bradley A. Zenger in 1997 and is headquartered in Portland, OR.
info.description_zh: Pixelworks, Inc. 從事電子顯示設備中使用的積體電路的設計和開發。它為內容服務提供者提供消費性電子產品和專業顯示產品、視訊傳輸和串流媒體解決方案。其產品類別包括影像處理器積體電路（IC）、視訊協處理器IC和轉碼IC。該公司由 Allen H. Alley、Michael G. West、Kenneth Hunkins、Robert Y. Greenberg 和 Bradley A. Zenger 於 1997 年創立，總部位於俄勒岡州波特蘭。

info.description: NN, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture high-precision components and assemblies primarily for the electrical, automotive, general industrial, aerospace and defense, and medical markets. It operates through the Mobile Solutions and Power Solutions segments. The Mobile Solutions segment manufactures system critical components for fuel systems, engines and transmissions, power steering systems, and electromechanical motors. The Power Solutions segment designs and produces a broad range of high-precision metal and plastic components, assemblies, and finished devices used in applications ranging from power control to flight control, and for military devices. The company was founded by Richard D. Ennen in October 1980 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: NN, Inc. 致力於設計和製造高精度零件和組件，主要面向電氣、汽車、一般工業、航空航太和國防以及醫療市場。它透過行動解決方案和電源解決方案部門運作。行動解決方案部門生產燃油系統、引擎和變速箱、動力轉向系統和機電馬達的系統關鍵部件。電源解決方案部門設計和生產各種高精度金屬和塑膠零件、組件和成品設備，用於從電源控製到飛行控制以及軍事設備等應用。該公司由 Richard D. Ennen 於 1980 年 10 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Expion360, Inc. engages in the design, assembly, manufacturing and sale of lithium iron phosphate batteries and supporting accessories. It primarily focuses on the recreational vehicles and marine industries. The company was founded by John Yozamp and Paul Shoun on June 16, 2016 and is headquartered in Redmond, OR.
info.description_zh: Expion360, Inc.從事磷酸鐵鋰電池及配套配件的設計、組裝、製造和銷售。它主要專注於休閒車和海洋工業。該公司由 John Yozamp 和 Paul Shoun 於 2016 年 6 月 16 日創立，總部位於俄勒岡州雷德蒙德。

info.description: AudioEye, Inc. engages in the provision of digital accessibility technology solutions. It offers patented, Internet content publication and distribution software which enables the conversion of any media into an accessible format and allowing real-time distribution to end-users on any Internet connected device. The company was founded by Nathaniel T. Bradley, Sean D. Bradley, David J. Ide, and James G. Crawford on May 20, 2005 and is headquartered in Tucson, AZ.
info.description_zh: AudioEye, Inc. 致力於提供數位無障礙技術解決方案。它提供获得专利的互联网内容发布和分发软件，可以将任何媒体转换为可访问的格式，并允许在任何互联网连接设备上实时分发给最终用户。该公司由 Nathaniel T. Bradley、Sean D. Bradley、David J. Ide 和 James G. Crawford 于 2005 年 5 月 20 日创立，总部位于亚利桑那州图森。

info.description: Nano Dimension Ltd. engages in the provision of intelligent machines for the fabrication of additively manufactured electronics. Its products include DragonFly IV, AME Materials, Fabrica 2.0, Fabrica Micro-AM Materials, Essemtec SMT Equipment, and Global Inkjet System. The company was founded by Amit Dror and Simon Anthony-Fried in 2012 and headquartered in Ness Ziona, Israel.
info.description_zh: Nano Dimension Ltd. 致力於為積層製造電子產品的製造提供智慧機器。其產品包括 DragonFly IV、AME Materials、Fabrica 2.0、Fabrica Micro-AM Materials、Essemtec SMT 裝置和 Global Inkjet System。該公司由 Amit Dror 和 Simon Anthony-Fried 於 2012 年創立，總部位於以色列 Ness Ziona。

info.description: NANO Nuclear Energy, Inc. is a microreactor and nuclear technology company, which provides supply energy services. Its products in technical development are ZEUS, a solid core battery reactor, and ODIN, a low-pressure coolant reactor. The company is founded by Jiang Yu in February, 2022 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: NANO Nuclear Energy, Inc.是一家微反應器和核子技術公司，提供供應能源服務。其技術開發產品有ZEUS（實心電池堆）和ODIN（低壓冷卻劑堆）。該公司由姜宇於2022年2月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. engages in the development and operation of seawater desalination plants and water distribution systems. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Bulk, Services, Manufacturing, and Corporate. The Retail segment operates the water utility for the Seven Mile Beach and West Bay areas of Grand Cayman Islands. The Bulk segment supplies potable water to government utilities in Grand Cayman and the Bahamas. The Services segment designs, constructs, and sells water infrastructure, and provides management and operating services to third parties. The Manufacturing segment focuses on the manufacture and service of custom and specialized water-related products applicable to commercial, municipal and industrial water production, supply, and treatment. The Corporate segment consists of various expenses of general and administrative nature to the firm. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd.從事海水淡化廠和配水系統的開發和營運。它透過以下部門運作：零售部門、散貨部門、服務部門、製造部門和企業部門。零售部門經營大開曼群島七英里海灘和西灣地區的自來水公司。散裝部門向大開曼島和巴哈馬的政府公用事業供應飲用水。服務部門設計、建造和銷售水基礎設施，並向第三方提供管理和營運服務。製造部門專注於適用於商業、市政和工業水生產、供應和處理的客製化和專業水相關產品的製造和服務。公司部門包括公司的各種一般性和行政性費用。該公司成立於1973年，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: GridAI Technologies Corp. is a diversified technology and life sciences company, which engages in the research and development of targeted, non-systemic therapies for the treatment of patients with gastrointestinal diseases. Its pipeline includes Latiglutenase, Capeserod, Adrulipase, and Niclosamide. The company was founded on January 30, 2014 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: GridAI Technologies Corp.是一家多元化的技術和生命科學公司，致力於研究和開發用於治療胃腸道疾病患者的標靶非系統療法。其管道包括 Latiglutenase、Capeserod、Adrulipase 和 Niclosamide。該公司成立於2014年1月30日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: JFB Construction Holdings is a commercial and residential real estate construction and development company, which engages in delivering services to commercial and residential markets. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Construction, Residential Construction, and Real Estate Development. The Commercial Construction segment includes all activities related to the construction of commercial properties. The Residential Construction segment focuses on the construction of residential properties including single-family homes and multi-family units. The Real Estate Development segment refers to the acquisition, development, and sale of real estate properties. The company was founded by Joseph F. Basille III on April 9, 2024 and is headquartered in Lantana, FL.
info.description_zh: JFB Construction Holdings 是一家商業和住宅房地產建設和開發公司，致力於為商業和住宅市場提供服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業建築、住宅建築和房地產開發。商業建築部門包括與商業房地產建設相關的所有活動。住宅建築部門專注於住宅物業的建設，包括單戶住宅和多戶住宅。房地產開發部門是指房地產的收購、開發和銷售。該公司由 Joseph F. Basille III 於 2024 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州蘭塔納。

info.description: SolarMax Technology, Inc. is an integrated solar and renewable energy company. The firm engages in the provision of global energy solutions for residential and commercial markets. Its solar products include home solar, SMX solar panels, home battery, and electric car charging. The firm operates through the following segments: the United States and China. The United States operations consist of the sale and installation of photovoltaic and battery backup systems for residential and commercial customers, and sales of LED systems and services to government and commercial users. The China operations consist of identifying and procuring solar farm projects for resale to third parties and performing EPC services for solar farm projects. The company was founded by David Hsu, Simon Yuan and Ching Liu in January 2008 and is headquartered in Riverside, CA.
info.description_zh: SolarMax Technology, Inc.是一家綜合性太陽能和再生能源公司。該公司致力於為住宅和商業市場提供全球能源解決方案。其太陽能產品包括家用太陽能、SMX太陽能板、家用電池和電動車充電。該公司透過以下部門運作：美國和中國。美國業務包括為住宅和商業客戶銷售和安裝光伏和電池備援系統，以及向政府和商業用戶銷售 LED 系統和服務。中國業務包括物色和採購太陽能發電場專案以轉售給第三方，以及為太陽能發電場專案提供EPC服務。該公司由 David Hsu、Simon Yuan 和 Ching Liu 於 2008 年 1 月創立，總部位於加州里弗賽德。

info.description: Neonode, Inc. engages in the provision of advanced optical sensing solutions for contactless touch, touch, and gesture sensing. It offers software solutions for scene analysis that feature advanced machine learning algorithms to detect and track persons and objects in video streams for cameras and other types of imagers. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Japan, South Korea, China, Germany, Switzerland, and Other. The company was founded by Thomas Eriksson Bjorn on September 4, 1997 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
info.description_zh: Neonode, Inc. 致力於為非接觸式觸控、觸控和手勢感測提供先進的光學感測解決方案。它提供用於場景分析的軟體解決方案，具有先進的機器學習演算法，可以檢測和追蹤攝影機和其他類型成像器視訊串流中的人員和物體。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、日本、韓國、中國、德國、瑞士等。該公司由 Thomas Eriksson Bjorn 於 1997 年 9 月 4 日創立，總部位於瑞典斯德哥爾摩。

info.description: Grandstand Ltd. is a marketing company, which engages in the provision of digital marketing services for the online gambling industry. It focuses on iGaming and sports betting. The company was founded by Charles Gillespie and Kevin McCrystle on July 26, 2006 and is headquartered in St. Helier, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Grandstand Ltd. 是一家行銷公司，致力於為線上賭博產業提供數位行銷服務。它專注於網路博彩和體育博彩。該公司由 Charles Gillespie 和 Kevin McCrystle 於 2006 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國聖赫利爾。

info.description: Dogness (International) Corp. engages in the provision of design and manufacture of pet products, including leashes, and smart products. Its products include leashes, lanyards, ribbon, collars, harnesses ornaments, and specialty products for cats and dogs. The firm produces the products in Classic, Elegance, Luxury, LED, Holiday, Special Function, and Cat series. The company was founded by Shilong Chen in 2003 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
info.description_zh: 多尼斯（國際）有限公司從事寵物產品的設計和製造，包括牽引繩和智慧產品。其產品包括皮帶、掛繩、緞帶、項圈、挽具裝飾品以及貓狗專用產品。本公司生產的產品有經典系列、優雅系列、豪華系列、LED系列、假日系列、特殊功能係列、貓咪系列等。該公司由陳世龍於2003年創立，總部位於中國東莞。

info.description: 9F, Inc. is an Internet technology company, which operates as a digital financial account platform integrating and personalizing financial services. It provides financial products and services across loan products, online wealth management products, and payment facilitation, all integrated under a single digital financial account. The company was founded by Lei Liu and Li Xing Chen in August 2006 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 9F, Inc.是一家網路科技公司，致力於整合和個人化金融服務的數位金融帳戶平台。它提供涵蓋貸款產品、線上理財產品和支付便利的金融產品和服務，所有這些都整合在一個數位金融帳戶下。該公司由劉雷和陳李星於2006年8月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: EquipmentShare.com, Inc. is a digitally-native equipment rental platform servicing the largest jobsites nationwide. It operates through the following segments: Equipment Rental and Services Operations, and Equipment Sales. The Equipment Rental and Services Operations segment engages in recurring activities at full-service branch locations, including equipment rentals and related services, as well as the sale of parts, supplies, and maintenance services. The Equipment Sales segment engages in the sale of new and used equipment through branch locations and dealership sites, including sales to participants in the OWN Program. The company was founded by Jabbok Schlacks and William J. Schlacks IV in 2014 and is headquartered in Columbia, MO.
info.description_zh: EquipmentShare.com, Inc. 是一個數位原生設備租賃平台，為全國最大的工作場所提供服務。它透過以下部門運作：設備租賃和服務營運以及設備銷售。設備租賃和服務營運部門在全方位服務分公司從事經常性活動，包括設備租賃和相關服務，以及零件、用品和維護服務的銷售。設備銷售部門透過分公司和經銷商站點從事新設備和二手設備的銷售，包括向 OWN 計畫參與者的銷售。該公司由 Jabbok Schlacks 和 William J. Schlacks IV 於 2014 年創立，總部位於密蘇裡州哥倫比亞。

info.description: Rapid7, Inc. engages in the provision of cyber security analytics and automation services. Its products include Metasploit, Nexpose, AppSpider, tCell by Rapid7, as well as insight platforms such as InsightDR, InsightIVM, InsightAppSec, InsightConnect, and InsightOps. The firm also offers security and product consulting services. The company was founded by Alan P. Matthews, Tas Giakouminakis, and Chad Loder in July 2000 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Rapid7, Inc. 從事提供網路安全分析和自動化服務。其產品包括Metasploit、Nexpose、AppSpider、Rapid7的tCell，以及InsightDR、InsightIVM、InsightAppSec、InsightConnect和InsightOps等洞察平台。該公司還提供安全和產品諮詢服務。該公司由 Alan P. Matthews、Tas Giakouminakis 和 Chad Loder 於 2000 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Evotec SE is a life science company, which engages in the discovery and development of new drugs for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. It operates through the Shared R&D and Just-Evotec Biologics segments. The Shared R&D segment includes drug discovery and development services and solutions. The Just-Evotec Biologics segment provides services related to designing, discovering, developing, and manufacturing of modern biotherapeutics. The company was founded by Manfred Eigen, Karsten Henco, Ulrich Aldag, Freimut Leidenberger, Heinrich Maria Schulte, Rudolf Rigler, Charles Weissmann, and Nobel Laureate on December 8, 1993 and is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Evotec SE 是一家生命科學公司，致力於為製藥和生物技術公司發現和開發新藥。它透過共享研發部門和 Just-Evotec Biologics 部門運作。共享研發部門包括藥物發現及開發服務及解決方案。 Just-Evotec Biologics 部門提供與現代生物治療藥物的設計、發現、開發和製造相關的服務。該公司由Manfred Eigen、Karsten Henco、Ulrich Aldag、Freimut Leidenberger、Heinrich Maria Schulte、Rudolf Rigler、Charles Weissmann和諾貝爾獎得主於1993年12月8日創立，總部位於德國漢堡。

info.description: indie Semiconductor, Inc. is an autotech company, which engages in the provision of automotive semiconductor and software solutions for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), driver automation, in-cabin, user experience, and electrification applications. It also focuses on edge sensors across multiple modalities spanning light detection and ranging, radar, ultrasound, and computer vision. The company was founded by Donald Kenneth McClymont, Ichiro Aoki, Scott Kee, and David Kang on February 9, 2007 and is headquartered in Aliso Viejo, CA.
info.description_zh: indie Semiconductor, Inc. 是一家汽車技術公司，致力於為高級駕駛員輔助系統 (ADAS)、駕駛員自動化、車內、用戶體驗和電氣化應用提供汽車半導體和軟體解決方案。它還專注於跨光檢測和測距、雷達、超音波和電腦視覺等多種模式的邊緣感測器。該公司由 Donald Kenneth McClymont、Ichiro Aoki、Scott Kee 和 David Kang 於 2007 年 2 月 9 日創立，總部位於加州亞里索維耶荷。

info.description: Playboy, Inc. operates as a media and lifestyle company. It connects consumers around the world with products, services, and experiences to help them look good, feel good, and have fun. The firm serves consumers in the following categories: Sexual Wellness, Style & Apparel, Gaming & Lifestyle, and Beauty & Grooming. Its flagship consumer brand, Playboy, publishes a magazine for men that focus primarily on photography, entertainment, humor, and cartoons as well as articles on current issues and trends. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Playboy, Inc. 是一家媒體和生活風格公司。它將世界各地的消費者與產品、服務和體驗聯繫起來，幫助他們看起來漂亮、感覺良好並享受樂趣。該公司為以下類別的消費者提供服務：性健康、時尚與服裝、遊戲與生活方式以及美容與美容。其旗艦消費品牌花花公子出版了一本男性雜誌，主要關注攝影、娛樂、幽默和卡通，以及有關當前問題和趨勢的文章。該公司成立於 1953 年，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Wetour Robotics Ltd. operates as a holding company. It engages in the provision of mobility solutions with artificial intelligence augmented online support and itinerary management support. The firm offers shuttle, customized chartered bus, packaged tour, and other services to customers. The company was founded on February 10, 2022 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Wetour Robotics Ltd. 以控股公司方式營運。它致力於提供具有人工智慧增強線上支援和行程管理支援的行動解決方案。該公司為客戶提供接駁車、客製化包車、跟團遊等服務。公司成立於2022年2月10日，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Corning, Inc. engages in the provision of glass for notebook computers, flat panel desktop monitors, display televisions, and other information display applications, carrier network and enterprise network products for the telecommunications industry, ceramic substrates for gasoline and diesel engines in automotive and heavy-duty vehicle markets, laboratory products for the scientific community and polymer products for biotechnology applications, optical materials for the semiconductor industry and the scientific community, and polycrystalline silicon products and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Optical Communications, Display, Specialty Materials, Automotive, and Life Sciences. The Optical Communications segment is classified into two main product groupings: carrier and enterprise network. The carrier network group consists of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data, and voice communications. The enterprise network group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments, and individuals for their own use. The Display Technologies segment manufactures glass substrates for flat panel displays, including organic light-emitting diodes and liquid crystal displays that are used primarily in televisions, notebook computers, desktop monitors, tablets, and handheld devices. The Specialty Materials segment is involved in the manufacture of products that provide material formulations for glass, glass ceramics and crystals, and precision metrology instruments and software. The Automotive segment manufactures ceramic substrates and filter products for emissions control in mobile applications around the world as well as technical glass and optic products and solutions for the interior and exterior of vehicles. The Life Sciences segment develops, manufactures, and supplies laboratory products. The company was founded by Amory Houghton Sr. in 1851 and is headquartered in Corning, NY.
info.description_zh: 康寧公司致力於為筆記型電腦、平板桌上型顯示器、顯示器電視和其他資訊顯示應用提供玻璃，為電信業提供營運商網路和企業網路產品，為汽車和重型汽車市場的汽油和柴油引擎提供陶瓷基板，為科學界提供實驗室產品，為生物技術應用提供聚合物產品，為半導體產業和科學界提供光學材料，以及多晶矽產品和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：光通訊、顯示器、特殊材料、汽車和生命科學。光通訊領域分為兩個主要產品組：營運商網路和企業網路。營運商網路集團包括用於視訊、數據和語音通訊等服務的光通訊基礎設施的產品和解決方案。企業網路組主要由出售給企業、政府和個人供其自用的基於光的通訊網路組成。顯示技術部門生產用於平面顯示器的玻璃基板，包括主要用於電視、筆記型電腦、桌上型顯示器、平板電腦和手持設備的有機發光二極管和液晶顯示器。特種材料部門從事為玻璃、玻璃陶瓷和晶體提供材料配方的產品的製造，以及精密計量儀器和軟體。汽車部門生產用於全球移動應用排放控制的陶瓷基板和過濾器產品，以及用於車輛內部和外部的技術玻璃和光學產品和解決方案。生命科學部門開發、製造和供應實驗室產品。該公司由 Amory Houghton Sr. 於 1851 年創立，總部位於紐約州康寧。

info.description: Tempest Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company advancing a diverse portfolio of small molecule product candidates containing tumor-targeted and/or immune-mediated mechanisms with the potential to treat a wide range of tumors. The company's novel programs range from early research to later-stage investigation in a randomized global study in first-line cancer patients. Tempest Therapeutics was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.
info.description_zh: Tempest Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於開發多種小分子候選產品組合，其中包含腫瘤靶向和/或免疫介導機制，具有治療多種腫瘤的潛力。該公司的新穎項目涵蓋從早期研究到針對第一線癌症患者的隨機全球研究的後期調查。 Tempest Therapeutics 成立於 2011 年，總部位於加州布里斯班。

info.description: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory, Inc. operates as an international franchiser of chocolate and confection stores. Its products include milk chocolate, dark chocolate, boxed chocolate, truffles, caramels, and gourmet caramel apples. The firm operates through the following segments: Franchising, Manufacturing, Retail Stores, and Unallocated. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Durango, CO.
info.description_zh: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory, Inc. 是一家國際巧克力和糖果店特許經營商。其產品包括牛奶巧克力、黑巧克力、盒裝巧克力、松露、焦糖和美味焦糖蘋果。該公司透過以下部門運作：特許經營、製造、零售店和未分配部門。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於科羅拉多州杜蘭戈。

info.description: Arqit Quantum, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services via satellite and terrestrial forms. Its product is QuantumCloud which secures devices with cloud-based quantum encryption. The company was founded by David John Williams and David James Bestwick on April 26, 2021 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arqit Quantum, Inc. 致力於透過衛星和地面形式提供網路安全服務。其產品是 QuantumCloud，它透過基於雲端的量子加密來保護設備。該公司由 David John Williams 和 David James Bestwick 於 2021 年 4 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Dominari Holdings, Inc. engages in wealth management, investment banking, sales and trading, and asset management through its subsidiaries. It operates through the Dominari Financial and Legacy AIkido business segments. The Dominari Financial segment represents the company's broker-dealer business, which is composed of mostly underwriting and transactional service activities. The Legacy AIkido segment includes Aikido Labs, which manages the investments holdings of the legacy entity. The company was founded by Gilbert V. Levin and M. Karen Levin in 1967 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Dominari Holdings, Inc.透過其子公司從事財富管理、投資銀行、銷售和交易以及資產管理業務。它透過 Dominari Financial 和 Legacy AIkido 業務部門運作。 Dominari Financial 部門代表該公司的經紀自營商業務，主要由承銷和交易服務活動組成。傳統合氣道部門包括合氣道實驗室，該實驗室管理傳統實體的投資控股。該公司由 Gilbert V. Levin 和 M. Karen Levin 於 1967 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd. is a holding company which provides payroll outsourcing services. It also offers employment, consultancy and market research services. The outsourcing services assist its end-users in calculating employees' salaries and the required employer's contributions to social security and housing provident funds as well as individual income tax and any other deductions. The employment services act as the employers of record to employ suitable candidates, who are sourced by their end-users. The consultancy and market research services provides consultation for local policy and delivery of country profile reports. The company was founded by Wai Hong Lao, Yiu Kong But, and Wai Cheung Yeung in April 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd.是一家提供薪資外包服務的控股公司。它還提供就業、諮詢和市場研究服務。外包服務協助最終用戶計算員工薪資、雇主所需繳納的社會安全和住房公積金以及個人所得稅和任何其他扣除項目。就業服務機構作為記錄雇主來僱用合適的候選人，這些候選人是由其最終用戶尋找的。諮詢和市場研究服務為當地政策提供諮詢並提供國家概況報告。該公司由Wai Hong Lao、Yiu Kong But和Wai Cheung Yeung於2013年4月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: DEFSEC Technologies, Inc. provides defense and security services. The firm's technology portfolio includes its proprietary MISST system, Micro Integrated Systems and Software Technology. The company was founded by Jeff Macleod on November 28, 2017, and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
