info.description: Boxlight Corp. is a technological company, which engages in development, sale, and servicing of interactive solutions for the global education market. It also designs, manufactures, and distributes interactive projectors, flat-panel displays, touch projectors, touch boards, and MimioTeach through the Boxlight Group and Genesis brands. The company was founded by Herbert Myers and Sloan Myers in 1985 and is headquartered in Duluth, GA.
info.description_zh: Boxlight Corp. 是一家科技公司，致力於為全球教育市場提供互動式解決方案的開發、銷售和服務。它還透過 Boxlight Group 和 Genesis 品牌設計、製造和分銷互動式投影機、平板顯示器、觸控投影機、觸控板和 MimioTeach。該公司由 Herbert Myers 和 Sloan Myers 於 1985 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州德盧斯。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long RGTI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Rigetti Computing, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long RGTI ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前達到 Rigetti Computer, Inc. 股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (“ETF”)，試圖透過使用衍生性商品，即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約，實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Freightos Ltd. engages in the operation of a booking and payment platform for international freight. It operates through the Platform and Solutions segments. The Platform segment provides digitalized price quoting, booking, and payments. The Solutions segment offers software tools and data to help industry participants automate their pricing, sales, and procurement processes. The company was founded by Zvi Schreiber in January 2012 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
info.description_zh: Freightos Ltd. 從事國際貨運訂艙和支付平台的營運。它透過平台和解決方案部門運作。平台部分提供數位化報價、預訂和付款。解決方案部門提供軟體工具和數據，幫助產業參與者自動化定價、銷售和採購流程。該公司由 Zvi Schreiber 於 2012 年 1 月創立，總部位於以色列耶路撒冷。

info.description: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of artificial intelligence solutions in neuroscience and immuno-oncology. It also focuses on utilizing technology and research to develop therapeutics solutions. The company was founded by Vimal D. Mehta on March 29, 2017 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事神經科學和免疫腫瘤學領域人工智慧解決方案的開發。它還專注於利用技術和研究來開發治療解決方案。該公司由 Vimal D. Mehta 於 2017 年 3 月 29 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: Polaryx Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the manufacturing of biotechnology products. Its pipeline of products includes PLX-100, PLX-200, and PLX-300. The company was founded by Hahn-Jun Lee on August 22, 2014 and is headquartered in Paramus, NJ.
info.description_zh: Polaryx Therapeutics, Inc. 從事生物技術產品的製造。其管道產品包括PLX-100、PLX-200和PLX-300。該公司由 Hahn-Jun Lee 於 2014 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於新澤西州帕拉默斯。

info.description: FreeCast, Inc. operates an online video streaming platform. Its cloud entertainment platform comprises the largest aggregated library of free and pay-per-view video-on-demand, streaming channels, live events, radio stations, music videos and online games. The company was founded by William A. Mobley, Jr. on June 21, 2011 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: FreeCast, Inc. 經營一個線上影片串流平台。其雲端娛樂平台包括最大的免費和按次付費視訊點播、串流頻道、現場活動、廣播電台、音樂視訊和線上遊戲的聚合庫。該公司由 William A. Mobley, Jr. 於 2011 年 6 月 21 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Moolec Science SA engages in the development and production of science-based food ingredients. Its products include pet food, animal feed, and dietary supplements. It operates through the following segments: Seed and Integrated Products, Crop Protection, Crop Nutrition, and Emerging Solutions. The company was founded by Gaston Paladini, Henk Hoogenkamp, and Martin Salinas in 2020 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Moolec Science SA 致力於科學食品配料的開發和生產。其產品包括寵物食品、動物飼料和膳食補充劑。該公司透過以下部門運作：種子和綜合產品、作物保護、作物營養和新興解決方案。該公司由 Gaston Paladini、Henk Hoogenkamp 和 Martin Salinas 於 2020 年創立，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: GRI Bio, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for inflammatory, fibrotic, and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on its lead program, GRI-0621, an inhibitor of type 1 invariant Natural Killer T (iNKT) cell activity and is being developed as a novel oral therapeutic for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded in May 2009 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: GRI Bio, Inc. 從事發炎、纖維化和自體免疫疾病療法的開發和商業化。該公司專注於其主導項目 GRI-0621，這是一種 1 型不變自然殺手 T (iNKT) 細胞活性抑制劑，正在開發為治療特發性肺纖維化的新型口服療法。該公司成立於 2009 年 5 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: OneMedNet Corp. designs and develops clinical imaging technology for the healthcare sector. It offers OneMedNet iRWD, a solution that securely de-identifies, searches, curates and shares medical images data with patients, care providers, and hospitals. The company was founded by Jeffrey N. Yu in 2009 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, MN.
info.description_zh: OneMedNet Corp. 為醫療保健產業設計和開發臨床影像技術。它提供 OneMedNet iRWD，這是一種安全地去識別、搜尋、管理和與患者、護理提供者和醫院共享醫學影像資料的解決方案。該公司由 Jeffrey N. Yu 於 2009 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊甸草原。

info.description: Mingteng International Corp., Inc. is a holding company, which engages in mold production, repair, and machining activities through its subsidiaries. It provides casting molds for turbocharger systems, braking systems, steering and differential system, and other automotive system parts. The company was founded by Ying Kai Xu on September 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
info.description_zh: 明騰國際股份有限公司是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事模俱生產、維修和機械加工活動。為渦輪增壓系統、煞車系統、轉向及差速系統等汽車系統零件提供鑄造模具。該公司由徐應凱於2021年9月20日創立，總部位於中國無錫。

info.description: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of information and communication technology services. Its solutions include ICT solution services, technical services, and project management services. The company was founded by Yat Lung Lee on May 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. 從事提供資訊和通訊技術服務。其解決方案包括ICT解決方案服務、技術服務和專案管理服務。該公司由李逸龍於2018年5月3日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Beyond Air, Inc. is a commercial stage medical device and biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of endogenous and exogenous nitric oxide (NO) to improve the lives of patients suffering from respiratory illnesses, neurological disorders, and solid tumors. It operates through the Beyond Air, Beyond Cancer segments, and NeuroNos. The company was founded on April 28, 2015 and is headquartered in Garden City, NY.
info.description_zh: Beyond Air, Inc.是一家商業階段的醫療器材和生物製藥公司，致力於開發內源性和外源性一氧化氮 (NO)，以改善患有呼吸系統疾病、神經系統疾病和實體瘤的患者的生活。它透過 Beyond Air、Beyond Cancer 和 NeuroNos 部門運作。該公司成立於2015年4月28日，總部位於紐約州花園城。

info.description: Masonglory Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of wet trades and other related ancillary works. It offers plastering on floors, ceilings and walls, tile laying on internal and external walls and floors, brick laying, floor screeding, and marble works. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Masonglory Ltd.是一家投資控股公司，從事提供濕貨貿易及其他相關配套工程業務。它提供地板、天花板和牆壁的抹灰、內外牆和地板的瓷磚鋪設、磚砌、地板找平和大理石工程。公司成立於2018年，總部位於香港。

info.description: FGI Industries Ltd. engages in the supply of kitchen and bath products. Its products fall under the following categories: Sanitaryware, Bath Furniture, Shower Systems and Other. The Sanitaryware category offers bath products such as toilets, sinks, pedestals and toilet seats. The Bath Furniture category deals with wood and wood-substitute furniture for bathrooms, including vanities, mirrors, laundry and medicine cabinets, and other storage systems. The Shower Systems category includes a range of shower-related products such as shower walls, shower doors and shower basins. The Other category includes shower door and shower systems products, custom kitchen cabinetry, and other accessory items. The company was founded on May 26, 2021 and is headquartered in East Hanover, NJ.
info.description_zh: FGI Industries Ltd. 從事廚房和浴室產品的供應。其產品分為以下類別：衛浴設備、浴室家具、淋浴系統及其他。衛浴產品類別提供馬桶、水槽、底座和馬桶座圈。浴室家具類別涉及浴室的木質和木質替代家具，包括梳妝台、鏡子、洗衣櫃和藥櫃以及其他儲存系統。淋浴系統類別包括一系列與淋浴相關的產品，例如淋浴牆、淋浴門和淋浴盆。其他類別包括淋浴門和淋浴系統產品、客製化廚房櫥櫃和其他配件。該公司成立於2021年5月26日，總部位於新澤西州東漢諾威。

info.description: Liminatus Pharma, Inc. is a pre-clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel, immune-modulating cancer therapies. The company was founded on November 1, 2020 and is headquartered in Cerritos, CA.
info.description_zh: Liminatus Pharma, Inc.是一家臨床前階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發新型免疫調節癌症療法。該公司成立於2020年11月1日，總部位於加州塞里托斯。

info.description: My Size, Inc. engages in the development of measurement technologies. It provides solutions for e-commerce, apparel, shipping and parcel delivery, and do-it-yourself industry applications. It offers measurement apps including MySizeID, BoxSize, and SizeUP. It operates through the Fashion and Equipment E-commerce Platform, and SaaS Solutions segments. The Fashion and Equipment E-commerce Platform segment represents Orgad's activity that was acquired by the company, mainly operates on Amazon. The SaaS Solutions segment relates to innovative artificial intelligence driven measurement solutions. The company was founded by Ronen Luzon on September 20, 1999 and is headquartered in Airport City, Israel.
info.description_zh: My Size, Inc. 從事測量技術的開發。它為電子商務、服裝、運輸和包裹遞送以及DIY行業應用提供解決方案。它提供的測量應用程式包括 MySizeID、BoxSize 和 SizeUP。它透過時尚和裝備電子商務平台和 SaaS 解決方案部門運作。時尚和裝備電子商務平台部門代表了 Orgad 的業務，已被該公司收購，主要在亞馬遜上營運。 SaaS 解決方案部門涉及創新的人工智慧驅動的測量解決方案。該公司由Ronen Luzon於1999年9月20日創立，總部位於以色列機場城。

info.description: INVO Fertility, Inc. operates as a revenue-generating fertility business. It also focuses on the development of class clinical-stage assets in oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded on January 5, 2007 and is headquartered in Sarasota, FL.
info.description_zh: INVO Fertility, Inc. 是一家創收生育業務。它也專注於腫瘤學和自體免疫疾病類臨床階段資產的開發。該公司成立於2007年1月5日，總部位於佛羅裡達州薩拉索塔。

info.description: Katapult Holdings, Inc. is an e-commerce focused financial technology company. The firm is engaged in the provision of e-commerce point-of-sale lease-purchase options for nonprime U.S. consumers. It offers its customers a lease purchase transaction processing system with no long-term obligation and options for ownership. The company was founded in August 2019 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Katapult Holdings, Inc. 是一家專注於電子商務的金融科技公司。該公司致力於為美國非優質消費者提供電子商務銷售點租賃購買選擇。它為客戶提供租賃購買交易處理系統，沒有長期義務和所有權選擇。該公司成立於 2019 年 8 月，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: NexGel, Inc. engages in the manufacture of aqueous polymer hydrogels used for wound care, medical diagnostics, transdermal drug delivery, and cosmetics. It operates through the NexGel and CGN segments. The NexGel segment consists of the manufacturing of ultra-gentle, high-water-content hydrogel products for healthcare and consumer applications, which is based in Langhorne, Pennsylvania. The CGN segment consists of the CGN JV used for the company's converting and packaging business, which is based in Granbury, Texas. The company was founded on January 13, 2009, and is headquartered in Langhorne, PA.
info.description_zh: NexGel, Inc. 從事水性聚合物水凝膠的製造，用於傷口護理、醫療診斷、經皮給藥和化妝品。它透過 NexGel 和 CGN 部門運作。 NexGel 部門包括製造用於醫療保健和消費者應用的超溫和、高含水量水凝膠產品，總部位於賓州蘭霍恩。 CGN 部門由用於公司加工和包裝業務的 CGN 合資企業組成，該合資企業位於德克薩斯州格蘭伯里。該公司成立於2009年1月13日，總部位於賓州蘭霍恩。

info.description: Super League Enterprise, Inc. creates innovative and immersive entertainment experiences, platform and audience monetization and dynamic content feeding channels across the world's top gaming platforms. Fueled by an insatiable desire to stay on the forefront of this ever-evolving meta landscape, Super League pioneer's proprietary digital solutions provide unparalleled access to the global gaming audience. It also creates vibrant in-game communities through the development of innovative experiences and custom content, delivering powerful opportunities for brands and advertisers to achieve impactful insights, and marketing outcomes with audiences of all ages. The company was founded by John C. Miller, David Steigelfest, and Brett Morris on October 1, 2014 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: Super League Enterprise, Inc. 在全球頂級遊戲平台上創造創新和沈浸式娛樂體驗、平台和受眾貨幣化以及動態內容供給管道。在不斷發展的元景觀中保持領先地位的永不滿足的願望的推動下，超級聯賽先鋒的專有數位解決方案為全球遊戲觀眾提供了無與倫比的訪問機會。它還透過開發創新體驗和客製化內容來創建充滿活力的遊戲內社區，為品牌和廣告商提供強大的機會，以獲得有影響力的見解，並為所有年齡段的受眾帶來行銷成果。該公司由 John C. Miller、David Steigelfest 和 Brett Morris 於 2014 年 10 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: Upland Software, Inc. engages in providing cloud-based software applications. Its products include AccuRoute, Adestra, Altify, BA Insight, Cimpl, ComSci, Eclipse PPM, FileBound, InGenius, Intelligent Capture, InterFAX, Kapost, Localytics, Mobile Commons, Objectif Lune, Panviva, PostUp, PowerStreering, PSA, Qvidian, Rant and Rave, RightAnswers, RO Innovation, Second Street, Ultriva, and Waterfall. The company was founded by John T. McDonald in July 2010 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Upland Software, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體應用程式。其產品包括 AccuRoute、Adestra、Altify、BA Insight、Cimpl、ComSci、Eclipse PPM、FileBound、InGenius、Intelligent Capture、InterFAX、Kapost、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp、PowerStreering、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp. Waterfall。該公司由 John T. McDonald 於 2010 年 7 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Streamex Corp. operates as a Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization. It engages in the provision of blockchain technology to tokenize physical commodities such as gold and create related financial products. The company was founded by Kenneth L. Londoner, Karl Henry McPhie, and Morgan Lekstrom on February 24, 2009 and is headquartered in Winter Park, FL.
info.description_zh: Streamex Corp. 作為現實世界資產 (RWA) 代幣化運作。它致力於提供區塊鏈技術來對黃金等實體商品進行代幣化並創建相關的金融產品。該公司由 Kenneth L. Londoner、Karl Henry McPhie 和 Morgan Lekstrom 於 2009 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州溫特帕克。

info.description: OSR Health, Inc. operates as a global healthcare company. The firm engages in developing oral immunotherapies for cancer treatment, design-augmented biologics for age-related and other degenerative diseases, and neurovascular intervention of medical devices and systems distribution in Korea. Its products are offered through its subsidiaries. The company was founded on February 25, 2020 and is headquartered in Bellevue, WA.
info.description_zh: OSR Health, Inc. 是一家全球醫療保健公司。該公司致力於開發用於癌症治療的口服免疫療法、用於年齡相關疾病和其他退化性疾病的設計增強生物製劑，以及醫療設備和系統分銷的神經血管幹預。其產品透過其子公司提供。該公司成立於2020年2月25日，總部位於華盛頓州貝爾維尤。

info.description: Synergy CHC Corp. engages in the marketing and distribution of branded health and wellness products. The company was founded on December 29, 2010 and is headquartered in Westbrook, ME.
info.description_zh: Synergy CHC Corp. 從事品牌健康和保健產品的營銷和分銷。該公司成立於2010年12月29日，總部位於緬因州威斯布魯克。

info.description: Gaxos.ai, Inc. is a technology-based company, which engages in the developing applications aimed at redefining the way they utilize artificial intelligence to optimize the user experience. The company was founded by Vadim Mats on October 27, 2021 and is headquartered in Roseland, NJ.
info.description_zh: Gaxos.ai, Inc. 是一家技術型公司，致力於開發應用程序，旨在重新定義利用人工智慧來優化用戶體驗的方式。該公司由 Vadim Mats 於 2021 年 10 月 27 日創立，總部位於新澤西州羅斯蘭。

info.description: E-Home Household Service Holdings Ltd. engages in the operation of household services. It operates through the following segments: Installation and Maintenance Services, Housekeeping Services, Senior Care Services, and Educational Consulting Services. The company was founded by Wen Shan Xie in 2014 and is headquartered in Fuzhou City, China.
info.description_zh: 易家家居服務控股有限公司從事家居服務經營。它透過以下部門運作：安裝和維護服務、家事服務、高級護理服務和教育諮詢服務。該公司由謝文山於2014年創立，總部位於中國福州市。

info.description: Xos, Inc. is a provider of energy storage and fleet electrification solutions. It develops battery-electric commercial vehicles and mobile power systems designed for rapid deployment charging and lower total cost of ownership compared to internal combustion engine vehicles. The company was founded by Dakota Semler and Giordano Sordoni on July 29, 2020 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Xos, Inc. 是一家能源儲存和車隊電氣化解決方案提供商。該公司開發電池電動商用車和行動電源系統，旨在實現快速部署充電並比內燃機車降低總擁有成本。該公司由 Dakota Semler 和 Giordano Sordoni 於 2020 年 7 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: TruGolf Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of indoor golf solutions. It offers video games, hardware solutions, and an e-sports platform. Its offerings include E6 CONNECT, an e-sports platform that connects golfers around the world. The company was founded by Christopher Jones in 1983 and is headquartered in Centerville, UT.
info.description_zh: TruGolf Holdings, Inc. 從事提供室內高爾夫解決方案。它提供視頻遊戲、硬體解決方案和電子競技平台。其產品包括 E6 CONNECT，這是一個連接世界各地高爾夫球手的電競平台。該公司由 Christopher Jones 於 1983 年創立，總部位於猶他州森特維爾。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long NBIS Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the ADR of Nebius Group NV (Nasdaq: NBIS). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the Underlying Stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing the Underlying Stock. The fund will aim to primarily obtain its notional exposure against the Underlying Stock through swap agreements.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x 多頭 NBIS 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Nebius Group NV（納斯達克股票代碼：NBIS）ADR 每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過基礎股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買基礎股票來複製基礎股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金的目標主要是透過掉期協議獲得其標的股票的名義曝險。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NBIS Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADSs of NBIS. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the underlying security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NBIS, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NBIS 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NBIS ADS 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的標的證券和金融工具，這些證券和金融工具結合起來提供 NBIS 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Capstone Holding Corp. is a growing platform of building products companies, focused on serving residential and commercial construction markets across the United States. Its current portfolio includes Instone, a national wholesale distributor of thin veneer stone and related masonry products. With over 30 years of operating history, Instone has established itself as the largest player in its category, offering a comprehensive range of manufactured and natural stone solutions. The company was founded on July 30, 1987 and is headquartered in Alsip, IL.
info.description_zh: Capstone Holding Corp. 是一家不斷發展的建築產品公司平台，專注於為美國各地的住宅和商業建築市場提供服務。其目前的產品組合包括 Instone，一家薄飾面石材及相關磚石產品的全國批發經銷商。 Instone 擁有 30 多年的經營歷史，已成為該類別中最大的參與者，提供全面的人造石和天然石材解決方案。該公司成立於 1987 年 7 月 30 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州阿爾西普。

info.description: Prairie Operating Co. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which focuses on the acquisition and development of crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs. It focuses on unconventional oil and natural gas reservoirs located in Colorado focused on the Niobrara and Codell formations. The company was founded by Gary C. Hanna and Edward Kovalik on May 2, 2001 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Prairie Operating Co. 是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，專注於原油、天然氣和液化天然氣的收購和開發。它重點關注位於科羅拉多州的非常規石油和天然氣儲層，重點關注 Niobrara 和 Codell 地層。該公司由 Gary C. Hanna 和 Edward Kovalik 於 2001 年 5 月 2 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Healthcare Triangle, Inc. operates as a healthcare information technology company, which engages in advancing various solutions for the cloud services, data science, and professional and managed services sectors for the healthcare and life sciences industry. It operates through the following segments: Software Services, Managed Services and Support, and Platform Services. The Software Services segment focuses on the sale of software services that are generated from providing strategic advisory, implementation, and development services. The Managed Services and Support segment includes post implementation support and cloud hosting. The Platform services segment offers solutions under CloudEz, DataEz, and Readabl.AI. The company was founded by Suresh Venkatachari and Keith T. Ryan on October 29, 2019 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: Healthcare Triangle, Inc. 是一家醫療保健資訊技術公司，致力於為醫療保健和生命科學行業的雲端服務、資料科學以及專業和託管服務領域開發各種解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：軟體服務、託管服務和支援以及平台服務。軟體服務部門專注於銷售透過提供策略諮詢、實施和開發服務而產生的軟體服務。託管服務和支援部分包括實施後支援和雲端託管。平台服務部門提供 CloudEz、DataEz 和 Readabl.AI 下的解決方案。該公司由 Suresh Venkatachari 和 Keith T. Ryan 於 2019 年 10 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: Beta Bionics, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical device company. It engages in the design, development, and commercialization of solutions for insulin-requiring people with diabetes. The company was founded by Edward R. Damiano on October 21, 2015 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Beta Bionics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的醫療器材公司。它致力於為需要胰島素的糖尿病患者設計、開發和商業化解決方案。該公司由 Edward R. Damiano 於 2015 年 10 月 21 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Modular Medical, Inc. is a development stage company, which engages in the provision of insulin pump technology. It focuses on the design, development, and commercialization of insulin pumps to serve the diabetes market. The company was founded by Paul M. DiPerna on October 22, 1998 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Modular Medical, Inc. 是一家處於開發階段的公司，致力於提供胰島素幫浦技術。它專注於胰島素幫浦的設計、開發和商業化，以服務糖尿病市場。該公司由 Paul M. DiPerna 於 1998 年 10 月 22 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Marathon Petroleum Corp. engages in the refining, marketing, and transportation of petroleum products. It operates through the Refining and Marketing, and Midstream segments. The Refining and Marketing segment includes refining crude oil and other feedstocks, purchasing ethanol, and refined products for resale and distribution of refined products. The Midstream segment refers to transportation, storing, distribution, and marketing of crude oil and refined products. The company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Findlay, OH.
info.industry_zh: 石油與天然氣精煉與行銷
info.description_zh: 馬拉松石油公司從事石油產品的精煉、行銷和運輸。它透過煉油和行銷以及中游部門運作。煉油和行銷部門包括煉油原油和其他原料、採購乙醇以及用於轉售和分銷煉油產品的煉油產品。中游部門是指原油和成品油的運輸、儲存、分銷和行銷。該公司成立於 1887 年，總部位於俄亥俄州芬德利。

info.description: Recon Technology Ltd. engages in providing oilfield services. It operates through the following segments: Automation Product and Software, Equipment and Accessories, Oilfield Environmental Protection, and Platform Outsourcing Services. The Automation Product and Software segment is involved in the sale of automation products specialized equipment when combined with services represent a single performance obligation for the development and construction of a single asset. The Equipment and Accessories segment includes the delivery of standard or customized products and equipment, including automation products, furnaces, and related accessories. The Oilfield Environmental Protection segment focuses on the wastewater treatment products and related service to oilfield and chemical industry companies. The Platform Outsourcing Services segment refers to online platform development, maintenance, and operation services to gas stations around different provinces in China. The company was founded by Guang Qiang Chen, Hong Qi Li, and Shen Ping Yin on August 21, 2007 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Recon Technology Ltd. 從事提供油田服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：自動化產品及軟體、設備及配件、油田環保、平台外包服務。自動化產品和軟體部門從事自動化產品專用設備的銷售，與服務結合構成單一資產開發和建造的單一履約義務。設備和配件部門包括標準或客製化產品和設備的交付，包括自動化產品、熔爐和相關配件。油田環保板塊專注於為油田、化學企業提供廢水處理產品及相關服務。平台外包服務業務是指為中國各省加油站提供線上平台開發、維護及營運服務。該公司由陳光強、李紅旗、沈平尹於2007年8月21日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: argenx SE is a global immunology company, which engages in improving the lives of people suffering from severe autoimmune diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Japan, EMEA, and China. The company was founded by Hans J. W. de Haard, Torsten Dreier, and Tim van Hauwermeiren in 2008 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: argenx SE 是一家全球免疫學公司，致力於改善患有嚴重自體免疫疾病的人們的生活。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、日本、歐洲、中東和非洲地區和中國。該公司由 Hans J. W. de Haard、Torsten Dreier 和 Tim van Hauwermeiren 於 2008 年創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Kamada Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on specialty plasma-derived therapeutic. It operates through the Proprietary Products and Distribution segments. The Proprietary Products segment refers to specialty plasma therapies and normal source plasma (NSP). The Distribution segment focuses on the commercialization of in-licensed third-party biopharmaceutical products. The company was founded by David Tsur and Ralf Hahn on December 13, 1990 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Kamada Ltd. 是一家生物製藥公司，專注於特殊血漿衍生療法。它透過專有產品和分銷部門運作。專有產品部分涉及特種血漿療法和普通源血漿（NSP）。分銷部門專注於許可的第三方生物製藥產品的商業化。該公司由 David Tsur 和 Ralf Hahn 於 1990 年 12 月 13 日創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: iShares MSCI Turkey ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Turkey IMI 25/50 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of equity market in Turkey. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 土耳其 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 土耳其 IMI 25/50 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量土耳其股票市場大、中、小型股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Medical ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in common stocks, convertible securities, warrants and other equity securities having the characteristics of common stocks of U.S. and foreign companies engaged in medical research, pharmaceutical and medical technology industries and related technology industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Medical ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，透過將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於從事醫學研究、製藥和醫療技術行業及相關技術行業的美國和外國公司的普通股、可轉換證券、認股權證和其他具有普通股特徵的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Devon Energy Corp. engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas properties. It develops and operates Delaware Basin, Eagle Ford, Heavy Oil, Barnett Shale, STACK, and Rockies Oil. The company was founded by J. Larry Nichols and John W. Nichols in 1971 and is headquartered in Oklahoma City, OK.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Devon Energy Corp. 從事石油和天然氣資產的勘探、開發和生產。它開發和經營特拉華盆地、伊格爾福特、重油、巴尼特頁岩、STACK 和落基山脈石油。該公司由 J. Larry Nichols 和 John W. Nichols 於 1971 年創立，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州俄克拉荷馬市。

info.description: Direxion Daily CSCO Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of CSCO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to CSCO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily CSCO Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 CSCO 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來為 CSCO 提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Beyond Meat, Inc. engages in the provision of plant-based meats. Its products include ready-to-cook meat under The Beyond Burger and Beyond Sausage brands, and frozen meat, namely, Beyond Chicken Strips and Beyond Beef Crumbles. The company was founded by Ethan Walden Brown and Brent Taylor in 2009 and is headquartered in El Segundo, CA.
info.description_zh: Beyond Meat, Inc. 從事植物性肉類的供應。其產品包括Beyond Burger和Beyond Sausage品牌的即食肉，以及Beyond Chicken Strips和Beyond Beef Crumbles等冷凍肉。該公司由 Ethan Walden Brown 和 Brent Taylor 於 2009 年創立，總部位於加州埃爾塞貢多。

info.description: Johnson & Johnson is a holding company, which engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of products in the healthcare field. It operates through the Innovative Medicine and MedTech segments. The Innovative Medicine segment focuses on immunology, infectious diseases, neuroscience, oncology, cardiovascular and metabolism, and pulmonary hypertension. The MedTech segment includes a portfolio of products used in interventional solutions, orthopaedics, surgery, and vision categories. The company was founded by Robert Wood Johnson I, James Wood Johnson, and Edward Mead Johnson Sr. in 1887 and is headquartered in New Brunswick, NJ.
info.description_zh: 強生公司是一家控股公司，從事醫療保健領域產品的研究、開發、製造和銷售。它透過創新醫學和醫療技術部門運作。創新醫學部門專注於免疫學、傳染病、神經科學、腫瘤學、心血管和代謝以及肺動脈高壓。醫療技術部門包括用於介入解決方案、骨科、手術和視覺類別的產品組合。該公司由 Robert Wood Johnson I、James Wood Johnson 和 Edward Mead Johnson Sr. 於 1887 年創立，總部位於新澤西州新不倫瑞克省。

info.description: 1RT Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company that was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more business. The company was founded on December 13, 2024 and is headquartered in New York. NY.
info.description_zh: 1RT Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年12月13日，總部位於紐約。紐約。

info.description: EOG Resources, Inc. engages in the exploration, development, production and marketing of crude oil and natural gas. It operates through the United States, Trinidad, and Other International geographical segments. The Other International segment includes China and Canada operations. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: EOG Resources, Inc.從事原油和天然氣的勘探、開發、生產和行銷。它透過美國、特立尼達和其他國際地理部門開展業務。其他國際部門包括中國和加拿大業務。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Republic Services, Inc. engages in the provision of environmental services. It provides collection, transfer, recycling, and disposal services for non-hazardous solid waste, as well as environmental solutions services. It operates through the following segments: Group 1, Group 2, and Group 3. The Group 1 segment focuses on the business of recycling and solid waste in geographic areas located in western United States. The Group 2 segment includes the recycling and solid waste business in geographic areas located in the southeastern and mid-western and the eastern seaboard of the United States and Canada. The Group 3 segment includes environmental solutions business in geographic areas located across the United States and Canada. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Republic Services, Inc. 從事提供環境服務。提供無害固體廢棄物的收集、轉運、回收、處置服務以及環境解決方案服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：第 1 組、第 2 組和第 3 組。第 1 組部門專注於美國西部地理區域的回收和固體廢棄物業務。第二組部門包括位於美國和加拿大東南部、中西部和東海岸地理區域的回收和固體廢物業務。第三組部門包括位於美國和加拿大地理區域的環境解決方案業務。該公司成立於 1996 年，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: Able View Global, Inc. is a brand management company, which engages in marketing strategy, branding, digital and social marketing, omni-channel sales, customer service, and overseas logistics. The company was founded in 2022 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Able View Global, Inc.是一家品牌管理公司，從事行銷策略、品牌推廣、數位和社交行銷、全通路銷售、客戶服務和海外物流。該公司成立於2022年，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: American Bitcoin Corp. engages in the management of a bitcoin accumulation platform. It offers exposure to bitcoin through an industry-first business model that integrates scaled self-mining operations with disciplined accumulation strategies. The company was founded by Eric Trump and Donald John Trump Jr. on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: 美國比特幣公司從事比特幣累積平台的管理。它透過行業首創的商業模式提供比特幣投資，該商業模式將規模化的自挖礦業務與嚴格的積累策略相結合。該公司由埃里克·川普和小唐納德·約翰·川普於2018年10月3日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It focuses on identifying and merging with technology companies, particularly in blockchain-enabled AI, digital trade identity, and robotics. The company was founded on November 3, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它專注於識別和合併科技公司，特別是在區塊鏈支援的人工智慧、數位貿易身分和機器人技術領域。該公司成立於2025年11月3日，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: Harvard Ave Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: 哈佛大道收購公司是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、資本股票交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年8月15日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: Maravai Lifesciences Holdings, Inc. engages in providing products to enable the development of drug therapies, diagnostics, and novel vaccines and to support research on human diseases. The firm's brands include TriLink BioTechnologies, Cygnus, Glen Research, and Alphazyme. It operates through the TriLink and Cygnus segments. The TriLink segment manufactures and sells products used in the fields of gene therapy, vaccines, nucleoside chemistry, oligonucleotide therapy and molecular diagnostics, including reagents used in the chemical synthesis, modification, labelling, and purification of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) and ribonucleic acid (RNA). The Cygnus segment sells biologic safety testing products and highly specialized analytical products for use in biologic manufacturing process development, including custom product-specific antibody and assay development services. It also operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Latin and Central America. The company was founded by Eric Tardif and Carl W. Hull in March 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Maravai Lifesciences Holdings, Inc. 致力於提供產品，以促進藥物治療、診斷和新型疫苗的開發，並支持人類疾病的研究。該公司的品牌包括 TriLink BioTechnologies、Cygnus、Glen Research 和 Alphazyme。它透過 TriLink 和 Cygnus 部門運作。 TriLink部門生產和銷售用於基因治療、疫苗、核苷化學、寡核苷酸治療和分子診斷領域的產品，包括用於脫氧核糖核酸（DNA）和核糖核酸（RNA）的化學合成、修飾、標記和純化的試劑。 Cygnus 部門銷售生物安全測試產品和高度專業化的分析產品，用於生物製造製程開發，包括客製化產品特定抗體和檢測開發服務。它也透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、亞太地區、歐洲、中東、非洲以及拉丁美洲和中美洲。該公司由 Eric Tardif 和 Carl W. Hull 於 2014 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2030 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nyxoah SA is a medical technology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of solutions to treat Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA). Its solution platform is based on the Genio system, a CE-Mark validated, user-centered, bilateral neurostimulation therapy to treat moderate to severe OSA. The company was founded by Robert Taub and Adi Mashiach on July 15, 2009, and is headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Nyxoah SA 是一家醫療技術公司，致力於治療阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症 (OSA) 解決方案的開發和商業化。其解決方案平台基於 Genio 系統，這是一種經過 CE 標誌驗證、以用戶為中心的雙側神經刺激療法，用於治療中度至重度 OSA。該公司由 Robert Taub 和 Adi Mashiach 於 2009 年 7 月 15 日創立，總部位於比利時 Mont-Saint-Guibert。

info.description: Invesco DWA Healthcare Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Healthcare Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the healthcare sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Healthcare Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Healthcare Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數由至少 30 家醫療保健行業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Stellar V Capital Corp. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on July 12, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Stellar V Capital Corp.是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年7月12日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Vertex, Inc. engages in the provision of tax compliance software solutions. The firm offers comprehensive solutions that automate end-to-end indirect tax processes for enterprises and mid-market companies with complex tax transactions. Its software enables tax determination, data management, compliance and reporting, and document management. The company was founded by Ray Westphal and Antoinette Westphal in 1978 and is headquartered in King of Prussia, PA.
info.description_zh: Vertex, Inc. 從事提供稅務合規軟體解決方案。該公司提供全面的解決方案，為具有複雜稅務交易的企業和中型市場公司實現端到端間接稅務流程的自動化。其軟體支援稅務確定、資料管理、合規性和報告以及文件管理。該公司由 Ray Westphal 和 Antoinette Westphal 於 1978 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州普魯士國王。

info.description: Astoria Dynamic Core US Fixed Income ETF seeks current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in other U.S. fixed income ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowing for investment purposes) directly or indirectly in U.S. fixed income securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Astoria Dynamic Core 美國固定收益 ETF 尋求當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於其他美國固定收益 ETF 來實現其投資目標。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上投資目的借款金額）直接或間接投資於美國固定收益證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IB Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 7, 2020 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: IB Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2020年7月7日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 18, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年1月18日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on December 9, 2024 and is headquartered in Princeton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. 以一家空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年12月9日，總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF seeks to provide capital growth over the medium to long term. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity and equity-related securities of emerging market issuers. Equity and equity-related securities include exchange-traded and over-the-counter common and preferred stocks, warrants, options, rights, convertible securities, sponsored and unsponsored depositary receipts, trust certificates, partnership interests and shares of other investment companies (including other exchange-traded funds ("ETFs")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF 尋求在中長期內提供資本增長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於新興市場發行人的股票和股票相關證券。股票和股票相關證券包括交易所交易和場外交易的普通股和優先股、認股權證、選擇權、權利、可轉換證券、保薦和非保薦存託憑證、信託證書、合夥權益以及其他投資公司的股份（包括其他交易所交易基金（「ETF」））。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SUMA Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Naseem Saloojee and David King on November 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: SUMA Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Naseem Saloojee 和 David King 於 2025 年 11 月 21 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Indigo Acquisition Corp. is blank check company for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase and reorganization. Its objective is to identify and acquire an established, profitable company with strong fundamentals and significant upside potential. The company was founded on June 07, 2024 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Indigo Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，旨在進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。其目標是識別並收購一家基礎雄厚且具有巨大上升潛力的成熟、盈利的公司。該公司成立於 2024 年 6 月 7 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Cellectis SA operates as a clinical stage biotechnological company, which engages in gene-editing platform to develop cell and gene therapies. The company was founded by David J. Sourdive and Andre Choulika on February 20, 1999 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Cellectis SA 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發細胞和基因療法的基因編輯平台。該公司由David J. Sourdive和Andre Choulika於1999年2月20日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Wisdomtree Core Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Core Laddered 市政基金尋求產生免徵聯邦所得稅的當前收入。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Wisdomtree High Income Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate a high level of current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in high income municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 高收入階梯市政基金旨在產生高水準的當前收入，且免徵聯邦所得稅。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於高收入市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets Asia ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Asia Custom Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure equity market performance in the emerging market countries of Asia. The underlying index includes large- and mid-capitalization companies and may change over time.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場亞洲 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場亞洲客製化上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。相關指數旨在衡量亞洲新興市場國家的股票市場表現。基礎指數包括大中型公司，並可能隨著時間的推移而變化。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场扩展 ESG 焦点指数的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: Franklin Wireless Corp. engages in the provision of wireless solutions including 5G (fifth generation) and 4G LTE (fourth generation long-term evolution). It offers mobile hotspots, routers, fixed wireless routers, various trackers, and software subscription services. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, and Asia. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Franklin Wireless Corp.提供無線解決方案，包括5G（第五代）和4G LTE（第四代長期演進）。它提供行動熱點、路由器、固定無線路由器、各種追蹤器和軟體訂閱服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：北美和亞洲。該公司成立於 1981 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: Community Bancorp operates as a bank holding company, which engages in a full line of personal and business financial services. The firm provides retail banking services to the residents, businesses, and municipalities in northeastern and central Vermont. It operates through the following segments: Commercial and Industrial, Purchased, Commercial Real Estate, Municipal, Residential Real Estate-1st Lien, Residential Real Estate -Jr Lien, and Consumer. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes commercial and industrial loans and to a lesser extent loans to finance agricultural production. The Purchased segment offers commercial loans to medical professionals nationwide and sells them individually to a secondary market, primarily banks, through a bid process. The Commercial Real Estate segment is involved in farm loans secured by farmland and buildings. The Municipal segment offers municipal financing transactions and backed by the full faith and credit of town governments or dedicated governmental revenue sources, with no historical losses recognized by the company. The Residential Real Estate-1st Lien segment deals with the family owner-occupied residential real estate mortgage services. The Residential Real Estate -Jr Lien segment offers family residential real estate mortgage services. The Consumer segment is made for individuals for consumer and household purposes. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Derby, VT.
info.description_zh: Community Bancorp 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，提供全方位的個人和企業金融服務。該公司為佛蒙特州東北部和中部的居民、企業和市政當局提供零售銀行服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：商業和工業部門、購買部門、商業房地產部門、市政部門、住宅房地產-第一留置權部門、住宅房地產-小型留置權部門和消費者部門。商業和工業部門包括商業和工業貸款以及較小程度的農業生產融資貸款。購買部門向全國醫療專業人員提供商業貸款，並透過投標流程將其單獨出售給二級市場（主要是銀行）。商業房地產部門涉及以農田和建築物擔保的農業貸款。市政部門提供市政融資交易，並得到城鎮政府或專門政府收入來源的充分信任和信用支持，公司不承認歷史損失。住宅房地產-第一留置權部門從事家庭自用住宅房地產抵押貸款服務。住宅房地產 -Jr Lien 部門提供家庭住宅房地產抵押貸款服務。消費者細分市場是為個人消費和家庭目的而設計的。該公司成立於 1982 年，總部位於佛蒙特州德比。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLU ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLU Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the utilities sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLU ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLU 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場公用事業板塊公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The RMR Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of management services to manage equity real estate investment trusts and operators. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: RMR Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供管理股權房地產投資信託和營運商的管理服務。該公司成立於 1986 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: Gladstone Commercial Corp. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the acquisition, managing and ownership of office and industrial properties. The company was founded by David John Gladstone on February 14, 2003 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: Gladstone Commercial Corp. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事辦公大樓和工業地產的收購、管理和所有權。該公司由 David John Gladstone 於 2003 年 2 月 14 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the real estate sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場房地產行業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The initial Index universe is typically derived from the component companies of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The initial universe of companies is typically screened based on their average projected free cash flows and earnings (if available) over each of the next two fiscal years. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of the fund's total assets in growth securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。最初的指數範圍通常源自於納斯達克 100 指數的成分公司。公司的初始範圍通常是根據未來兩個財政年度的平均預期自由現金流和收益（如果有）進行篩選的。一般情況下，基金會尋求將基金總資產的至少80%投資於成長型證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stock of "hypergrowth companies.
info.description_zh: 金鷹動態超增長ETF尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於「高速成長公司」的普通股來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. The firm offers checking accounts, business savings accounts, online and mobile banking, insurance, and investment advisory services, borrowing, and treasury management. Its customers include sole proprietors, small and medium-sized businesses, partnerships, corporations, non-profit organizations and associations, and investors living and working in and near the bank's primary service area. The company was founded on October 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。該公司提供支票帳戶、企業儲蓄帳戶、線上和行動銀行、保險、投資諮詢服務、借款和資金管理。其客戶包括獨資經營者、中小型企業、合夥企業、公司、非營利組織和協會，以及在銀行主要服務區域內和附近生活和工作的投資者。該公司成立於1997年10月28日，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF seeks to track the performance of a rules-based index designed to provide targeted, passive exposure to global public companies representing the full upstream and downstream value chain enabling Nvidia Corporation to manufacture, assemble, deploy, and operate high-performance computer systems. The fund employs a thematic supply-chain selection methodology using FactSet relationship data and a 50% revenue contribution threshold across six designated functional pillars to capture the physical infrastructure behind artificial intelligence deployment, while explicitly avoiding direct equity investments in shares of Nvidia Corporation.
info.description_zh: PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF 旨在追蹤基於規則的指數的表現，該指數旨在為代表整個上游和下游價值鏈的全球上市公司提供有針對性的被動投資，使 Nvidia Corporation 能夠製造、組裝、部署和運營高性能電腦系統。該基金採用主題供應鏈選擇方法，利用 FactSet 關係數據和跨六個指定功能支柱的 50% 收入貢獻門檻來捕獲人工智慧部署背後的實體基礎設施，同時明確避免對 Nvidia 公司股票的直接股權投資。

info.description: WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is a dividend weighted index designed to provide exposure to Japanese equity markets while at the same time neutralizing exposure to fluctuations of the value of the Japanese yen relative to the U.S. dollar. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與此類組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是股息加權指數，旨在提供日本股市的曝險，同時抵消日圓相對美元價值波動的曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Hydrogen ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Global Hydrogen Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes (if any), in the securities of the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of hydrogen technology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Hydrogen ETF 力求提供與 Solactive Global Hydrogen Index 的價格和收益表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於指數證券以及基於指數證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該指數旨在為那些能夠從氫技術領域的進一步進步中受益的公司提供投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ASML Holding NV engages in the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. It includes lithography, metrology and inspection systems. The company was founded on April 1, 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ASML Holding NV 從事先進半導體設備系統的開發、生產、行銷、銷售、升級和服務。它包括光刻、計量和檢測系統。該公司成立於1984年4月1日，總部位於荷蘭費爾德霍芬。

info.description: Equinix, Inc. is a digital infrastructure company, which engages in the provision of a platform that interconnects the foundational infrastructure. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. It offers digital services, data center services, interconnection services, and support services. The company was founded by Jay Steven Adelson and Albert M. Avery, IV on June 22, 1998 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Equinix, Inc. 是一家數位基礎設施公司，致力於提供互連基礎設施的平台。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲和亞太地區。它提供數位服務、資料中心服務、互連服務和支援服務。該公司由 Jay Steven Adelson 和 Albert M. Avery, IV 於 1998 年 6 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities of the underlying index), which may include common stocks, ADRs and GDRs. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of companies that are involved in the artificial intelligence ("AI") semiconductor and quantum computing ecosystems. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X AI 半導體和量子 ETF 力求提供與 Global X AI 半導體和量子指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於相關指數的證券，其中可能包括普通股、ADR 和 GDR。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）半導體和量子運算生態系統的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: enVVeno Medical Corp. is a development stage medical device company, which develops tissue based solutions that are designed to be life sustaining or life enhancing for patients with cardiovascular disease, and peripheral arterial and venous disease. Its products include VenoValve and enVVe. The company was founded by Norman Jaffe on December 22, 1999 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: enVVeno Medical Corp. 是一家處於開發階段的醫療器材公司，開發基於組織的解決方案，旨在為心血管疾病、週邊動脈和靜脈疾病患者維持生命或增強生命。其產品包括VenoValve和enVVe。該公司由 Norman Jaffe 於 1999 年 12 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Momentum Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The Adviser expects that, over time, if it has sufficient assets, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index, before fees and expenses, will be 95% or better. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Momentum Index 的總回報表現大致相對應的投資結果。一般情況下，基金總資產至少80%會投資於指數成分證券。顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，如果擁有足夠的資產，在扣除費用和開支之前，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck ETF that tracks an index of companies involved in China's semiconductor industry, including chip design, manufacturing, and equipment firms.
info.description_zh: VanEck ETF 追蹤中國半導體產業的公司指數，包括晶片設計、製造和設備公司。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF seeks stment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of DraftKings Inc. (Nasdaq: DKNG). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前，DraftKings Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：DKNG）股價每日百分比變化兩倍（200%）的評估結果。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design and test solutions that are used in the design, development, manufacture, installation, deployment, validation, optimization, and secure operation of electronics systems to communications, networking, and electronics industries. It operates through the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG) segments. The CSG segment serves customers spanning the global commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The EISG segment offers test and measurement solutions across electronic industrial end markets, focusing on applications in the automotive, and energy industry and measurement solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing, consumer electronics, education, and general electronics manufacturing. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard in 1937 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: 是德科技公司致力於提供電子設計和測試解決方案，這些解決方案用於通訊、網路和電子行業電子系統的設計、開發、製造、安裝、部署、驗證、最佳化和安全操作。它透過通訊解決方案集團（CSG）和電子工業解決方案集團（EISG）部門運作。 CSG 部門為全球商業通訊、航空航太、國防和政府終端市場的客戶提供服務。 EISG 部門提供跨電子工業終端市場的測試和測量解決方案，重點關注汽車和能源產業的應用以及半導體設計和製造、消費性電子、教育和通用電子製造的測量解決方案。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1937 年創立，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: Iron Mountain, Inc. engages in the provision of storage and information management solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Global Records & Information Management Business, Global Data Center Business and Corporate & Other Business. The Global Records & Information Management Business segment offers comprehensive solutions for storing, managing, digitizing, and securely disposing of records and information worldwide. The Global Data Center Business segment provides data center facilities to protect mission-critical assets and ensure the continued operation of its customers IT infrastructures, with secure and reliable colocation and wholesale options. The Corporate & Other Business segment consists of the storage, safeguarding and electronic or physical deliveries of physical media of all types and digital content repository systems to house, distribute, and archive key media assets, primarily for entertainment and media industry clients. The company was founded by Herman Knaust in 1951 and is headquartered in Portsmouth, NH.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Iron Mountain, Inc. 從事提供儲存和資訊管理解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：全球記錄和資訊管理業務、全球資料中心業務以及企業及其他業務。全球記錄和資訊管理業務部門提供用於儲存、管理、數位化和安全處置全球記錄和資訊的全面解決方案。全球資料中心業務部門提供資料中心設施，以保護關鍵任務資產並確保客戶 IT 基礎設施的持續運營，並提供安全可靠的託管和批發選項。企業及其他業務部門包括所有類型的實體媒體和數位內容儲存庫系統的儲存、保護和電子或實體交付，以容納、分發和存檔關鍵媒體資產，主要面向娛樂和媒體行業客戶。該公司由 Herman Knaust 於 1951 年創立，總部位於新罕布夏州朴茨茅斯。

info.description: Invesco DWA Industrials Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Industrials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the industrials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Industrials Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Industrials Technical Leaders Index（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由至少 30 隻具有強大相對實力或「動量」特徵的工業部門公司證券組成。

info.description: Dermata Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage medical dermatology company that focuses on identifying, developing, and commercializing pharmaceutical product candidates for the treatment of medical and aesthetic skin diseases. The company was founded by David F. Hale and Gerald T. Proehl on December 8, 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Dermata Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的醫學皮膚科公司，專注於識別、開發和商業化用於治療醫學和美容皮膚病的候選藥物。該公司由 David F. Hale 和 Gerald T. Proehl 於 2014 年 12 月 8 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: FitLife Brands, Inc. engages in the provision of nutritional supplements for health conscious consumers. Its brands include NDS Nutrition, PMD Sports, SirenLabs, Core Active, Nutrology, Metis Nutrition, iSatori, BioGenetic Laboratories, Energize, Maritime Naturals and MusclePharm. The company was founded by Scott D. Landow on July 26, 2005 and is headquartered in Omaha, NE.
info.description_zh: FitLife Brands, Inc. 致力於為注重健康的消費者提供營養補充品。其品牌包括 NDS Nutrition、PMD Sports、SirenLabs、Core Active、Nutrology、Metis Nutrition、iSatori、BioGenetic Laboratories、Energize、Maritime Naturals 和 MusclePharm。該公司由 Scott D. Landow 於 2005 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於內布拉斯加州奧馬哈。

info.description: QuantumScape Corp. engages in developing next-generation solid-state lithium-metal batteries. The company's next-generation batteries are designed to enable greater energy density, faster charging, and enhanced safety to support the transition away from legacy energy sources toward a lower-carbon future. The company was founded by Jagdeep Singh, Tim Holme, and Fritz B. Prinz in May 2010 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: QuantumScape Corp. 致力於開發新一代固態鋰金屬電池。該公司的下一代電池旨在實現更高的能量密度、更快的充電速度和更高的安全性，以支持從傳統能源向低碳未來的過渡。該公司由 Jagdeep Singh、Tim Holme 和 Fritz B. Prinz 於 2010 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Direxion Daily ASML Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of ASML Holding N.V. The fund employs financial derivative instruments to provide concentrated, leveraged exposure to a global leader in photolithography systems for the semiconductor industry, intended for sophisticated investors to manage short-term risk or execute tactical views.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily ASML Bull 2X ETF 尋求 ASML Holding N.V. 普通股每日表現 200% 的每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金採用金融衍生工具，為半導體產業光刻系統的全球領導者提供集中的槓桿投資，旨在幫助經驗豐富的投資者管理短期風險或執行戰術觀點。

info.description: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of medical diagnostic testing services. It also develops and commercializes a series of products for major types of cardiovascular disease and associated comorbidities, including coronary heart disease (CHD), stroke, heart failure, and diabetes. The company was founded by Meeshanthini V. Dogan and Robert Philibert in 2017 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供醫療診斷測試服務。它還開發和商業化一系列針對主要類型心血管疾病和相關合併症的產品，包括冠狀動脈心臟病（CHD）、中風、心臟衰竭和糖尿病。該公司由 Meeshanthini V. Dogan 和 Robert Philibert 於 2017 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the business of wet trades such as plastering, brickwork, wall and floor tiling, painting and decoration, floor screeding, and marble works. The firm also involves in construction, renovation, maintenance, addition, and alteration of buildings in mainly residential and commercial segments, as well as industrial buildings, government buildings, community facilities transportation, and public infrastructure. The company was founded on August 2, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 明成集團控股有限公司是一家控股公司，從事抹灰、磚瓦、牆地磚、油漆及裝飾、地板及大理石工程等濕工業務。該公司還涉及主要住宅和商業領域的建築物的建設、翻新、維護、加建和改造，以及工業建築、政府建築、社區設施交通和公共基礎設施。該公司成立於2022年8月2日，總部位於香港。

info.description: BrenX Ltd. engages in development, production, marketing, and sale of thermal energy storage systems, based on technology developed in the company that enables heat storage at high temperatures in crushed volcanic rocks. It operates as a dedicated project company for the construction and operation of a power plant as part of a 7.1 MW power production facility, which combines solar energy and natural gas for the sale of electricity to the Israel Electric Company. The company was founded by Avi Brenmiller on January 12, 2012 and is headquartered in Rosh Haayin, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: BrenX Ltd. 從事熱能儲存系統的開發、生產、行銷和銷售，該系統基於該公司開發的技術，可在碎火山岩中進行高溫儲熱。它作為一家專門的項目公司運營，負責建設和運營發電廠，作為 7.1 兆瓦發電設施的一部分，該發電廠將太陽能和天然氣結合起來，向以色列電力公司出售電力。该公司由Avi Brenmiller于2012年1月12日创立，总部位于以色列罗什艾因。

info.description: Cyabra, Inc. engages in the provision of data authentication analysis. The firm provides a software that detects fake information and mitigates it in real time. It also helps discover AI-generated content, bot networks, fake profiles, and deepfakes. The company was founded by Dan Brahmy, Yossef Daar and Ido Shraga in July 2017 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Cyabra, Inc. 從事提供資料認證分析。該公司提供了一種軟體，可以檢測虛假資訊並即時消除虛假資訊。它還有助於發現人工智慧生成的內容、機器人網路、虛假個人資料和深度偽造品。該公司由 Dan Brahmy、Yossef Daar 和 Ido Shraga 於 2017 年 7 月創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Blaize Holdings, Inc. provides artificial intelligence solutions. It develops hardware computing platforms for augmented reality, drones, and automobiles. The company was founded by Dinakar C. Munagala, Satyaki Koneru, and Ke Yin in January 2010 and is headquartered in El Dorado Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Blaize Holdings, Inc. 提供人工智慧解決方案。它為擴增實境、無人機和汽車開發硬體運算平台。該公司由 Dinakar C. Munagala、Satyaki Koneru 和 Ke Yin 於 2010 年 1 月創立，總部位於加州埃爾多拉多山。
